    13                                  ; 20/12/2022 - Modifications for initiating IO.SYS by Retro DOS v2 boot sector
    14                                  ;
    15                                  ;	       (Retro DOS v2 BS loads IO.SYS & MSDOS.SYS as single kernel file
    16                                  ;	       with name of 'MSDOS.SYS'. Retro DOS init code -for IO.SYS init-
    17                                  ;	       is different than original MSDOS IO.SYS LOADER and INIT code.)
    18                                  ;
    19                                  ;	       ((RETRODOS.SYS/MSDOS.SYS can be loaded by a fake IO.SYS for
    20                                  ;		using it with MSDOS 5.0 boot sector & as bootable MSDOS disk.
    21                                  ;		For that, fake IO.SYS must load 'MSDOS.SYS' at 1000h:0000h.))
    22                                  ;
    23                                  ; 18/12/2022 - Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS (for using with MSDOS 5 boot sector)
    24                                  ; 09/12/2022 - Multisection binary file format (BIOSDATA & BIOSCODE sections)
    25                                  ; 01/10/2022 - Erdogan Tan (Istanbul)
    26                                  
    27                                  ;Note: This code is a part of Retro DOS 4.0 kernel source code
    28                                  ;     (as included binary, 'IOSYS5.BIN')
    29                                  ;     Equivalent of MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS, BIOSCODE and BIOSDATA and SYSINIT
    30                                  ;						        (except MSLOAD code)
    31                                  
    32                                  ;------- Retro DOS v2 (v3) boot sector loads RETRODOS.SYS (MSDOS.SYS)
    33                                  ;	 at 1000h:0000h and loader (initialization) part of RETRODOS kernel
    34                                  ;	 moves IO.SYS (DOSBIOSCODE & DOSBIOSDATA, 'IOSYS5.BIN') to 70h:0000h.
    35                                  ;	 Then SYSINIT code to the next segment (46Dh for original MSDOS 5.0)..
    36                                  ;	 SYSINIT code relocates itself and DOSBIOSCODE and MSDOS.SYS
    37                                  ;	 (MSDOS5.BIN) according to request/setting in 'config.sys' file.
    38

   129                                  ; 26/12/2018 (Retro DOS 4.0 - MSDOS 6.0 "MSBDS.INC" - 1991)
   130                                  ; -------------------------------------------------------------------------
   131                                  ; 24/02/2018 (Retro DOS 2.0 - MSDOS 3.3 "MSBDS.INC" - 24/07/1987)
   132                                  ;
   133                                  ;  BDS is the Bios Data Structure.
   134                                  ;
   135                                  ;  There is one BDS for each logical drive in the system. All the BDS's
   136                                  ;  are linked together in a list with the pointer to the first BDS being
   137                                  ;  found in START_BDS. The BDS hold various values important to the disk
   138                                  ;  drive. For example there is a field for last time accesses. As actions
   139                                  ;  take place in the system the BDS are update to reflect the actions.
   140                                  ;  For example is there is a read to a disk the last access field for the
   141                                  ;  BDS for that drive is update to the current time.
   142                                  ;
   143                                  ; Values for various flags in BDS.flags.
   144                                  ;
   145                                  
   146                                  fnon_removable	    equ     01h 	;For non-removable media
   147                                  fchangeline	    equ     02h 	;If changeline supported on drive
   148                                  return_fake_bpb     equ     04h 	; When set, don't do a build BPB
   149                                  					; just return the fake one
   150                                  good_tracklayout    equ     08h 	; The track layout has no funny sectors
   151                                  fi_am_mult	    equ     10h 	;If more than one logical for this physical
   152                                  fi_own_physical     equ     20h 	;Signify logical owner of this physical
   153                                  fchanged	    equ     40h 	;Indicates media changed
   154                                  set_dasd_true	    equ     80h 	; Set DASD before next format
   155                                  fchanged_by_format  equ    100h		;Media changed by format
   156                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
   157                                  unformatted_media   equ    200h 	;Fixed disk only
   158                                  
   159                                  ;
   160                                  ; Various form factors to describe media
   161                                  ;
   162                                  
   163                                  ff48tpi 	    equ     0
   164                                  ff96tpi 	    equ     1
   165                                  ffSmall 	    equ     2
   166                                  ffHardFile	    equ     5

   296                                  ; GENERIC IOCTL REQUEST STRUCTURE (DEVSYM.INC, MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
   297                                  ;	SEE THE DOS 4.0 DEVICE DRIVER SPEC FOR FURTHER ELABORATION.
   298                                  ;

   300                                  	       ;DB   (SIZE SRHEAD) DUP(?)

   302                                  			    	; GENERIC IOCTL ADDITION.
   303 0000000D ??                      .MAJORFUNCTION:	resb 1		;FUNCTION CODE
   304 0000000E ??                      .MINORFUNCTION:	resb 1		;FUNCTION CATEGORY
   305 0000000F ????                    .REG_SI:	resw 1

   311                                  IOC_OTHER	EQU	0	; Other device control J.K. 4/29/86
   312                                  IOC_SE		EQU	1	; SERIAL DEVICE CONTROL

   328                                  ; 29/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0 (DEVSYM.INC, MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
   329                                  
   330                                  ;	THE DEVICE TABLE LIST HAS THE FORM:
   331                                  
   332                                  ;struc SYSDEV
   333                                  ; .NEXT:  resd 1	;POINTER TO NEXT DEVICE HEADER
   334                                  ; .ATT:	  resw 1	;ATTRIBUTES OF THE DEVICE
   335                                  ; .STRAT: resw 1	;STRATEGY ENTRY POINT
   336                                  ; .INT:	  resw 1	;INTERRUPT ENTRY POINT
   337                                  ; .NAME:  resb 8	;NAME OF DEVICE (ONLY FIRST BYTE USED FOR BLOCK)
   338                                  ; .size:
   339                                  ;endstruc
   340                                  
   341                                  ; 27/03/2018 - DEVSYM.INC - MSDOS 3.3 - 24/07/1987
   342                                  
   343                                  ;
   344                                  ; ATTRIBUTE BIT MASKS
   345                                  ;
   346                                  ; CHARACTER DEVICES:
   347                                  ;
   348                                  ; BIT 15 -> MUST BE 1
   349                                  ;     14 -> 1 IF THE DEVICE UNDERSTANDS IOCTL CONTROL STRINGS
   350                                  ;     13 -> 1 IF THE DEVICE SUPPORTS OUTPUT-UNTIL-BUSY
   351                                  ;     12 -> UNUSED
   352                                  ;     11 -> 1 IF THE DEVICE UNDERSTANDS OPEN/CLOSE
   353                                  ;     10 -> MUST BE 0
   354                                  ;      9 -> MUST BE 0
   355                                  ;      8 -> UNUSED
   356                                  ;      7 -> UNUSED
   357                                  ;      6 -> UNUSED
   358                                  ;      5 -> UNUSED
   359                                  ;      4 -> 1 IF DEVICE IS RECIPIENT OF INT 29H
   360                                  ;      3 -> 1 IF DEVICE IS CLOCK DEVICE
   361                                  ;      2 -> 1 IF DEVICE IS NULL DEVICE
   362                                  ;      1 -> 1 IF DEVICE IS CONSOLE OUTPUT
   363                                  ;      0 -> 1 IF DEVICE IS CONSOLE INPUT
   364                                  ;
   365                                  ; BLOCK DEVICES:
   366                                  ;
   367                                  ; BIT 15 -> MUST BE 0
   368                                  ;     14 -> 1 IF THE DEVICE UNDERSTANDS IOCTL CONTROL STRINGS
   369                                  ;     13 -> 1 IF THE DEVICE DETERMINES MEDIA BY EXAMINING THE FAT ID BYTE.
   370                                  ;	    THIS REQUIRES THE FIRST SECTOR OF THE FAT TO *ALWAYS* RESIDE IN
   371                                  ;	    THE SAME PLACE.
   372                                  ;     12 -> UNUSED
   373                                  ;     11 -> 1 IF THE DEVICE UNDERSTANDS OPEN/CLOSE/REMOVABLE MEDIA
   374                                  ;     10 -> MUST BE 0
   375                                  ;      9 -> MUST BE 0
   376                                  ;      8 -> UNUSED
   377                                  ;      7 -> UNUSED
   378                                  ;      6 -> IF DEVICE HAS SUPPORT FOR GETMAP/SETMAP OF LOGICAL DRIVES.
   379                                  ;	    IF THE DEVICE UNDERSTANDS GENERIC IOCTL FUNCTION CALLS.
   380                                  ;      5 -> UNUSED
   381                                  ;      4 -> UNUSED
   382                                  ;      3 -> UNUSED
   383                                  ;      2 -> UNUSED
   384                                  ;      1 -> UNUSED
   385                                  ;      0 -> UNUSED
   386                                  ;
   387                                  
   388                                  DEVTYP	       EQU   8000H	    ; BIT 15 - 1 IF CHAR, 0 IF BLOCK
   389                                  CHARDEV        EQU   8000H
   390                                  DEVIOCTL       EQU   4000H	    ; BIT 14 - CONTROL MODE BIT
   391                                  ISFATBYDEV     EQU   2000H	    ; BIT 13 - DEVICE USES FAT ID BYTES,
   392                                  				    ;  COMP MEDIA.
   393                                  OUTTILBUSY     EQU   2000H	    ; OUTPUT UNTIL BUSY IS ENABLED
   394                                  ISNET	       EQU   1000H	    ; BIT 12 - 1 IF A NET DEVICE, 0 IF
   395                                  				    ;  NOT.  CURRENTLY BLOCK ONLY.
   396                                  DEVOPCL        EQU   0800H	    ; BIT 11 - 1 IF THIS DEVICE HAS
   397                                  				    ;  OPEN,CLOSE AND REMOVABLE MEDIA
   398                                  				    ;  ENTRY POINTS, 0 IF NOT
   399                                  
   400                                  EXTENTBIT      EQU   0400H	    ; BIT 10 - CURRENTLY 0 ON ALL DEVS
   401                                  				    ;  THIS BIT IS RESERVED FOR FUTURE USE
   402                                  				    ;  TO EXTEND THE DEVICE HEADER BEYOND
   403                                  				    ;  ITS CURRENT FORM.
   404                                  
   405                                  ; NOTE BIT 9 IS CURRENTLY USED ON IBM SYSTEMS TO INDICATE "DRIVE IS SHARED".
   406                                  ;    SEE IOCTL FUNCTION 9. THIS USE IS NOT DOCUMENTED, IT IS USED BY SOME
   407                                  ;    OF THE UTILITIES WHICH ARE SUPPOSED TO FAIL ON SHARED DRIVES ON SERVER
   408                                  ;    MACHINES (FORMAT,CHKDSK,RECOVER,..).
   409                                  
   410                                  ; 18/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
   411                                  IOQUERY	       EQU   0080H	    ;Bit 7 - Supports generic IOCtl query M017
   412                                  
   413                                  DEV320	       EQU   0040H	    ;BIT 6 - FOR BLOCK DEVICES, THIS
   414                                  				    ;DEVICE SUPPORTS SET/GET MAP OF
   415                                  				    ;LOGICAL DRIVES, AND SUPPORTS
   416                                  				    ;GENERIC IOCTL CALLS.
   417                                  				    ;FOR CHARACTER DEVICES, THIS
   418                                  				    ;DEVICE SUPPORTS GENERIC IOCTL.
   419                                  				    ;THIS IS A DOS 3.2 DEVICE DRIVER.
   420                                  ISSPEC	       EQU   0010H	    ;BIT 4 - THIS DEVICE IS SPECIAL
   421                                  ISCLOCK        EQU   0008H	    ;BIT 3 - THIS DEVICE IS THE CLOCK DEVICE.
   422                                  ISNULL	       EQU   0004H	    ;BIT 2 - THIS DEVICE IS THE NULL DEVICE.
   423                                  ISCOUT	       EQU   0002H	    ;BIT 1 - THIS DEVICE IS THE CONSOLE OUTPUT.

   469                                  ;*** J.K.
   470                                  ;General Guide -
   471                                  ;Category Code:
   472                                  ; 0... .... DOS Defined
   473                                  ; 1... .... User defined
   474                                  ; .xxx xxxx Code
   475                                  
   476                                  ;Function Code:
   477                                  ; 0... .... Return error if unsupported
   478                                  ; 1... .... Ignore if unsupported
   479                                  ; .0.. .... Intercepted by DOS
   480                                  ; .1.. .... Passed to driver
   481                                  ; ..0. .... Sends data/commands to device
   482                                  ; ..1. .... Quries data/info from device
   483                                  ; ...x .... Subfunction
   484                                  ;
   485                                  ; Note that "Sends/queries" data bit is intended only to regularize the
   486                                  ; function set.  It plays no critical role; some functions may contain both
   487                                  ; command and query elements. The convention is that such commands are
   488                                  ; defined as "sends data".

  1066 0000011B 7000                    		dw 70h			; KERNEL_SEGMENT
  1067                                  
  1068                                  ; (MSDOS 3.3) NOTE:
  1069                                  ; Some floppy drives do not have changeline support. The result is a
  1070                                  ; large amount of inefficiency in the code. A media-check always returns
  1071                                  ; "I don`t know". This cause DOS to reread the FAT on every access and
  1072                                  ; always discard any cached data.
  1073                                  ;    We get around this inefficiency by implementing a "Logical Door Latch".
  1074                                  ; The following three items are used to do this. The logical door latch is
  1075                                  ; based on the premise that it is not physically possible to change floppy
  1076                                  ; disks in a drive in under two seconds (most people take about 10). The
  1077                                  ; logical door latch is implemented by saving the time of the last successful
  1078                                  ; disk operation (in the value TIM_DRV). When a new request is made the
  1079                                  ; current time is compared to the saved time. If less than two seconds have
  1080                                  ; passed then the value "No Change" is returned. If more than two seconds
  1081                                  ; have passed the value "Don't Know" is returned.
  1082                                  ;    There is one complecation to this algorithm. Some programs change the
  1083                                  ; value of the timer. In this unfortunate case we have an invalid timer.
  1084                                  ; This possibility is detected by counting the number of disk operations
  1085                                  ; which occur without any time passing. If this count exceeds the value of
  1086                                  ; "AccessMax" we assume the counter is invalid and always return "Don't
  1087                                  ; Know". The variable "AccessCount" is used to keep track of the number
  1088                                  ; of disk operation which occur without the time changing.
  1089                                  
  1090 0000011D 00                      accesscount:	db 0			
  1091 0000011E FF                      tim_drv:	db 0FFh			
  1092 0000011F 00                      medbyt:		db 0
  1093                                  wrtverify:	; 15/10/2022			
  1094 00000120 02                      rflag:		db 2			; 2 for	read, 3	for write
  1095 00000121 00                      verify:		db 0			; 1 if verify after write
  1096 00000122 0000                    seccnt:		dw 0			
  1097 00000124 00                      		db 0			; -- pad where hardnum was
  1098 00000125 01                      dsktnum:	db 1			; number of diskette drives			
  1099                                  
  1100                                  ; (MSDOS 3.3) NOTE:
  1101                                  ; Some of the older versions of the IBM rom-bios always assumed a seek would
  1102                                  ; have to be made to read the diskette. Consequently a large head settle
  1103                                  ; time was always used in the I/O operations. To get around this problem
  1104                                  ; we need to continually adjust the head settle time. The following
  1105                                  ; algorithm is used:
  1106                                  ;
  1107                                  ;   Get the current head settle value.
  1108                                  ;   If it is 1, then
  1109                                  ;	set slow = 15
  1110                                  ;   else
  1111                                  ;	set slow = value
  1112                                  ;   ...
  1113                                  ;   if we are seeking and writing then
  1114                                  ;	use slow
  1115                                  ;   else
  1116                                  ;	use fast
  1117                                  ;   ...
  1118                                  ;   restore current head settle value
  1119                                  
  1120 00000126 00                      motorstartup:	db 0			; value from table
  1121 00000127 00                      settlecurrent:	db 0			; value from table
  1122 00000128 00                      settleslow:	db 0			; slow settle value
  1123 00000129 00                      nextspeed:	db 0			; value	of speed to be used
  1124 0000012A 00                      save_head_sttl:	db 0			; used by read_sector routine
  1125 0000012B 00                      save_eot:	db 0			; saved	eot from the default DPT
  1126 0000012C 09                      eot:		db 9

  1701                                  ;************************************************************************
  1702                                  ;*									*
  1703                                  ;*	Ensure A20 is enabled before jumping into code in HMA.		*
  1704                                  ;*	This code assumes that if Segment of Device request packet is	*
  1705                                  ;*	DOS DATA segment then the Device request came from DOS & that	*
  1706                                  ;*	A20 is already on.						*
  1707                                  ;*									*
  1708                                  ;************************************************************************
  1709                                  
  1710                                  cdev_entry:	; proc near		
  1711 00000715 2E803E[0D00]00          		cmp	byte [cs:inHMA], 0
  1712 0000071B 740D                    		jz	short ce_enter_codeseg
  1713                                  				; optimized for DOS in HMA
  1714 0000071D 50                      		push	ax
  1715 0000071E 2EA1[0300]              		mov	ax, [cs:DosDataSg]
  1716 00000722 2E3906[1400]            		cmp	[cs:ptrsav+2], ax
  1717 00000727 58                      		pop	ax
  1718 00000728 7505                    		jnz	short not_from_dos
  1719                                  				; jump is coded this way to fall thru
  1720                                  				; in 99.99% of the cases
  1721                                  ce_enter_codeseg:
  1722 0000072A 2EFF2E[B406]            		jmp	far [cs:cdev]

  2136                                  ; This table gives Win386 the instance data in the BIOS and ROM-BIOS data

  2151                                  ;	instance items WILL NOT be filled in by SYSINIT.
  2152                                  ;	That's just fine as long as these are the last items

  2154                                  ;	to 0000 at load time.

  2483                                  
  2484                                  ; Possibly disposable data, goes at end of data group
  2485                                  
  2486                                  ;***	ibm_disk_io - main routine, fixes at rom bug
  2487                                  ;
  2488                                  ;	entry:	(ah) = function, 02 or 0a for read.
  2489                                  ;		(dl) = drive number (80h or 81h).
  2490                                  ;		(dh) = head number.
  2491                                  ;		(ch) = cylinder number.
  2492                                  ;		(cl) = sector number (high 2 bits has cylinder number).
  2493                                  ;		(al) = number of sectors.
  2494                                  ;		(es:bx) = address of read buffer.
  2495                                  ;		for more on register contents see rom bios listing.
  2496                                  ;		stack set up for return by an iret.
  2497                                  ;
  2498                                  ;	exit:	(ah) = status of current operation.
  2499                                  ;		(cy) = 1 if failed, 0 if successful.
  2500                                  ;		for other register contents see rom bios listing.
  2501                                  ;
  2502                                  ;	uses:	
  2503                                  ;
  2504                                  ;
  2505                                  ;	warning: uses old13 vector for non-read calls.
  2506                                  ;		does direct calls to the at rom.
  2507                                  ;		does segment arithmatic.
  2508                                  ;
  2509                                  ;	effects: performs disk i/o operation.
  2510                                  
  2511                                  ; 16/10/2022
  2512                                  ; 28/05/2019
  2513                                  cmd_block equ 42h ; ROMBIOS DATA segment (40h) offset 42h ; 13/12/2022
  2514                                  
  2515                                  ;* offsets into cmd_block for registers
  2516                                  
  2517                                  pre_comp equ 0	;write pre-compensation
  2518                                  sec_cnt	 equ 1	;sector count
  2519                                  sec_num	 equ 2	;sector number
  2520                                  cyl_low	 equ 3	;cylinder number, low part
  2521                                  cyl_high equ 4	;cylinder number, high part
  2522                                  drv_head equ 5	;drive/head (bit 7 = ecc mode, bit 5 = 512 byte sectors, 
  2523                                  		;            bit 4 = drive number, bits 3-0 have head number)
  2524                                  cmd_reg  equ 6	;command register
  2525                                  
  2526                                  ; 01/10/2022
  2527                                  disk_status1	equ 74h
  2528                                  hf_num		equ 75h
  2529                                  control_byte	equ 76h
  2530                                  
  2531                                  ibm_disk_io:				
  2532 00001273 80FA80                  		cmp	dl, 80h		; main routine,	fixes at rom bug
  2533 00001276 720A                    		jb	short atd1	; pass through floppy disk calls. 
  2534 00001278 80FC02                  		cmp	ah, 2
  2535 0000127B 740A                    		jz	short atd2	; intercept call 02 (read sectors).
  2536 0000127D 80FC0A                  		cmp	ah, 0Ah
  2537 00001280 7405                    		jz	short atd2	; and call 0Ah (read long).
  2538                                  atd1:
  2539 00001282 2EFF2E[0601]            		jmp	far [cs:Old13]					
  2540                                  		;jmp	cs:Old13	; use rom int 13h handler
  2541                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2542                                  
  2543                                  atd2:					
  2544 00001287 53                      		push	bx
  2545 00001288 51                      		push	cx
  2546 00001289 52                      		push	dx
  2547 0000128A 57                      		push	di
  2548 0000128B 1E                      		push	ds
  2549 0000128C 06                      		push	es
  2550 0000128D 50                      		push	ax
  2551 0000128E B84000                  		mov	ax, 40h		; bioseg (rombios data segment)
  2552                                  					; establish bios segment addressing
  2553 00001291 8ED8                    		mov	ds, ax
  2554                                  		; 16/10/2022
  2555 00001293 C606740000              		mov	byte [disk_status1], 0
  2556                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:74h, 0 ; [disk_status1]
  2557                                  					; initially no error code.
  2558 00001298 80E27F                  		and	dl, 7Fh		; mask to hard disk number
  2559 0000129B 3A167500                		cmp	dl, [hf_num]
  2560                                  		;cmp	dl, ds:75h	; [hf_num] ; 40h:75h
  2561 0000129F 7207                    		jb	short atd3	; disk number in range
  2562                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:74h, 1 ; bad_disk
  2563 000012A1 C606740001              		mov	byte [disk_status1], 1
  2564 000012A6 EB20                    		jmp	short atd4	; disk number out of range error,
  2565                                  					; return
  2566                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2567                                  
  2568                                  atd3:					
  2569 000012A8 53                      		push	bx
  2570 000012A9 8CC0                    		mov	ax, es
  2571 000012AB C1EB04                  		shr	bx, 4		; make es:bx to seg:000x form.
  2572 000012AE 01D8                    		add	ax, bx
  2573 000012B0 8EC0                    		mov	es, ax
  2574 000012B2 5B                      		pop	bx
  2575 000012B3 83E30F                  		and	bx, 0Fh
  2576 000012B6 0E                      		push	cs
  2577 000012B7 E8DF00                  		call	check_dma
  2578 000012BA 720C                    		jb	short atd4	; abort if dma across segment boundary
  2579 000012BC 58                      		pop	ax
  2580 000012BD 50                      		push	ax
  2581 000012BE E81A00                  		call	setcmd		; set up command block for disk op
  2582 000012C1 BAF603                  		mov	dx, 3F6h	; hf_reg_port 
  2583 000012C4 EE                      		out	dx, al		; write out command modifier
  2584 000012C5 E86B00                  		call	docmd		; carry out command
  2585                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2586                                  
  2587                                  atd4:	
  2588                                  
  2589                                  ;  new code - let logical or clear carry and then set carry if ah!=0
  2590                                  ;	      and save a couple bytes while were at it.
  2591                                  				
  2592 000012C8 58                      		pop	ax
  2593                                  		;mov	ah, ds:74h	; [disk_status1]
  2594 000012C9 8A267400                		mov	ah, [disk_status1]
  2595 000012CD 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
  2596 000012CF 7401                    		jz	short atd5
  2597 000012D1 F9                      		stc
  2598                                  atd5:					
  2599 000012D2 07                      		pop	es
  2600 000012D3 1F                      		pop	ds
  2601 000012D4 5F                      		pop	di
  2602 000012D5 5A                      		pop	dx
  2603 000012D6 59                      		pop	cx
  2604 000012D7 5B                      		pop	bx
  2605 000012D8 CA0200                  		retf	2		; far return, dropping flags
  2606                                  
  2607                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E ========================================
  2608                                  
  2609                                  ;***	setcmd - set up cmd_block for the disk operation
  2610                                  ;
  2611                                  ;	entry:	(ds) = bios data segment.
  2612                                  ;		(es:bx) in seg:000x form.
  2613                                  ;		other registers as in int 13h call
  2614                                  ;	
  2615                                  ;	exit:	cmd_block set up for disk read call.
  2616                                  ;		control_byte set up for disk operation.
  2617                                  ;		(al) = control byte modifier
  2618                                  ;
  2619                                  ;	sets the fields of cmd_block using the register contents
  2620                                  ;	and the contents of the disk parameter block for the given drive.
  2621                                  ;
  2622                                  ;	warning: (ax) destroyed.
  2623                                  ;		does direct calls to the at rom.
  2624                                  
  2625                                  setcmd:		; proc near		
  2626                                  		;mov	ds:43h,	al	; [cmd_block+sec_cnt]
  2627                                  		; 16/10/2022
  2628 000012DB A24300                  		mov	[cmd_block+sec_cnt], al
  2629                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:48h, 20h ; [cmd_block+cmd_reg]
  2630 000012DE C606480020              		mov	byte [cmd_block+cmd_reg], 20h ; assume function 02h (read)
  2631 000012E3 80FC02                  		cmp	ah, 2
  2632 000012E6 7405                    		jz	short setc1	; cmd_reg = 20h	if function 02h	(read)
  2633 000012E8 C606480022              		mov	byte [cmd_block+cmd_reg], 22h
  2634                                  		;mov	byte ptr ds:48h, 22h ; [cmd_block+cmd_reg]
  2635                                  					; cmd_reg = 22h	if function 0Ah	(read long)
  2636                                  setc1:					
  2637 000012ED 88C8                    		mov	al, cl
  2638 000012EF 243F                    		and	al, 3Fh		; mask sector number
  2639                                  		;mov	ds:44h,	al	; [cmd_block+sec_num]
  2640                                  		;mov	ds:45h,	ch	; [cmd_block+cyl_low]
  2641 000012F1 A24400                  		mov	[cmd_block+sec_num], al ; mov [44h],al
  2642 000012F4 882E4500                		mov	[cmd_block+cyl_low], ch ; mov [45h],ch
  2643 000012F8 88C8                    		mov	al, cl
  2644 000012FA C0E806                  		shr	al, 6		; get two high bits of cylinder	number
  2645                                  		;mov	ds:46h,	al	; [cmd_block+cyl_high]
  2646 000012FD A24600                  		mov	[cmd_block+cyl_high], al ; mov [46h],al
  2647 00001300 89D0                    		mov	ax, dx
  2648 00001302 C0E004                  		shl	al, 4		; drive	number
  2649 00001305 80E40F                  		and	ah, 0Fh

  2659                                  			 		; write pre-comp from disk parameters

  2678                                  ;***	docmd - carry out read operation to at hard disk
  2679                                  ;
  2680                                  ;	entry:	(es:bx) = address for read in data.
  2681                                  ;		cmd_block set up for disk read.
  2682                                  ;
  2683                                  ;	exit:	buffer at (es:bx) contains data read.
  2684                                  ;		disk_status1 set to error code (0 if success).
  2685                                  ;
  2686                                  ;	
  2687                                  ;
  2688                                  ;	warning: (ax), (bl), (cx), (dx), (di) destroyed.
  2689                                  ;		no check is made for dma boundary overrun.
  2690                                  ;
  2691                                  ;	effects: programs disk controller.
  2692                                  ;		performs disk input.
  2693                                  
  2694                                  docmd:		; proc near		
  2695 00001333 89DF                    		mov	di, bx
  2696 00001335 0E                      		push	cs
  2697 00001336 E84000                  		call	command
  2698 00001339 7535                    		jnz	short doc3
  2699                                  doc1:					
  2700 0000133B 0E                      		push	cs
  2701 0000133C E84200                  		call	waitt		; wait for controller to complete read
  2702 0000133F 752F                    		jnz	short doc3
  2703 00001341 B90001                  		mov	cx, 256		; 256 words per sector
  2704 00001344 BAF001                  		mov	dx, 1F0h	; hf_port
  2705 00001347 FC                      		cld			; string op goes up
  2706 00001348 FA                      		cli			; disable interrupts
  2707                                  					; (bug was forgetting this)
  2708                                  
  2709                                  ;	M062 -- some of these old machines have intermittent failures
  2710                                  ;		when the read is done at full speed. Instead of using
  2711                                  ;		a string rep instruction, we'll use a loop. There is
  2712                                  ;		a slight performance hit, but it only affects these
  2713                                  ;		very old machines with an exact date code match, and
  2714                                  ;		it makes said machines more reliable
  2715                                  ;
  2716                                  ;M062	repz	insw		;read in sector
  2717                                  
  2718                                  rsct_loop:				
  2719 00001349 6D                      		insw
  2720 0000134A E2FD                    		loop	rsct_loop
  2721 0000134C FB                      		sti
  2722                                  		; 16/10/2022
  2723 0000134D F606480002              		test	byte [cmd_block+cmd_reg], 02h
  2724                                  		;test	byte ptr ds:48h, 2 ; [cmd_block+cmd_reg]
  2725                                  					; (ds =	40h)
  2726 00001352 7410                    		jz	short doc2	; no ecc bytes to read.
  2727 00001354 0E                      		push	cs
  2728 00001355 E83100                  		call	wait_drq	; wait for controller to complete read
  2729 00001358 7216                    		jb	short doc3
  2730 0000135A B90400                  		mov	cx, 4		; 4 bytes of ecc
  2731 0000135D BAF001                  		mov	dx, 1F0h	; hf_port

  2733 00001361 F36C                    		rep insb		; read in ecc
  2734 00001363 FB                      		sti
  2735                                  doc2:					
  2736 00001364 0E                      		push	cs
  2737 00001365 E82900                  		call	check_status
  2738 00001368 7506                    		jnz	short doc3	; operation failed
  2739                                  		;dec	byte ptr ds:43h	; [cmd_block+sec_cnt]
  2740 0000136A FE0E4300                		dec	byte [cmd_block+sec_cnt]
  2741 0000136E 75CB                    		jnz	short doc1	; loop while more sectors to read
  2742                                  doc3:					
  2743 00001370 C3                      		retn

  2894                                  ;; When Int13 is done with AH > 15h and DL >= 80h, they trash
  2895                                  ;; the byte at DS:74h, assuming that DS points to ROM_DATA.

  2898                                  ;; up for the IBM patch above. This code is also dynamically

  2905                                  					; this is used at configuration	time.

  2908                                  					; this code will be dynamically	relocated by msinit

  2946                                  
  2947                                  ; CMOS Clock setting support routines used by MSCLOCK.		
  2948                                  ; Warning!!! This code will be dynamically relocated by MSINIT.
  2949                                  
  2950                                  daycnt_to_day:	; proc far
  2951                                  
  2952                                  ; entry: [daycnt] = number of days since 1-1-80
  2953                                  ;
  2954                                  ; return: ch - century in bcd
  2955                                  ;	  cl - year in bcd
  2956                                  ;	  dh - month in bcd
  2957                                  ;	  dl - day in bcd
  2958                                  
  2959                                  		; 16/10/2022		
  2960                                  		push	word [cs:daycnt] ; save daycnt
  2961                                  		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 7305	; (365*20+(20/4))
  2962                                  					; # days from 1-1-1980 to 1-1-2000
  2963                                  		jnb	short century20
  2964                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_century], 19
  2965                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_year], 80
  2966                                  		jmp	short years
  2967                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2968                                  		
  2969                                  century20:				
  2970                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_century], 20
  2971                                  		mov	byte [cs:base_year], 0
  2972                                  		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 7305	; (365*20+(20/4))
  2973                                  					; adjust daycnt
  2974                                  years:					
  2975                                  		xor	dx, dx
  2976                                  		mov	ax, [cs:daycnt]
  2977                                  		mov	bx, 1461	; (366+365*3)
  2978                                  					; # of days in a Leap year block
  2979                                  		div	bx		; AX = # of leap block,	DX = daycnt
  2980                                  		mov	[cs:daycnt], dx	; save daycnt left
  2981                                  		mov	bl, 4
  2982                                  		mul	bl		; AX = # of years. Less	than 100
  2983                                  		add	[cs:base_year], al ; So, ah = 0. Adjust year
  2984                                  		inc	word [cs:daycnt]	; set daycnt to	1 base
  2985                                  		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 366	; daycnt=remainder of leap year	bk
  2986                                  		jbe	short leapyear	; within 366+355+355+355 days.
  2987                                  		inc	byte [cs:base_year]	; if daycnt <= 366, then leap year
  2988                                  		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 366	; else daycnt--, base_year++ ;
  2989                                  		mov	cx, 3		; And next three years are normal
  2990                                  regularyear:				
  2991                                  		cmp	word [cs:daycnt], 365	; for(i=1; i>3 or daycnt <=365;	i++)
  2992                                  		jbe	short yeardone	; {if (daycnt >	365)
  2993                                  		inc	byte [cs:base_year]	;   { daycnt -=	365
  2994                                  		sub	word [cs:daycnt], 365	;   }
  2995                                  		loop	regularyear	; }
  2996                                  					;
  2997                                  					; should never fall through loop
  2998                                  leapyear:				
  2999                                  		mov	byte [cs:month_tab+1], 29 ; leap year.
  3000                                  					; change month table.
  3001                                  yeardone:				
  3002                                  		xor	bx, bx
  3003                                  		xor	dx, dx
  3004                                  		mov	ax, [cs:daycnt]
  3005                                  		;mov	si, offset month_tab
  3006                                  		mov	si, month_tab	; 19/10/2022
  3007                                  		mov	cx, 12
  3008                                  months:					
  3009                                  		inc	bl
  3010                                  
  3011                                  		; !!! -- 16/10/2022 -- (if DS=CS, what for CS: prefixes are used !?)
  3012                                  		;mov	dl, [cs:si]
  3013                                  		; !!! -- 16/10/2022 -- (may be to keep code addrs as unchanged/fix!?)
  3014                                  		; ds = cs !? ((ofcourse ds must be same with cs here))
  3015                                  		;mov	dl, [si] ; 20/03/2019 (MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS, BIOSDATA:14C0h)
  3016                                  		;mov	dl, [si] ; 16/10/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS, BIOSDATA:14C0h)
  3017                                  		
  3018                                  		mov	dl, [si] ; ?	; mov dl, [cs:si]
  3019                                  		cmp	ax, dx		; cmp daycnt for each month till fit
  3020                                  					; dh=0
  3021                                  		jbe	short month_done
  3022                                  		inc	si		; next month
  3023                                  		sub	ax, dx		; adjust daycnt
  3024                                  		loop	months		;
  3025                                  					; should never fall through loop
  3026                                  month_done:				
  3027                                  		mov	byte [cs:month_tab+1], 28
  3028                                  					; restore month table value
  3029                                  		mov	dl, bl
  3030                                  		mov	dh, [cs:base_year]
  3031                                  		mov	cl, [cs:base_century] ; al=day,dl=month,dh=year,cl=cntry
  3032                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  3033                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; convert "day"	to bcd
  3034                                  					; dl = bcd day,	al = month
  3035                                  		xchg	dl, al
  3036                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  3037                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; dh = bcd month, al = year
  3038                                  		xchg	dh, al
  3039                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  3040                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; cl = bcd year, al = century
  3041                                  		xchg	cl, al
  3042                                  		call	far [cs:bintobcd]
  3043                                  		;call	cs:bintobcd	; ch = bcd century
  3044                                  		mov	ch, al
  3045                                  		pop	word [cs:daycnt] ; restore original value
  3046                                  		retf
  3047                                  
  3048                                  enddaycnttoday:	
  3049                                  
  3050                                  %endif
  3051

  3056                                  
  3057                                  bin_to_bcd:	; proc far		; real time clock support
  3058                                  
  3059                                  ;convert a binary input in al (less than 63h or 99 decimal)
  3060                                  ;into a bcd value in al. ah destroyed.	
  3061                                  		
  3062                                  		push	cx		
  3063                                  		aam			; al=high digit	bcd, ah=low digit bcd
  3064                                  		mov	cl, 4
  3065                                  		shl	ah, cl		; mov the high digit to	high nibble
  3066                                  		or	al, ah
  3067                                  		pop	cx
  3068                                  		retf
  3069                                  %endif

  3072                                  
  3073                                  ; the k09 requires the routines for reading the clock because of the suspend/
  3074                                  ; resume facility. the system clock needs to be reset after resume.
  3075                                  
  3076                                  ; the following routine is executed at resume time when the system
  3077                                  ; powered on after suspension. it reads the real time clock and
  3078                                  ; resets the system time and date, and then irets.
  3079                                  
  3080                                  ; warning!!! this code will be dynamically relocated by msinit.
  3081                                  
  3082                                  	; 08/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
  3083                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSDATA:183Eh
  3084                                  int_6Ch:
  3085 000013BF 0E                      		push	cs
  3086 000013C0 1F                      		pop	ds
  3087                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:inHMA], 0  
  3088 000013C1 803E[0D00]00            		cmp	byte [inHMA], 0
  3089 000013C6 7405                    		jz      short int6c
  3090 000013C8 BB[8707]                		mov     bx, EnsureA20On
  3091 000013CB FFD3                    		call    bx
  3092                                  int6c:					
  3093                                  		;push	cs
  3094                                  		;pop	ds
  3095 000013CD 8F06[AA06]              		pop	word [int6c_ret_addr]	; pop off return address
  3096 000013D1 8F06[AC06]              		pop	word [int6c_ret_addr+2]
  3097 000013D5 9D                      		popf
  3098 000013D6 E81300                  		call	read_real_date	; get the date from the clock
  3099 000013D9 FA                      		cli

  3439                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3440                                  ;									:
  3441                                  ;	System initialization						:
  3442                                  ;									:
  3443                                  ;	The entry conditions are established by the bootstrap		:
  3444                                  ;	loader and are considered unknown. The following jobs		:
  3445                                  ;	will be performed by this module:				:
  3446                                  ;									:
  3447                                  ;	1.	All device initialization is performed			:
  3448                                  ;	2.	A local stack is set up and DS:SI are set		:
  3449                                  ;		to point to an initialization table. Then		:
  3450                                  ;		an inter-segment call is made to the first		:
  3451                                  ;		byte of the dos 					:
  3452                                  ;	3.	Once the dos returns from this call the ds		:
  3453                                  ;		register has been set up to point to the start		:
  3454                                  ;		of free memory. The initialization will then		:
  3455                                  ;		load the command program into this area 		:
  3456                                  ;		beginning at 100 hex and transfer control to		:
  3457                                  ;		this program.						:
  3458                                  ;									:
  3459                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------

  3721                                  ;	entry point to call utility functions in Bios_Code. At this time,
  3722                                  ;	  we aren't doing any A20 switching. During MSINIT time Bios_Code
  3723                                  ;	  will not yet be moved to its final resting place, so we know
  3724                                  ;	  it'll be low.
  3725                                  ;
  3726                                  ;	to use this function, do a "push cs" and load bp with the offset of
  3727                                  ;	  the function you want to call in Bios_Code. This routine will
  3728                                  ;	  push the address of a retf in Bios_Code onto the stack which
  3729                                  ;	  will get executed when the utility function finishes. It will
  3730                                  ;	  then transfer control to Bios_Code:bp using a couple of pushes
  3731                                  ;	  and a retf
  3732                                  
  3733                                  ; 16/10/2022
  3734                                  ;BC_RETF equ bc_retf - DOSBIOSEG_2C7h
  3735                                  ; 09/12/2022
  3736                                  BC_RETF equ bc_retf
  3737                                  
  3738                                  addr_of_bcretf:	;dw 0C8h		; dw bc_retf
  3739                                  					; 2C7h:0C8h = 70h:2638h
  3740 00001609 [CA00]                  		dw BC_RETF

  3744                                  call_bios_code:	; proc far			
  3745 0000160B 2EFF36[0916]            		push	word [cs:addr_of_bcretf] 
  3746                                  					; set up near return to far return
  3747 00001610 2EFF36[B606]            		push	word [cs:cdev+2] ; push Bios_Code segment
  3748 00001615 55                      		push	bp		; save offset of utility function
  3749 00001616 CB                      		retf			; far jump to (DOS)BIOS code

  3766                                  init:		; 27/12/2018
  3767                                  		; MSDOS 6.0 (MSINIT.ASM)
  3768                                  		;=============================================================
  3769                                  		;
  3770                                  		; entry from boot sector. the register contents are:
  3771                                  		;
  3772                                  		;   dl = int 13 drive number we booted from
  3773                                  		;   ch = media byte
  3774                                  		;   bx = first data sector on disk.
  3775                                  		;   ax = first data sector (high)
  3776                                  		;   di = sectors/fat for the boot media.
  3777                                  
  3778                                  		; 07/04/2018
  3779                                  		;=============================================================
  3780                                  		; Retro DOS v2.0 - registers from FD Boot Sector 
  3781                                                  ; DL = [bsDriveNumber]
  3782                                  		; DH = [bsMedia]
  3783                                  		; AX = [bsSectors] ; Total sectors
  3784                                  		; DS = 0, SS = 0
  3785                                  		; BP = 7C00h
  3786                                  
  3787                                  		; 29/09/2023
  3788                                  		; SP = 0FFFEh (for Retro DOS v2&v3 boot sector) 
  3789                                  		;    = 07C00h (for MSDOS 5.0 boot sector)
  3790                                  		
  3791                                  ; 20/12/2022
  3792                                  ; Changing original MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS init code with Retro DOS v4.0 init code.		
  3793                                  %if 0

  3796                                  		push	ax
  3797                                  		xor	ax, ax
  3798                                  		mov	ds, ax
  3799                                  		pop	ax
  3800                                  %endif

  3965                                  ;									:
  3966                                  ;	System initialization						:
  3967                                  ;									:
  3968                                  ;	The entry conditions are established by the bootstrap		:
  3969                                  ;	loader and are considered unknown. The following jobs		:
  3970                                  ;	will be performed by this module:				:
  3971                                  ;									:
  3972                                  ;	1.	All device initialization is performed			:
  3973                                  ;	2.	A local stack is set up and DS:SI are set		:
  3974                                  ;		to point to an initialization table. Then		:
  3975                                  ;		an inter-segment call is made to the first		:
  3976                                  ;		byte of the dos 					:
  3977                                  ;	3.	Once the dos returns from this call the ds		:
  3978                                  ;		register has been set up to point to the start		:
  3979                                  ;		of free memory. The initialization will then		:
  3980                                  ;		load the command program into this area 		:
  3981                                  ;		beginning at 100 hex and transfer control to		:
  3982                                  ;		this program.						:
  3983                                  ;									:
  3984                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3985                                  		
  3986                                  		; 20/12/2022

  3988                                  		; Registers
  3989                                  		; ----------------------
  3990                                  		; DL = [bsDriveNumber]
  3991                                  		; DH = [bsMedia]
  3992                                  		; DS = 0, ES = 0, SS = 0

  3994                                  		; SP = 700h

  4106                                  ; we have to support a system that does not have any diskette
  4107                                  ; drives but only hardfiles. this system will ipl from the hardfile.
  4108                                  ; if the equipment flag bit 0 is 1, then the system has diskette drive(s).
  4109                                  ; otherwise, the system has only hardfiles.
  4110                                  ;
  4111                                  ; important thing is that still, for compatibility reason, the drive letter
  4112                                  ; for the hardfiles start from "c".  so, we still need to allocate dummy bds
  4113                                  ; drive a and drive b. at sysinit time, we are going to set cds table entry
  4114                                  ; of dpb pointer for these drives to 0, so any user attempt to access this
  4115                                  ; drives will get "invalid drive letter ..." message. we are going to
  4116                                  ; establish "fakefloppydrv" flag. ***sysinit module should call int 11h to
  4117                                  ; determine whether there are any diskette drivers in the system or not.!!!***
  4118                                  
  4119                                  ; check the register returned by the equipment determination interrupt
  4120                                  ; we have to handle the case of no diskettes in the system by faking
  4121                                  ; two dummy drives.

  4124                                  ; to do anything special.
  4125                                  ;

  4316                                  ;		; 20/12/2022

  4318                                  ;		; (https://stanislavs.org/helppc/int_15-c0.html)

  4320                                  ;		INT 15h, ah = C0h - Return System Configuration Parameters (PS/2 only)
  4321                                  ;
  4322                                  ;		on return:
  4323                                  ;		CF = 0 if successful
  4324                                  ;		   = 1 if error
  4325                                  ;		AH = when CF set, 80h for PC & PCjr, 86h for XT
  4326                                  ;	     	    (BIOS after 11/8/82) and AT (BIOS after 1/10/84)
  4327                                  ;
  4328                                  ;		ES:BX = pointer to system descriptor table in ROM of the format:
  4329                                  ;
  4330                                  ;		Offset Size	     Description
  4331                                  ;
  4332                                  ;		  00   word   length of descriptor (8 minimum)
  4333                                  ;		  02   byte   model byte (same as F000:FFFE, not reliable)
  4334                                  ;		  03   byte   secondary model byte
  4335                                  ;		  04   byte   BIOS revision level (zero based)

  5228                                  ; the bds chain to adjust the logical drive num (drive letter) with greater
  5229                                  ; than two diskette drives

  5231                                  ; new scheme:	if more than 2 disktte drives, first map the bds structure
  5232                                  ;		as usual and then rescan the bds chain to adjust the  drive
  5233                                  ;		letters. to do this, scan for disk drives and assign logical
  5234                                  ;		drive number starting from 2 and then rescan diskette drives
  5235                                  ;		and assign next to the last logical drive number of last disk
  5236                                  ;		drive to the 3rd and 4th diskette drives.

  5688                                  ;******************************************************************************
  5689                                  ; module name: remap
  5690                                  ;
  5691                                  ; descriptive name: all the code for himem that could be separated from msbio
  5692                                  ;
  5693                                  ; function:  remap the bds chain to adjusted logical drive numbers (drive
  5694                                  ;	     letters) if more than two diskette drives on the system.
  5695                                  ;
  5696                                  ;     scheme:  if more than 2 diskette drives, first map the bds structure
  5697                                  ;	       as usual and then rescan the bds chain to adjust the drive
  5698                                  ;	       letters. to do this, scan for disk drives and assign logical
  5699                                  ;	       drive number starting from 2 and then rescan diskette drives
  5700                                  ;	       and assign next to the last logical drive number of last disk
  5701                                  ;	       drive to the 3rd and 4th diskette drives.
  5702                                  
  5703                                  ; input:       none
  5704                                  ; exit:	drive letters have been remapped in bds chain
  5705                                  ; exit error:  none
  5706                                  ; called from: msinit
  5707                                  ;
  5708                                  ; notes:  this function  will be called only if more than 2 diskettes are
  5709                                  ;	  found in the system
  5710                                  ;	  this function assumes that there are no more than 26 drives assigned
  5711                                  ;	    this is guaranteed by the code that creates bdss for partitions
  5712                                  ;	  this function assumes that the first entries in the chain are
  5713                                  ;	   floppy drives, and all the rest are hard drives
  5714                                  ;	  will alter the boot drive if necessary to reflect remapping
  5715                                  ;
  5716                                  ;******************************************************************************
  5717                                  
  5718                                  ; 17/10/2022
  5719                                  ; 02/10/2022
  5720                                  
  5721                                  		; 15/12/2023 - Retro DOS v5.0 (PCDOS 7.1) IBMBIO.COM
  5722                                  		; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSDATA:2464h)
  5723                                  		; (MSDOS 6.22 IO.SYS - BIOSDATA:1D9Eh)
  5724                                  
  5725                                  remap:		; proc near
  5726                                  
  5727                                  		; 15/12/2023
  5728                                  		; ds = cs
  5729                                  		;mov	di, [cs:start_bds] ; get first bds
  5730 00001ACE 8B3E[1901]              		mov	di, [start_bds]
  5731                                  
  5732                                  ; search for 1st fixed disk physical drive num
  5733                                  
  5734                                  drive_loop:
  5735 00001AD2 807D0480                		cmp	byte [di+4], 80h ; [di+BDS.drivenum]
  5736                                  					; first	hard disk??
  5737 00001AD6 7409                    		jz	short fdrv_found ; yes,	continue
  5738 00001AD8 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  5739                                  					; get next bds,	assume segment
  5740 00001ADA 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, -1 ; 0FFFFh	; last bds?
  5741 00001ADD 75F3                    		jnz	short drive_loop ; loop	if not
  5742 00001ADF EB49                    		jmp	short rmap_exit	; yes, no hard drive on	system
  5743                                  
  5744                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  5745                                  ;first disk drive bds, now change the logical drive num to 2 and the subsequent
  5746                                  ;logical drive nums to 3, 4, 5 etc.
  5747                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  5748                                  
  5749                                  fdrv_found:
  5750 00001AE1 B002                    		mov	al, 2		; start	with logical drv num=2
  5751                                  fdrv_loop:
  5752 00001AE3 884505                  		mov	[di+5],	al	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  5753 00001AE6 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  5754                                  					; ds:di--> next	bds
  5755                                  		;inc	al		; set num for next drive
  5756                                  		; 18/12/2022
  5757 00001AE8 40                      		inc	ax
  5758 00001AE9 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh	; last hard drive ?
  5759 00001AEC 75F5                    		jnz	short fdrv_loop	; no - assign more disk drives
  5760                                  
  5761                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  5762                                  ; now, rescan and find bds of 3rd floppy drive and assign next drive letter
  5763                                  ; in al to 3rd. if the current drive letter is past z, then do not allocate
  5764                                  ; any more.
  5765                                  ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  5766                                  
  5767                                  		;mov	di, [cs:start_bds] ; [start_bds]
  5768                                  		; 15/12/2023
  5769 00001AEE 8B3E[1901]              		mov	di, [start_bds]	; get first bds
  5770 00001AF2 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  5771                                  					; ds:di-->bds2
  5772                                  		;mov	ah, [cs:dsktnum] ; get number of floppies to remap
  5773 00001AF4 8A26[2501]              		mov	ah, [dsktnum]
  5774 00001AF8 80EC02                  		sub	ah, 2		; adjust for a:	& b:
  5775                                  remap_loop1:
  5776 00001AFB 8B3D                    		mov	di, [di]	; [di+BDS.link]
  5777                                  					; set new num to next floppy
  5778 00001AFD 884505                  		mov	[di+5],	al	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  5779 00001B00 FEC0                    		inc	al		; new number for next floppy
  5780 00001B02 FECC                    		dec	ah		; count down extra floppies
  5781 00001B04 75F5                    		jnz	short remap_loop1
  5782                                  
  5783                                  ; now we've got to adjust the boot drive if we reassigned it
  5784                                  
  5785                                  		; 15/12/2023
  5786                                  		;mov	al, [cs:drvfat]
  5787 00001B06 A0[7E15]                		mov	al, [drvfat]
  5788 00001B09 3C02                    		cmp	al, 2		; is it	a: or b: ?
  5789 00001B0B 721D                    		jb	short rmap_exit
  5790                                  		;sub	al, [cs:dsktnum]
  5791 00001B0D 2A06[2501]              		sub	al, [dsktnum]	; is it one of the other floppies?
  5792 00001B11 7204                    		jb	short remap_boot_flop ;	brif so
  5793                                  
  5794                                  ; we've got to remap the boot hard drive
  5795                                  ; subtract the number of EXTRA floppies from it
  5796                                  
  5797 00001B13 0402                    		add	al, 2		; bootdrv -= (dsktnum-2)
  5798 00001B15 EB04                    		jmp	short remap_change_boot_drv
  5799                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  5800                                  
  5801                                  ; we've got to remap the boot floppy.
  5802                                  ; add the number of hard drive partitions to it
  5803                                  
  5804                                  remap_boot_flop:
  5805                                  		;add	al, [cs:drvmax]	; bootdrv += (drvmax-dsktnum)
  5806                                  		; 15/12/2023
  5807 00001B17 0206[7500]              		add	al, [drvmax]
  5808                                  remap_change_boot_drv:			
  5809                                  		;mov	[cs:drvfat], al ; alter msdos.sys load drive
  5810 00001B1B A2[7E15]                		mov	[drvfat], al
  5811 00001B1E FEC0                    		inc	al
  5812 00001B20 1E                      		push	ds
  5813 00001B21 BF2704                  		mov	di, SYSINITSEG	; 46Dh
  5814                                  		;mov	di, 544h	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM
  5815                                  		;;mov	di, 46Dh	; SYSINIT segment
  5816 00001B24 8EDF                    		mov	ds, di
  5817 00001B26 A2[9802]                		mov	[DEFAULTDRIVE], al
  5818                                  		;mov	ds:296h, al	; [SYSINIT+DEFAULT_DRIVE]
  5819                                  					; pass it to sysinit as	well
  5820 00001B29 1F                      		pop	ds ; ds = cs
  5821                                  rmap_exit:
  5822 00001B2A C3                      		retn
  5823

  5827                                  ; 02/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (MSDOS 5.0 -actual-)
  5828                                  ; 28/12/2018 - Retro DOS v4.0 (MSDOS 6.21 -draft-)
  5829                                  ; 02/06/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0 (MSDOS 3.3)

  5831                                  ;**************************************************
  5832                                  ; getboot - get the boot sector for a hard disk
  5833                                  ;
  5834                                  ; Reads the boot sector from a specified drive into
  5835                                  ; a buffer at the top of memory.
  5836                                  ;
  5837                                  ; dl = int13 drive number to read boot sector for
  5838                                  ;**************************************************
  5839                                  
  5840                                  ; 17/10/2022
  5841                                  bootbias equ 200h
  5842                                  
  5843                                  getboot:	; proc near
  5844                                  
  5845                                  		; 15/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 
  5846                                  		;	 (Modified MSDOS 6.22) IO.SYS
  5847                                  		; ds = cs
  5848                                  		
  5849                                  		; 08/04/2018
  5850                                  		; Retro DOS v2.0 (IBMBIO.COM, IBMDOS 2.1)
  5851                                  		; 28/03/2018 - MSDOS 6.0 - MSINIT.ASM, 1991
  5852                                  		; 02/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0
  5853                                  		;	      (disassembled IO.SYS code of MSDOS 5.0)
  5854                                  
  5855                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:init_bootseg] ; 17/10/2022
  5856                                  		; 15/12/2023
  5857 00001B2B A1[8115]                		mov	ax, [init_bootseg]
  5858 00001B2E 8EC0                    		mov	es, ax
  5859                                  
  5860                                  		; 17/10/2022
  5861 00001B30 BB0002                  		mov	bx, bootbias ; 200h
  5862                                  		;mov	bx, 200h	; bootbias
  5863                                  					; load BX, ES:BX is where sector goes
  5864 00001B33 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h
  5865 00001B36 30F6                    		xor	dh, dh
  5866 00001B38 B90100                  		mov	cx, 1
  5867 00001B3B CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - READ SECTORS INTO MEMORY
  5868                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
  5869                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
  5870                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read
  5871 00001B3D 7209                    		jb	short erret
  5872                                  		; 17/10/2022
  5873 00001B3F 26813EFE0355AA          		cmp	word [es:bootbias+1FEh], 0AA55h
  5874                                  		;cmp	word ptr es:3FEh, 0AA55h ; [es:bootbias+1FEh]
  5875                                  					; Dave Litton magic word?
  5876 00001B46 7401                    		jz	short norm_ret	; yes
  5877                                  erret:
  5878 00001B48 F9                      		stc
  5879                                  norm_ret:
  5880 00001B49 C3                      		retn
  5881                                  
  5882                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  5883                                  		
  5884                                  		; 16/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22)
  5885                                  
  5886                                  chk_partition_type:
  5887                                  		; 16/12/2023
  5888 00001B4A 268A07                  		mov	al, [es:bx]	; partition type
  5889                                  
  5890                                  		; see if partitiontype == 1, 4, 6
  5891 00001B4D 3C01                    		cmp	al, 1		; FAT12
  5892 00001B4F 7406                    		je	short chk_ptype_retn
  5893 00001B51 3C04                    		cmp	al, 4		; FAT16 CHS (<= 32MB)
  5894 00001B53 7402                    		je	short chk_ptype_retn
  5895 00001B55 3C06                    		cmp	al, 6		; FAT16 BIG CHS (> 32MB)
  5896                                  chk_ptype_retn:
  5897                                  		; zf = 1 -> primary DOS partition
  5898                                  		; zf = 0 -> not a primary DOS partition
  5899 00001B57 C3                      		retn
