  5902                                  
  5903                                  ; 28/12/2018 - Retro DOS v4.0 
  5904                                  
  5905                                  ;***************************************************************************
  5906                                  ;   sethard - generate bpb for a variable sized hard file. ibm has a
  5907                                  ;   partitioned hard file; we must read physical sector 0 to determine where
  5908                                  ;   our own logical sectors start. we also read in our boot sector to
  5909                                  ;   determine version number
  5910                                  ;
  5911                                  ;   inputs:	dl is rom drive number (80...)
  5912                                  ;		bh is partition number (0....) 
  5913                                  ;		ds:di points to bds
  5914                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear -> bpb is filled in
  5915                                  ;		carry set   -> bpb is left uninitialized due to error
  5916                                  ;	trashes (at least) si, cx
  5917                                  ;	MUST PRESERVE ES:!!!!
  5918                                  ;***************************************************************************
  5919                                  
  5920                                  sethard:	; proc near
  5921                                  		; 16/12/2023
  5922                                  		; 12/08/2023
  5923                                  		; ds = cs = BIOSDATA
  5924 00001B58 57                      		push	di
  5925 00001B59 53                      		push	bx
  5926                                  		;push	ds  ; ds = cs = BIOSDATA ; 14/08/2023
  5927 00001B5A 06                      		push	es
  5928 00001B5B 885D05                  		mov	[di+5],	bl	; [di+BDS.drivelet]
  5929 00001B5E 885504                  		mov	[di+4],	dl	; [di+BDS.drivenum]
  5930 00001B61 804D2301                		or	byte [di+23h], 1 ; [di+BDS.flags]
  5931                                  					; fnon_removable
  5932 00001B65 C6452205                		mov	byte [di+22h], 5 ; [di+BDS.formfactor]
  5933                                  					; ffHardFile
  5934 00001B69 C606[8015]00            		mov	byte [fbigfat], 0 ; assume 12 bit FAT
  5935 00001B6E 88FE                    		mov	dh, bh		; partition number
  5936 00001B70 52                      		push	dx
  5937 00001B71 B408                    		mov	ah, 8
  5938 00001B73 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - DISK -	GET CURRENT DRIVE PARAMETERS (XT,AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  5939                                  					; DL = drive number
  5940                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status code, BL	= drive	type
  5941                                  					; DL = number of consecutive drives
  5942                                  					; DH = maximum value for head number, ES:DI -> drive parameter
  5943 00001B75 FEC6                    		inc	dh
  5944 00001B77 887515                  		mov	[di+15h], dh	; [di+BDS.heads] ; get number of heads
  5945 00001B7A 5A                      		pop	dx
  5946 00001B7B 7249                    		jb	short setret	; error	if no hard disk
  5947 00001B7D 80E13F                  		and	cl, 3Fh
  5948 00001B80 884D13                  		mov	[di+13h], cl	; [di+BDS.secpertrack]
  5949 00001B83 52                      		push	dx		; save partition number
  5950 00001B84 E8A4FF                  		call	getboot
  5951 00001B87 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore partition number
  5952 00001B88 723C                    		jb	short setret
  5953 00001B8A BBC203                  		mov	bx, 3C2h	; 1C2h+bootbias
  5954                                  
  5955                                  ; The first 'active' partition is 00, the second is 01....
  5956                                  ;   then the remainder of the 'primary' but non-active partitions
  5957                                  
  5958                                  act_part:
  5959 00001B8D 26F647FC80              		test	byte [es:bx-4], 80h ; is the partition active?
  5960 00001B92 740B                    		jz	short no_act	; no
  5961                                  ; 16/12/2023
  5962                                  %if 0
  5963                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 1 ; reject if partitiontype != 1, 4 or 6
  5964                                  		jz	short got_good_act
  5965                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 4
  5966                                  		jz	short got_good_act
  5967                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 6
  5968                                  		jnz	short no_act
  5969                                  %endif
  5970                                  		; 16/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22)
  5971                                  		; check if it is a primary dos partition
  5972                                  
  5973 00001B94 E8B3FF                  		call	chk_partition_type
  5974 00001B97 7506                    		jne	short no_act
  5975                                  
  5976                                  got_good_act:
  5977 00001B99 08F6                    		or	dh, dh		; is this our target partition #?
  5978 00001B9B 742D                    		jz	short set2	; WE GOT THE ONE WANTED!!
  5979 00001B9D FECE                    		dec	dh		; count	down
  5980                                  no_act:
  5981 00001B9F 83C310                  		add	bx, 16
  5982 00001BA2 81FB0204                		cmp	bx, 402h	; 202h+bootbias
  5983                                  					; last entry done?
  5984 00001BA6 75E5                    		jnz	short act_part	; no, process next entry
  5985 00001BA8 BBC203                  		mov	bx, 3C2h	; 1C2h+bootbias
  5986                                  					; restore original value of bx
  5987                                  
  5988                                  ; Now scan the non-active partitions
  5989                                  
  5990                                  get_primary:				
  5991 00001BAB 26F647FC80              		test	byte [es:bx-4], 80h
  5992 00001BB0 750B                    		jnz	short not_prim	; we've already scanned
  5993                                  					; the ACTIVE ones
  5994                                  ; 16/12/2023
  5995                                  %if 0
  5996                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 1 ; see if partitiontype == 1, 4 or 6
  5997                                  		jz	short got_prim
  5998                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 4
  5999                                  		jz	short got_prim
  6000                                  		cmp	byte [es:bx], 6
  6001                                  		jnz	short not_prim
  6002                                  %endif
  6003                                  		; 16/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22)
  6004                                  		; check if it is a primary dos partition
  6005                                  
  6006 00001BB2 E895FF                  		call	chk_partition_type
  6007 00001BB5 7506                    		jne	short not_prim
  6008                                  
  6009                                  got_prim:
  6010 00001BB7 08F6                    		or	dh, dh		; is this our target partition?
  6011 00001BB9 740F                    		jz	short set2
  6012 00001BBB FECE                    		dec	dh
  6013                                  not_prim:
  6014 00001BBD 83C310                  		add	bx, 16
  6015 00001BC0 81FB0204                		cmp	bx, 402h	; 202h+bootbias
  6016 00001BC4 75E5                    		jnz	short get_primary ; loop till we've gone through table
  6017                                  setret:					
  6018 00001BC6 F9                      		stc			; error	return
  6019 00001BC7 E98502                  		jmp	ret_hard_err
  6020                                  
  6021                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6022                                  
  6023                                  ;  until we get the real logical boot record and get the bpb,
  6024                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS will be used instead of BDS_BPB.BPB_TOTALSECTORS
  6025                                  ;  for the convenience of the computation.
  6026                                  ;
  6027                                  ;  at the end of this procedure, if a bpb information is gotten from
  6028                                  ;  the valid boot record, then we are going to use those bpb information
  6029                                  ;  without change.
  6030                                  ;
  6031                                  ;  otherwise, if (hidden sectors + total sectors) <= a word, then we will move
  6032                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS (low) to BDS_BPB.BPB_TOTALSECTORS and zero out
  6033                                  ;  BDS_BPB.BPB_BIGTOTALSECTORS entry to make it a conventional bpb format.
  6034                                  
  6035                                  set2:
  6036                                  		; 12/08/2023
  6037                                  		; ds = cs = BIOSDATA segment (0070h)
  6038 00001BCA 8816[8315]              		mov	[rom_drv_num], dl
  6039                                  		;mov	[cs:rom_drv_num], dl
  6040                                  			; save the rom bios drive number we are handling now.
  6041 00001BCE 268B4704                		mov	ax, [es:bx+4]	; hidden sectors (start	sector)
  6042 00001BD2 268B5706                		mov	dx, [es:bx+6]
  6043                                  
  6044                                  ; decrement the sector count by 1 to make it zero based. exactly 64k
  6045                                  ; sectors should be allowed	
  6046                                  
  6047 00001BD6 83E801                  		sub	ax, 1
  6048 00001BD9 83DA00                  		sbb	dx, 0
  6049 00001BDC 26034708                		add	ax, [es:bx+8]	; sectors in partition
  6050 00001BE0 2613570A                		adc	dx, [es:bx+10]
  6051 00001BE4 7305                    		jnc	short okdrive
  6052 00001BE6 800E[8015]80            		or	byte [fbigfat], 80h ; ftoobig
  6053                                  okdrive:
  6054 00001BEB 268B4704                		mov	ax, [es:bx+4]
  6055 00001BEF 894517                  		mov	[di+17h], ax	; [di+BDS.hiddensecs]
  6056                                  					; BPB_HIDDENSECTORS = p->partitionbegin
  6057 00001BF2 268B4706                		mov	ax, [es:bx+6]

  7214                                  ; domini **********************************************************************
  7215                                  ;
  7216                                  ;mini disk initialization routine. called right after dohard
  7217                                  ;modified for >2 hardfile support
  7218                                  ;
  7219                                  ; **cs=ds=es=datagrp
  7220                                  ;
  7221                                  ; **domini will search for every extended partition in the system, and
  7222                                  ;   initialize it.
  7223                                  ;
  7224                                  ; **bdsm stands for bds table for mini disk and located right after the label
  7225                                  ;   end96tpi. end_of_bdsm will have the offset value of the ending
  7226                                  ;   address of bdsm table.
  7227                                  ;
  7228                                  ; **bdsm is the same as usual bds structure except that tim_lo, tim_hi entries
  7229                                  ;   are overlapped and used to identify mini disk and the number of hidden_trks.
  7230                                  ;   right now, they are called as ismini, hidden_trks respectively.
  7231                                  ;
  7232                                  ; **domini will use the same routine in sethard routine after label set2 to
  7233                                  ;   save coding.
  7234                                  ;
  7235                                  ; **drvmax determined in dohard routine will be used for the next
  7236                                  ;   available logical mini disk drive number.
  7237                                  ;
  7238                                  ; input: drvmax, dskdrvs
  7239                                  ;
  7240                                  ; output: minidisk installed. bdsm table established and installed to bds.
  7241                                  ;	  end_of_bdsm - ending offset address of bdsm.
  7242                                  ;
  7243                                  ; called modules:
  7244                                  ;		  getboot
  7245                                  ;		  find_mini_partition (new), xinstall_bds (new), M038
  7246                                  ;
  7247                                  ;		  setmini (new, it will use set2 routine)
  7248                                  ;
  7249                                  ; variables used: end_of_bdsm

  7537                                  cmos_clock_read:	
  7538 0000208E 50                      		push	ax
  7539 0000208F 51                      		push	cx
  7540 00002090 52                      		push	dx
  7541 00002091 55                      		push	bp
  7542 00002092 31ED                    		xor	bp, bp
  7543                                  loop_clock:
  7544 00002094 31C9                    		xor	cx, cx
  7545 00002096 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
  7546 00002098 B402                    		mov	ah, 2
  7547 0000209A CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- READ REAL TIME CLOCK (AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  7548                                  					; Return: CH = hours in	BCD
  7549                                  					; CL = minutes in BCD
  7550                                  					; DH = seconds in BCD
  7551 0000209C 83F900                  		cmp	cx, 0
  7552 0000209F 7512                    		jnz	short clock_present
  7553 000020A1 83FA00                  		cmp	dx, 0
  7554 000020A4 750D                    		jnz	short clock_present
  7555 000020A6 83FD01                  		cmp	bp, 1		; read again after a slight delay, in case clock
  7556 000020A9 741B                    		jz	short no_readdate ; was	at zero	setting.
  7557 000020AB 45                      		inc	bp		; only perform delay once.
  7558 000020AC B90040                  		mov	cx, 4000h	; 16384
  7559                                  delay:
  7560 000020AF E2FE                    		loop	delay
  7561 000020B1 EBE1                    		jmp	short loop_clock
  7562                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7563                                  
  7564                                  clock_present:
  7565                                  		;mov	byte [cs:havecmosclock], 1 ; set the flag for cmos clock
  7566                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7567                                  		; ds = cs
  7568 000020B3 C606[EC04]01            		mov	byte [havecmosclock], 1 ; set the flag for cmos clock
  7569                                  		
  7570 000020B8 E81000                  		call	cmosck		; reset	cmos clock rate	that may be
  7571                                  					; possibly destroyed by	cp dos and
  7572                                  					; post routine did not restore that.
  7573 000020BB 56                      		push	si
  7574 000020BC E82DF3                  		call	read_real_date	; read real-time clock for date
  7575 000020BF FA                      		cli
  7576                                  		;mov	ds:daycnt, si	; set system date
  7577 000020C0 8936[E904]              		mov	[daycnt], si
  7578 000020C4 FB                      		sti
  7579 000020C5 5E                      		pop	si
  7580                                  no_readdate:
  7581 000020C6 5D                      		pop	bp
  7582 000020C7 5A                      		pop	dx
  7583 000020C8 59                      		pop	cx
  7584 000020C9 58                      		pop	ax
  7585                                  cmosck9:	; 19/12/2023
  7586 000020CA C3                      		retn
  7587                                  
  7588                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7589                                  
  7590                                  ; the following code is written by jack gulley in engineering group.
  7591                                  ; cp dos (CP/DOS, OS/2) is changing cmos clock rate for its own purposes
  7592                                  ; and if the use cold boot the system to use pc dos while running cp dos,
  7593                                  ; the cmos clock rate are still slow which slow down disk operations
  7594                                  ; of pc dos which uses cmos clock. pc dos is put this code in msinit
  7595                                  ; to fix this problem at the request of cp dos.
  7596                                  ;
  7597                                  ; the program is modified to be run on msinit. equates are defined
  7598                                  ; in cmosequ.inc. this program will be called by cmos_clock_read procedure.
  7599                                  ;
  7600                                  ;  the following code cmosck is used to insure that the cmos has not
  7601                                  ;	had its rate controls left in an invalid state on older at's.
  7602                                  ;
  7603                                  ;	it checks for an at model byte "fc" with a submodel type of
  7604                                  ;	00, 01, 02, 03 or 06 and resets the periodic interrupt rate
  7605                                  ;	bits in case post has not done it. this initialization routine
  7606                                  ;	is only needed once when dos loads. it should be run as soon
  7607                                  ;	as possible to prevent slow diskette access.
  7608                                  ;
  7609                                  ;	this code exposes one to dos clearing cmos setup done by a
  7610                                  ;	resident program that hides and re-boots the system.
  7611                                  
  7612                                  cmosck:					; check and reset rtc rate bits
  7613                                  
  7614                                  ;model byte and submodel byte were already determined in msinit.
  7615                                  
  7616                                  	; 16/06/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
  7617                                  	; 19/03/2018 (Model: 0FCh, Sub Model: 01h, REF: AMIBIOS Prog. Guide)
  7618                                  
  7619                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7620                                  		; ds = cs
  7621                                  		;push	ax ; not necessary ; 19/12/2023
  7622                                  		;
  7623 000020CB 803E[2D06]FC            		cmp	byte [model_byte], 0FCh
  7624                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:model_byte], 0FCh
  7625 000020D0 75F8                    		jnz	short cmosck9	; Exit if not an AT model
  7626 000020D2 803E[2E06]06            		cmp	byte [secondary_model_byte], 6 ; 21/04/2024
  7627                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:secondary_model_byte], 6
  7628                                  					; Is it 06 for the industral AT ?
  7629 000020D7 7407                    		jz	short cmosck4	; Go reset CMOS periodic rate if 06
  7630 000020D9 803E[2E06]04            		cmp	byte [secondary_model_byte], 4
  7631                                  		;cmp	byte [cs:secondary_model_byte], 4
  7632                                  					; Is it 00, 01, 02, or 03 ?
  7633 000020DE 73EA                    		jnb	short cmosck9	; EXIT if problem fixed by POST
  7634                                  					; Also,Secondary_model_byte = 0
  7635                                  					;   when AH=0C0h, int 15h failed.
  7636                                  					;	RESET THE CMOS PERIODIC RATE
  7637                                  					;  Model=FC submodel=00,01,02,03 or 06
  7638                                  cmosck4:
  7639 000020E0 B08A                    		mov	al, 8Ah		; cmos_reg_a|nmi
  7640                                  					; NMI disabled on return
  7641 000020E2 B426                    		mov	ah, 26h		; 00100110b
  7642                                  					; Set divider & rate selection
  7643 000020E4 E80B00                  		call	cmos_write
  7644 000020E7 B08B                    		mov	al, 8Bh		; cmos_reg_b|nmi
  7645                                  					; NMI disabled on return
  7646 000020E9 E82000                  		call	cmos_read
  7647 000020EC 2407                    		and	al, 7		; 00000111b
  7648                                  					; clear SET,PIE,AIE,UIE,SQWE
  7649 000020EE 88C4                    		mov	ah, al
  7650 000020F0 B00B                    		mov	al, 0Bh		; cmos_reg_b
  7651                                  					; NMI enabled on return
  7652                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7653                                  		;call	cmos_write
  7654                                  ;cmosck9:
  7655                                  		;pop	ax ; 19/12/2023
  7656                                  		;retn
  7657                                  
  7658                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7659                                  		;jmp	short cmos_write
  7660                                  
  7661                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  7662                                  
  7663                                  ;--- cmos_write ----------------------------------------------------------------
  7664                                  ;		write byte to cmos system clock configuration table	       :
  7665                                  ;									       :
  7666                                  ; input: (al)=	cmos table address to be written to			       :
  7667                                  ;		bit    7 = 0 for nmi enabled and 1 for nmi disabled on exit    :
  7668                                  ;		bits 6-0 = address of table location to write		       :
  7669                                  ;	 (ah)=	new value to be placed in the addressed table location	       :
  7670                                  ;									       :
  7671                                  ; output:	value in (ah) placed in location (al) with nmi left disabled   :
  7672                                  ;		if bit 7 of (al) is on. during the cmos update both nmi and    :
  7673                                  ;		normal interrupts are disabled to protect cmos data integrity. :
  7674                                  ;		the cmos address register is pointed to a default value and    :
  7675                                  ;		the interrupt flag restored to the entry state on return.      :
  7676                                  ;		only the cmos location and the nmi state is changed.	       :
  7677                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7678                                  
  7679                                  cmos_write:				; write (ah) to location (al)
  7680 000020F2 9C                      		pushf			;
  7681 000020F3 50                      		push	ax		; save work register values
  7682 000020F4 FA                      		cli
  7683 000020F5 50                      		push	ax		; save user nmi	state
  7684 000020F6 0C80                    		or	al, 80h		; disable nmi for us
  7685 000020F8 E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  7686                                  					; RTC Seconds
  7687 000020FA 90                      		nop
  7688 000020FB 88E0                    		mov	al, ah
  7689 000020FD E671                    		out	71h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  7690 000020FF 58                      		pop	ax		; get user nmi
  7691 00002100 2480                    		and	al, 80h
  7692 00002102 0C0F                    		or	al, 0Fh
  7693 00002104 E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  7694                                  					; RTC Seconds
  7695 00002106 90                      		nop
  7696 00002107 E471                    		in	al, 71h		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  7697 00002109 58                      		pop	ax		; restore work registers
  7698                                  
  7699                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7700                                  		;push	cs		; *place code segment in stack and
  7701                                  		;call	cmos_popf	; *handle popf for b- level 80286
  7702                                  		;retn
  7703 0000210A EB18                    		jmp	short cmos_rw_popf
  7704                                  
  7705                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  7706                                  
  7707                                  ;--- CMOS_READ -----------------------------------------------------------------
  7708                                  ;		read byte from cmos system clock configuration table	       :
  7709                                  ;									       :
  7710                                  ; input: (al)=	cmos table address to be read				       :
  7711                                  ;		bit    7 = 0 for nmi enabled and 1 for nmi disabled on exit    :
  7712                                  ;		bits 6-0 = address of table location to read		       :
  7713                                  ;									       :
  7714                                  ; output: (al)	value at location (al) moved into (al). if bit 7 of (al) was   :
  7715                                  ;		on then nmi left disabled. during the cmos read both nmi and  :
  7716                                  ;		normal interrupts are disabled to protect cmos data integrity. :
  7717                                  ;		the cmos address register is pointed to a default value and    :
  7718                                  ;		the interrupt flag restored to the entry state on return.      :
  7719                                  ;		only the (al) register and the nmi state is changed.	       :
  7720                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7721                                  
  7722                                  cmos_read:				; read location (al) into (al)
  7723 0000210C 9C                      		pushf
  7724 0000210D FA                      		cli
  7725 0000210E 53                      		push	bx
  7726                                  		;push	ax ; *		; AL = cmos table address to be read
  7727                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7728 0000210F 89C3                    		mov	bx, ax ; * ; input
  7729 00002111 0C80                    		or	al, 80h
  7730 00002113 E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  7731                                  					; RTC Seconds
  7732 00002115 90                      		nop			; (undocumented delay needed)
  7733 00002116 E471                    		in	al, 71h		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  7734                                  		
  7735                                  		;mov	bx, ax ; output
  7736                                  		;pop	ax ; * ; input
  7737                                  
  7738                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7739                                  		; al = output, bl = input
  7740 00002118 93                      		xchg	ax, bx ; *
  7741                                  		; bl = output, al = input
  7742                                  	
  7743 00002119 2480                    		and	al, 80h
  7744 0000211B 0C0F                    		or	al, 0Fh
  7745 0000211D E670                    		out	70h, al		; CMOS Memory/RTC Index	Register:
  7746                                  					; RTC Seconds
  7747 0000211F 90                      		nop
  7748 00002120 E471                    		in	al, 71h		; CMOS Memory/RTC Data Register
  7749                                  		;mov	ax, bx ; * ; output
  7750                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7751 00002122 93                      		xchg	ax, bx
  7752 00002123 5B                      		pop	bx
  7753                                  
  7754                                  		; 19/12/2023
  7755                                  cmos_rw_popf:
  7756 00002124 0E                      		push	cs		; *place code segment in stack and
  7757 00002125 E80100                  		call	cmos_popf	; *handle popf for b- level 80286
  7758 00002128 C3                      		retn			; return with flags restored
  7759                                  
  7760                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7761                                  
  7762                                  cmos_popf:				
  7763 00002129 CF                      		iret			; popf for level b- parts
  7764                                  					; return far and restore flags
  7765

  7771                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7772                                  ; MSINIT.ASM (MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
  7773                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7774                                  ; The following routines provide support for reading in the file MSDOS.SYS.
  7775                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7776                                  
  7777                                  ; 15/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
  7778                                  ;
  7779                                  ; (For Retro DOS, 'IO.SYS' and 'MSDOS.SYS' are already loaded together
  7780                                  ;  at once -as single kernel file- by the Retro DOS boot sector code.
  7781                                  ;  So, following disk reads -MSDOS.SYS loading- is not needed!
  7782                                  ;  Only needing is to move MSDOS Kernel to it's final memory location.) 
  7783                                  
  7784                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  7785                                  
  7786                                  ; GetClus, read in a cluster at a specified address
  7787                                  ;
  7788                                  ;  bx = cluster to read
  7789                                  ;  cx = sectors per cluster
  7790                                  ;  es:di = load location
  7791                                  
  7792                                  ; 17/10/2022
  7793                                  ;DISKRD equ diskrd - DOSBIOSEG_2C7h	; (8E5h for MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
  7794                                  ; 09/12/2022
  7795                                  DISKRD equ diskrd
  7796                                  
  7797                                  		; 17/10/2022
  7798                                  getclus:
  7799                                  		; 14/12/2023
  7800                                  		; 13/12/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.22 IO.SYS)
  7801                                  		; ds = cs
  7802                                  
  7803                                  		push	cx
  7804                                  		push	di
  7805                                  		;mov	[cs:doscnt], cx
  7806                                  		mov	[doscnt], cx ; 13/12/2023
  7807                                  		mov	ax, bx
  7808                                  		dec	ax
  7809                                  		dec	ax
  7810                                  		mul	cx		; convert to logical sector
  7811                                  					; dx:ax	= matching logical sector number
  7812                                  					;	  starting from the data sector
  7813                                  		;add	ax, [cs:bios_l]
  7814                                  		;adc	dx, [cs:bios_h]	; dx:ax	= first	logical	sector to read
  7815                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7816                                  		add	ax, [bios_l]
  7817                                  		adc	dx, [bios_h]	; dx:ax	= first	logical	sector to read
  7818                                  unpack:
  7819                                  		push	ds ; ds = cs ; 13/12/2023
  7820                                  		push	dx ; * ; 13/12/2023
  7821                                  		push	ax
  7822                                  		push	bx
  7823                                  		;mov	si, [cs:fatloc]
  7824                                  		mov	si, [fatloc] ; 13/12/2023
  7825                                  		mov	ds, si
  7826                                  		mov	si, bx		; next cluster
  7827                                  		test	byte [cs:fbigfat], 40h	; fbig
  7828                                  					; 16 bit fat?
  7829                                  		jnz	short unpack16	; yes
  7830                                  		shr	si, 1		; 12 bit fat. si=si/2
  7831                                  					; si = clus + clus/2
  7832                                  		add	si, bx		;
  7833                                  					; (si =	byte offset of the cluster in the FAT)
  7834                                  		;push	dx ; 13/12/2023
  7835                                  		xor	dx, dx
  7836                                  		; 12/12/2023
  7837                                  		; ds = FAT buffer segment
  7838                                  		call	get_fat_sector
  7839                                  		;pop	dx ; 12/12/2023
  7840                                  
  7841                                  		mov	ax, [bx]	; save it into ax
  7842                                  		jnz	short even_odd	; if not a splitted fat, check even-odd.
  7843                                  		; 25/06/2023
  7844                                  		;mov	al, [bx]	; splitted fat
  7845                                  
  7846                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7847                                  		;mov	[cs:temp_cluster], al
  7848                                  		push	ax ; **	; al = low 8 bits of 12 bits cluster number
  7849                                  
  7850                                  		inc	si		; (next	byte)
  7851                                  
  7852                                  		;push	dx ; 13/12/2023
  7853                                  		xor	dx, dx
  7854                                  		call	get_fat_sector
  7855                                  		;pop	dx ; 13/12/2023
  7856                                  
  7857                                  		;mov	al, ds:0
  7858                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7859                                  		; ds = FAT buffer segment
  7860                                  		;mov	al, [0] ; 19/10/2022
  7861                                  		;mov	[cs:temp_cluster+1], al
  7862                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:temp_cluster]
  7863                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7864                                  		;mov	al, [cs:temp_cluster]
  7865                                  		pop	ax  ; ** ; al = low 8 bits of 12 bits cluster number
  7866                                  		mov	ah, [0] ; high 4 bits (bits 7 to 11) of 12 bits cluster num
  7867                                  even_odd:
  7868                                  		pop	bx		; restore old fat entry	value
  7869                                  		push	bx		; save it right	away.
  7870                                  		shr	bx, 1		; was it even or odd?
  7871                                  		jnb	short havclus	; it was even.
  7872                                  		shr	ax, 1		; odd. massage fat value and keep
  7873                                  					; the highest 12 bits.
  7874                                  		shr	ax, 1
  7875                                  		shr	ax, 1
  7876                                  		shr	ax, 1
  7877                                  havclus:
  7878                                  		mov	bx, ax		; now bx = new fat entry.
  7879                                  		and	bx, 0FFFh	; keep low 12 bits.
  7880                                  		jmp	short unpackx
  7881                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7882                                  
  7883                                  unpack16:
  7884                                  		;push	dx	; 13/12/2023	
  7885                                  		xor	dx, dx ; 0
  7886                                  		shl	si, 1		; extend to 32 bit offset
  7887                                  		;adc	dx, 0
  7888                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7889                                  		rcl	dx, 1
  7890                                  
  7891                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7892                                  		; ds = FAT buffer segment
  7893                                  		call	get_fat_sector
  7894                                  		;pop	dx	; 13/12/2023
  7895                                  		mov	bx, [bx]	;
  7896                                  					; bx = new fat entry.
  7897                                  unpackx:
  7898                                  		pop	si		; restore old bx value into si
  7899                                  		pop	ax		; restore logical sector (low)
  7900                                  		pop	dx ; * ; 13/12/2023
  7901                                  		pop	ds
  7902                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7903                                  		; (this is a fast kernel loading method by the MSDOS programmer)
  7904                                  		; ((consequtive clusters --> consequtive sectors))
  7905                                  		; ds = cs
  7906                                  		sub	si, bx
  7907                                  		cmp	si, -1		; one apart? (consequtive?)
  7908                                  					; (current = previous+1)
  7909                                  		jnz	short getcl2	; no, read [doscnt] sectors 
  7910                                  		;add	[cs:doscnt], cx
  7911                                  		add	[doscnt], cx ; 13/12/2023 ; add to read count
  7912                                  		jmp	short unpack
  7913                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  7914                                  
  7915                                  getcl2:
  7916                                  		push	bx
  7917                                  		push	dx		; sector to read (high)
  7918                                  		push	ax		; sector to read (low)
  7919                                  
  7920                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7921                                  		; ds = cs
  7922                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:drvfat]	; get drive and	fat spec
  7923                                  		;mov	cx, [cs:doscnt]
  7924                                  		mov	ax, [drvfat]	; get drive and	fat spec
  7925                                  		mov	cx, [doscnt]
  7926                                  
  7927                                  		pop	dx		; sector to read for diskrd (low)
  7928                                  		;pop	word [cs:start_sec_h]
  7929                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7930                                  		pop	word [start_sec_h]
  7931                                  					; sector to read for diskrd (high)
  7932                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7933                                  		; ds = cs
  7934                                  		;push	ds
  7935                                  		;push	cs
  7936                                  		;pop	ds
  7937                                  
  7938                                  		push	cs		; simulate far call
  7939                                  		; 17/10/2022
  7940                                  		mov	bp, DISKRD	; 8E5h
  7941                                  		;mov	bp, 8E5h	; offset diskrd
  7942                                  					; 2C7h:8E5h = 70h:2E55h
  7943                                  		call	call_bios_code	; read the clusters
  7944                                  		
  7945                                  		;pop	ds
  7946                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7947                                  		; ds = cs
  7948                                  		pop	bx
  7949                                  		pop	di
  7950                                  
  7951                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:doscnt]	; get number of	sectors	read
  7952                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7953                                  		mov	ax, [doscnt]
  7954                                  		xchg	ah, al		; multiply by 256
  7955                                  		shl	ax, 1		; times	2 equal	512
  7956                                  		add	di, ax		; update load location
  7957                                  		pop	cx		; restore sectors/cluster
  7958                                  		retn
  7959                                  
  7960                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  7961                                  
  7962                                  ;function: find and read the corresponding fat sector into ds:0
  7963                                  ;
  7964                                  ;in). dx:si - offset value (starting from fat entry 0) of fat entry to find. M054
  7965                                  ;     ds - fatloc segment
  7966                                  ;     cs:drvfat - logical drive number, fat id
  7967                                  ;     cs:md_sectorsize
  7968                                  ;     cs:last_fat_secnum - last fat sector number read in.
  7969                                  ;
  7970                                  ;out). corresponding fat sector read in.
  7971                                  ;      bx = offset value from fatlog segment.
  7972                                  ;      other registera saved.
  7973                                  ;      zero flag set if the fat entry is splitted, i.e., when 12 bit fat entry
  7974                                  ;      starts at the last byte of the fat sector. in this case, the caller
  7975                                  ;      should save this byte, and read the next fat sector to get the rest
  7976                                  ;      of the fat entry value. (this will only happen with the 12 bit fat.)
  7977                                  
  7978                                  		; 17/10/2022
  7979                                  get_fat_sector:	
  7980                                  		; 14/12/2023
  7981                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7982                                  		; ds = fat buffer segment
  7983                                  
  7984                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7985                                  		;push	ax ; (not necessary)
  7986                                  		push	cx ; read count (sectors per cluster)
  7987                                  		push	di ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load offset
  7988                                  		push	si ; FAT offset value (from fat entry 0)
  7989                                  		push	es ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load segment
  7990                                  		push	ds ; FAT buffer segment
  7991                                  
  7992                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7993                                  		push	cs
  7994                                  		pop	ds
  7995                                  
  7996                                  		mov	ax, si
  7997                                  		;;mov	cx, [cs:md_sectorsize] ; 512
  7998                                  		; 13/12/2023
  7999                                  		;mov	cx, [md_sectorsize] ; 512
  8000                                  		;div	cx		; ax = sector number, dx = offset
  8001                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8002                                  		;nop
  8003                                  
  8004                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8005                                  		div	word [md_sectorsize] ; 512
  8006                                  
  8007                                  		; ax = FAT sector (sequence/index) number
  8008                                  		; dx = cluster number offset
  8009                                  
  8010                                  		; Get rid of the assumption that
  8011                                  		; there	is only	one reserved sector
  8012                                  
  8013                                  		; 13/12/2023 ; *
  8014                                  		;push	es ; *
  8015                                  		;push	ds ; *
  8016                                  		;push	di ; *
  8017                                  		push	ax
  8018                                  		;push	cs ; *
  8019                                  		;pop	ds ; *
  8020                                  
  8021                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:drvfat]	; get drive # and FAT id
  8022                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8023                                  		mov	ax, [drvfat]	; get drive # and FAT id 
  8024                                  		mov	bp, SETDRIVE
  8025                                  		;;mov	bp, 4D7h	; setdrive
  8026                                  					; at 2C7h:4D7h = 70h:2A47h
  8027                                  		push	cs		; simulate far call
  8028                                  		call	call_bios_code	; get bds for drive
  8029                                  		pop	ax		; (sector number -without reserved and hidden sectors-)
  8030                                  		add	ax, [es:di+9]	; [es:di+BDS.resectors]
  8031                                  					; add #reserved_sectors
  8032                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8033                                  		;pop	di ; *
  8034                                  		;pop	ds ; *
  8035                                  		;pop	es ; *
  8036                                  
  8037                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8038                                  		; ds = cs
  8039                                  		cmp	ax, [last_fat_sec_num]
  8040                                  		;cmp	ax, [cs:last_fat_sec_num]
  8041                                  		jz	short gfs_split_chk ; don't need to read it again.
  8042                                  		mov	[last_fat_sec_num], ax
  8043                                  		;mov	[cs:last_fat_sec_num], ax
  8044                                  					; sector number
  8045                                  					; (in the partition, without hidden sectors)
  8046                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8047                                  		pop	es ; FAT buffer segment (DS on top of the stack)
  8048                                  		push	es ; (put it on top of the stack again)
  8049                                  
  8050                                  		push	dx ; cluster number offset
  8051                                  
  8052                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8053                                  		xor	cx, cx
  8054                                  		mov	[start_sec_h], cx ;0 
  8055                                  		;mov	word [cs:start_sec_h], 0 
  8056                                  					; prepare to read the fat sector
  8057                                  					; start_sec_h is always	0 for fat sector.
  8058                                  		mov	dx, ax
  8059                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8060                                  		inc	cx ; cx = 1
  8061                                  		;mov	cx, 1		; 1 sector read
  8062                                  		;mov	ax, [cs:drvfat]
  8063                                  		mov	ax, [drvfat]
  8064                                  		;push	ds
  8065                                  		;pop	es
  8066                                  
  8067                                  		xor	di, di	; 0	; es:di	-> fatloc segment:0
  8068                                  		
  8069                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8070                                  		;push	ds
  8071                                  		;push	cs
  8072                                  		;pop	ds
  8073                                  		
  8074                                  		push	cs		; simulate far call
  8075                                  		mov	bp, DISKRD	; 8E5h
  8076                                  		;mov	bp, 8E5h	; offset diskrd
  8077                                  					; 2C7h:8E5h = 70h:2E55h
  8078                                  		call	call_bios_code
  8079                                  
  8080                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8081                                  		;pop	ds
  8082                                  		; ds = cs = biosdata segment
  8083                                  
  8084                                  		pop	dx ; cluster number offset 
  8085                                  
  8086                                  gfs_split_chk:
  8087                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8088                                  		;mov	cx, [cs:md_sectorsize] ; 512
  8089                                  		mov	cx, [md_sectorsize]
  8090                                  ;gfs_split_chk:
  8091                                  		dec	cx		; 511
  8092                                  		cmp	dx, cx		; if offset points to the
  8093                                  					; last byte of this sector,
  8094                                  					; then splitted	entry.
  8095                                  		mov	bx, dx		; set bx to dx
  8096                                  		
  8097                                  		; 13/12/2023
  8098                                  		; bx = dx = cluster number offset in the FAT buffer
  8099                                  		pop	ds ; FAT buffer segment
  8100                                  		pop	es ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load segment
  8101                                  		pop	si ; FAT offset value (from fat entry 0)
  8102                                  		pop	di ; IBMDOS.COM/MSDOS.SYS load offset
  8103                                  		pop	cx ; read count (sectors per cluster)
  8104                                  		;pop	ax
  8105                                  
  8106                                  		retn
  8107                                  ; 15/10/2022
  8108                                  ;Bios_Data_Init	ends

  8256                                  
  8257                                  ; Special case for 32-bit start sector number:
  8258                                  ;   if (si==dsktbl) /* if this is a disk device call */
  8259                                  ;      set high 16 bits of secnum to 0
  8260                                  ;      if (secnum == 0xffff) fetch 32 bit sector number
  8261                                  ;
  8262                                  ; pass high word of sector number in start_sec_h, low word in dx
  8263                                  ;
  8264                                  ; note: start_l and start_h are the offsets within the io_request packet
  8265                                  ;	  which contain the low and hi words of the 32 bit start sector if
  8266                                  ;	  it has been used.

  8269                                  
  8270                                  		; 20/09/2023

  8327 000000CB E80700                  		call	bc_cmderr

  8332                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8333                                  ; The following piece of hack is for supporting CP/M compatibility
  8334                                  ; Basically at offset 5 we have a far call into 0:c0. But this does not call
  8335                                  ; 0:c0 directly instead it call f01d:fef0, because it needs to support 'lhld 6'
  8336                                  ; The following hack has to reside at ffff:d0 (= f01d:fef0) if BIOS is loaded
  8337                                  ; high.
  8338                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8339                                  
  8340                                  
  8341                                  		;db 7 dup(0)
  8342                                  
  8343                                  		; 20/09/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (Optimization)
  8344                                  		; (PCDOS 7.1 - IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:0D0h)
  8345                                  		; 15/10/2022
  8346                                  		;dw 0		; pad to bring offset to 0D0h
  8347                                  
  8348 000000D0 00<rep 5h>              off_d0: 	times 5 db 0	; 5 bytes from 0:c0 will be copied onto here
  8349                                  				;  which is the CP/M call 5 entry point
  8350

  8355                                  bc_cmderr:

  8357                                  					; unknown command error
  8358                                  
  8359                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8360                                  
  8361                                  ;	now zero the count field by subtracting its current value,
  8362                                  ;	  which is still in cx, from itself.
  8363                                  
  8364                                  ;	subtract the number of i/o's NOT YET COMPLETED from total
  8365                                  ;	  in order to return the number actually complete

  8372                                  					; # of successful i/o's

  8374 000000E1 F9                      		stc			; indicate abnormal end

  8393                                  ; BIOSCODE:00E4h (MSDOS 6.21, IO.SYS)
  8394                                  
  8395                                  ;************************************************************************
  8396                                  ;*									*
  8397                                  ;*	device driver dispatch tables					*
  8398                                  ;*									*
  8399                                  ;*	each table starts with a byte which lists the number of		*
  8400                                  ;*	legal functions, followed by that number of words. Each		*
  8401                                  ;*	word represents an offset of a routine in Bios_Code which	*
  8402                                  ;*	handles the function. The functions are terminated with		*
  8403                                  ;*	a near return. If carry is reset, a 'done' code is returned	*
  8404                                  ;*	to the caller. If carry is set, the ah/al registers are		*
  8405                                  ;*	returned as abnormal completion status. Notice that ds		*
  8406                                  ;*	is assumed to point to the Bios_Data segment throughout.	*
  8407                                  ;*									*
  8408                                  ;************************************************************************
  8409                                  
  8410                                  
  8411                                  		; 20/09/2023

  8418                                  					; 2C7h:0E4h = 70h:2654h

  8420                                  					; 00 init

  8422 000000E9 [FA01]                  		dw bc_exvec  ; 1FBh	; 02

  8426                                  					; 04

  8428                                  					; 05

  8518                                  ;*									*

  8522                                  ;*	  supported. the returning value of the extended keystroke	*
  8523                                  ;*	  of the extended keyboard function uses 0E0h in al		*
  8524                                  ;*	  instead of 00h as in the conventional keyboard function.	*
  8525                                  ;*	  this creates a conflict when the user entered real		*
  8526                                  ;*	  greek alpha charater (= 0E0h) to  distinguish the extended	*
  8527                                  ;*	  keystroke and the greek alpha. this case will be handled	*
  8528                                  ;*	  in the following manner:					*
  8529                                  ;*									*
  8530                                  ;*	      ah = 16h							*
  8531                                  ;*	      int 16h							*
  8532                                  ;*	      if al == 0, then extended code (in ah)			*
  8533                                  ;*	      else if al == 0E0h, then					*
  8534                                  ;*	      if ah <> 0, then extended code (in ah)			*
  8535                                  ;*		else greek_alpha character.				*
  8536                                  ;*									*
  8537                                  ;*	also, for compatibility reason, if an extended code is		*
  8538                                  ;*	  detected, then we are going to change the value in al		*
  8539                                  ;*	  from 0E0h to 00h.						*
  8540                                  ;*									*
  8541                                  ;************************************************************************
  8542                                  
  8543                                  		; 19/10/2022
  8544                                  chrin:		
  8545 00000166 8A26[DE04]              		mov	ah, [keyrd_func] ; set by msinit. 0 or 10h
  8546 0000016A 30C0                    		xor	al, al
  8547 0000016C 8606[0C00]              		xchg	al, [altah]	; get character	& zero altah
  8548 00000170 08C0                    		or	al, al
  8549 00000172 752A                    		jnz	short keyret
  8550 00000174 CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD -
  8551 00000176 09C0                    		or	ax, ax
  8552 00000178 74EC                    		jz	short chrin
  8553 0000017A 3D0072                  		cmp	ax, 7200h	; check	for ctrl-prtsc
  8554 0000017D 7504                    		jnz	short alt_ext_chk
  8555 0000017F B010                    		mov	al, 10h
  8556 00000181 EB1B                    		jmp	short keyret
  8557                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8558                                  
  8559                                  ;  if operation was extended function (i.e. keyrd_func != 0) then
  8560                                  ;    if character read was 0E0h then
  8561                                  ;      if extended byte was zero (i.e. ah == 0) then
  8562                                  ;	 goto keyret
  8563                                  ;      else
  8564                                  ;	 set al to zero
  8565                                  ;	 goto alt_save
  8566                                  ;      endif
  8567                                  ;    endif
  8568                                  ;  endif
  8569                                  
  8570                                  alt_ext_chk:
  8571 00000183 803E[DE04]00            		cmp	byte [keyrd_func], 0
  8572 00000188 740C                    		jz	short not_ext
  8573 0000018A 3CE0                    		cmp	al, 0E0h
  8574 0000018C 7508                    		jnz	short not_ext
  8575 0000018E 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
  8576 00000190 740C                    		jz	short keyret
  8577 00000192 30C0                    		xor	al, al
  8578 00000194 EB04                    		jmp	short alt_save
  8579                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8580                                  
  8581                                  not_ext:				
  8582 00000196 08C0                    		or	al, al		; special case?
  8583 00000198 7504                    		jnz	short keyret
  8584                                  alt_save:				
  8585 0000019A 8826[0C00]              		mov	[altah], ah	; store	special	key
  8586                                  keyret:					
  8587 0000019E C3                      		retn
  8588                                  
  8589                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8590                                  
  8591                                  ;************************************************************************
  8592                                  ;*									*
  8593                                  ;*	con_rdnd - keyboard non destructive read, no wait		*
  8594                                  ;*									*
  8595                                  ;*	pc-convertible-type machine: if bit 10 is set by the dos	*
  8596                                  ;*	in the status word of the request packet, and there is no	*
  8597                                  ;*	character in the input buffer, the driver issues a system	*
  8598                                  ;*	wait request to the rom. on return from the rom, it returns	*
  8599                                  ;*	a 'char-not-found' to the dos.					*
  8600                                  ;*									*
  8601                                  ;************************************************************************
  8602                                  
  8603                                  		; 19/10/2022
  8604                                  con_rdnd:				
  8605 0000019F A0[0C00]                		mov	al, [altah]
  8606 000001A2 08C0                    		or	al, al
  8607 000001A4 754C                    		jnz	short rdexit
  8608 000001A6 8A26[DF04]              		mov	ah, [keysts_func]
  8609 000001AA CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD -
  8610 000001AC 751D                    		jnz	short gotchr
  8611 000001AE 803E[7900]00            		cmp	byte [fhavek09], 0
  8612 000001B3 7412                    		jz	short z_bus_exit
  8613 000001B5 C41E[1200]              		les	bx, [ptrsav]
  8614                                  		; 12/12/2022
  8615 000001B9 26F6470404              		test	byte [es:bx+4], 04h
  8616                                  		;test	word [es:bx+3], 400h ; [es:bx+status]
  8617 000001BE 7407                    		jz	short z_bus_exit
  8618 000001C0 B80041                  		mov	ax, 4100h
  8619 000001C3 30DB                    		xor	bl, bl
  8620 000001C5 CD15                    		int	15h		; SYSTEM - WAIT	ON EXTERNAL EVENT (CONVERTIBLE)
  8621                                  					; AL = condition type, BH = condition compare or mask value
  8622                                  					; BL = timeout value times 55 milliseconds, 00h	means no timeout
  8623                                  					; DX = I/O port	address	if AL bit 4 set
  8624                                  z_bus_exit:				
  8625 000001C7 F9                      		stc			; 2C7h:1C8h = 70h:2738h
  8626 000001C8 B403                    		mov	ah, 3		; indicate busy	status
  8627 000001CA C3                      		retn
  8628                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8629                                  
  8630                                  gotchr:					
  8631 000001CB 09C0                    		or	ax, ax
  8632 000001CD 7508                    		jnz	short notbrk	; check	for null after break
  8633 000001CF 8A26[DE04]              		mov	ah, [keyrd_func] ; issue keyboard read function
  8634 000001D3 CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD -
  8635 000001D5 EBC8                    		jmp	short con_rdnd	; get a	real status
  8636                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8637                                  
  8638                                  notbrk:					
  8639 000001D7 3D0072                  		cmp	ax, 7200h	; check	for ctrl-prtsc
  8640 000001DA 7504                    		jnz	short rd_ext_chk
  8641 000001DC B010                    		mov	al, 10h		; ('P' & 1Fh) ; return control p
  8642 000001DE EB12                    		jmp	short rdexit
  8643                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8644                                  
  8645                                  rd_ext_chk:				
  8646 000001E0 803E[DE04]00            		cmp	byte [keyrd_func], 0 ; extended keyboard function?
  8647 000001E5 740B                    		jz	short rdexit
  8648 000001E7 3CE0                    		cmp	al, 0E0h	; extended key value or	greek alpha?
  8649 000001E9 7507                    		jnz	short rdexit
  8650 000001EB 80FC00                  		cmp	ah, 0		; scan code exist?
  8651 000001EE 7402                    		jz	short rdexit	; yes. greek alpha char.
  8652 000001F0 B000                    		mov	al, 0		; no. extended key stroke.
  8653                                  					; change it for	compatibility
  8654                                  rdexit:					
  8655 000001F2 C41E[1200]              		les	bx, [ptrsav]
  8656 000001F6 2688470D                		mov	[es:bx+13], al	; [es:bx+media]
  8657                                  					; return keyboard character here
  8658                                  bc_exvec:				
  8659 000001FA F8                      		clc			; bc_exvec at 2C7h:1FBh	= 70h:276Bh
  8660                                  					; indicate normal termination
  8661 000001FB C3                      		retn
  8662                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8663                                  
  8664                                  ;************************************************************************
  8665                                  ;*									*
  8666                                  ;*	con_write - console write routine				*
  8667                                  ;*									*
  8668                                  ;*	entry:	es:di -> buffer						*
  8669                                  ;*		cx    =  count						*
  8670                                  ;*									*
  8671                                  ;************************************************************************
  8672                                  
  8673                                  con_writ:
  8674                                  		;jcxz	short bc_exvec
  8675 000001FC E3FC                    		jcxz	bc_exvec	; 19/10/2022
  8676                                  		; 12/12/2022
  8677                                  		;jcxz	cc_ret
  8678                                  con_lp:					
  8679 000001FE 268A05                  		mov	al, [es:di]
  8680 00000201 47                      		inc	di
  8681 00000202 CD29                    		int	29h		; DOS 2+ internal - FAST PUTCHAR
  8682                                  					; AL = character to display
  8683 00000204 E2F8                    		loop	con_lp
  8684                                  cc_ret:					
  8685 00000206 F8                      		clc
  8686 00000207 C3                      		retn

  8690                                  ;************************************************************************

  8695                                  
  8696                                  con_flush:

  8698                                  flloop:					; while	(charavail()) charread();	
  8699 0000020D B401                    		mov	ah, 1
  8700 0000020F CD16                    		int	16h		; KEYBOARD - CHECK BUFFER, DO NOT CLEAR
  8701                                  					; Return: ZF clear if character	in buffer
  8702                                  					; AH = scan code, AL = character
  8703                                  					; ZF set if no character in buffer
  8704 00000211 74F3                    		jz	short cc_ret

  8707                                  					; Return: AH = scan code, AL = character
  8708 00000217 EBF4                    		jmp	short flloop

  8748                                  		; 12/12/2022
  8749                                  prn_done:

  8751 0000021D C3                      		retn

  8759                                  ;*									*

  8763                                  		;jcxz	short prn_done	; no chars to output

  8818                                  ;************************************************************************
  8819                                  ;*									*
  8820                                  ;*	prnstat - utility function to call ROM BIOS to check		*
  8821                                  ;*		 printer status. Return meaningful error code		*
  8822                                  ;*									*
  8823                                  ;************************************************************************
  8824                                  
  8825                                  prnstat:				
  8826 0000025C B402                    		mov	ah, 2		; set command for get status
  8827                                  					; PRINTER - GET	STATUS
  8828                                  					; DX = printer port (0-3)
  8829                                  					; Return: AH = status
  8830                                  
  8831                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
  8832                                  
  8833                                  ;************************************************************************
  8834                                  ;*									*
  8835                                  ;*	prnop - call ROM BIOS printer function in ah			*
  8836                                  ;*		return zero true if no error				*
  8837                                  ;*		return zero false if error, al = error code		*
  8838                                  ;*									*
  8839                                  ;************************************************************************
  8840                                  
  8841                                  prnop:	
  8842 0000025E 8B16[2100]              		mov	dx, [auxnum]	; get printer number
  8843 00000262 CD17                    		int	17h		
  8844                                  
  8845                                  	; This check was added to see if this is a case of no
  8846                                  	; printer being installed. This tests checks to be sure
  8847                                  	; the error is noprinter (30h)
  8848                                  
  8849 00000264 50                      		push	ax
  8850 00000265 80E430                  		and	ah, 30h
  8851 00000268 80FC30                  		cmp	ah, 30h		; noprinter
  8852 0000026B 58                      		pop	ax
  8853 0000026C 7506                    		jnz	short NextTest
  8854 0000026E 80E4DF                  		and	ah, 0DFh	; ~nopaperstatus
  8855 00000271 80CC08                  		or	ah, 8		; ioerrstatus
  8856                                  
  8857                                  ; examine the status bits to see if an error occurred. unfortunately, several
  8858                                  ; of the bits are set so we have to pick and choose. we must be extremely
  8859                                  ; careful about breaking basic.
  8860                                  
  8861                                  NextTest:				
  8862 00000274 F6C428                  		test	ah, 28h		; (ioerrstatus+nopaperstatus)
  8863                                  					; i/o error?
  8864 00000277 740A                    		jz	short checknotready ; no, try not ready
  8865                                  
  8866                                  ; at this point, we know we have an error. the converse is not true
  8867                                  
  8868 00000279 B009                    		mov	al, 9		; error_I24_out_of_paper
  8869                                  					; first, assume	out of paper
  8870 0000027B F6C420                  		test	ah, 20h		; out of paper set?
  8871 0000027E 7502                    		jnz	short ret1	; yes, error is	set
  8872 00000280 FEC0                    		inc	al		; return al=10 (i/o error)
  8873                                  ret1:					
  8874 00000282 C3                      		retn
  8875                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8876                                  
  8877                                  checknotready:				
  8878 00000283 B002                    		mov	al, 2		; assume not-ready
  8879 00000285 F6C401                  		test	ah, 1
  8880 00000288 C3                      		retn

  8885                                  ;*									*
  8886                                  ;*	prn_tilbusy - output until busy. Used by print spooler.		*

  8888                                  ;*		     device to come ready.				*

  8918                                  					; lodsb
