  9272                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------
  9273                                  ;								:
  9274                                  ;		    clock device driver 			:
  9275                                  ;								:
  9276                                  ;								:
  9277                                  ;   this file contains the clock device driver. 		:
  9278                                  ;								:
  9279                                  ;   the routines in this files are:				:
  9280                                  ;								:
  9281                                  ;	routine 		function			:
  9282                                  ;	------- 		--------			:
  9283                                  ;	tim_writ		set the current time		:
  9284                                  ;	tim_read		read the current time		:
  9285                                  ;	time_to_ticks		convert time to corresponding	:
  9286                                  ;				  number of clock ticks 	:
  9287                                  ;								:
  9288                                  ; the clock ticks at the rate of:				:
  9289                                  ;								:
  9290                                  ;	1193180/65536 ticks/second (about 18.2 ticks per second):
  9291                                  ; see each routine for information on the use.			:
  9292                                  ;								:
  9293                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------
  9294                                  
  9295                                  ; convert time to ticks
  9296                                  ; input : time in cx and dx
  9297                                  ; ticks returned in cx:dx
  9298                                  
  9299                                  ;19/07/2019
  9300                                  ;09/03/2019
  9301                                  
  9302                                  time_to_ticks:				; 0070h:2906h =	02C7h:0396h
  9303                                  
  9304                                  ; first convert from hour,min,sec,hund. to
  9305                                  ; total number of 100th of seconds
  9306                                  
  9307 0000038A B03C                    		mov	al, 60
  9308 0000038C F6E5                    		mul	ch		; hours	to minutes
  9309 0000038E B500                    		mov	ch, 0
  9310 00000390 01C8                    		add	ax, cx		; total	minutes
  9311 00000392 B97017                  		mov	cx, 6000	; 60*100
  9312 00000395 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx		; get out of the way of	the multiply
  9313 00000397 F7E1                    		mul	cx		; convert to 1/100 sec
  9314 00000399 89C1                    		mov	cx, ax
  9315 0000039B B064                    		mov	al, 100
  9316 0000039D F6E7                    		mul	bh		; convert seconds to 1/100 sec
  9317 0000039F 01C1                    		add	cx, ax		; combine seconds with hours and min
  9318 000003A1 83D200                  		adc	dx, 0		; ripple carry
  9319 000003A4 B700                    		mov	bh, 0
  9320 000003A6 01D9                    		add	cx, bx		; combine 1/100	sec
  9321 000003A8 83D200                  		adc	dx, 0
  9322                                  
  9323                                  	; dx:cx is time in 1/100 sec
  9324                                  
  9325 000003AB 92                      		xchg	ax, dx
  9326 000003AC 91                      		xchg	ax, cx		; now time is in cx:ax
  9327 000003AD BB0BE9                  		mov	bx, 59659
  9328 000003B0 F7E3                    		mul	bx		; multiply low half
  9329 000003B2 87D1                    		xchg	dx, cx
  9330 000003B4 92                      		xchg	ax, dx		; cx->ax, ax->dx, dx->cx
  9331 000003B5 F7E3                    		mul	bx		; multiply high	half
  9332 000003B7 01C8                    		add	ax, cx		; combine overlapping products
  9333 000003B9 83D200                  		adc	dx, 0
  9334 000003BC 92                      		xchg	ax, dx		; ax:dx=time*59659
  9335 000003BD BB0500                  		mov	bx, 5
  9336 000003C0 F6F3                    		div	bl		; divide high half by 5
  9337 000003C2 88C1                    		mov	cl, al
  9338 000003C4 B500                    		mov	ch, 0
  9339 000003C6 88E0                    		mov	al, ah		; remainder of divide-by-5
  9340 000003C8 98                      		cbw
  9341 000003C9 92                      		xchg	ax, dx		; use it to extend low half
  9342 000003CA F7F3                    		div	bx		; divide low half by 5
  9343 000003CC 89C2                    		mov	dx, ax		; cx:dx	is now number of ticks in time
  9344 000003CE CB                      		retf			; far return
  9345

  9347

  9349                                  ; 15/10/2022
  9350                                  
  9351                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------
  9352                                  ;
  9353                                  ; tim_writ sets the current time
  9354                                  ;
  9355                                  ; on entry es:[di] has the current time:
  9356                                  ;
  9357                                  ;	number of days since 1-1-80	(word)
  9358                                  ;	minutes (0-59)			(byte)
  9359                                  ;	hours (0-23)			(byte)
  9360                                  ;	hundredths of seconds (0-99)	(byte)
  9361                                  ;	seconds (0-59)			(byte)
  9362                                  ;
  9363                                  ; each number has been checked for the correct range.
  9364                                  ;
  9365                                  ;	NOTE: Any changes in this routine probably require corresponding
  9366                                  ;	changes in the version that is built with the power manager driver.
  9367                                  ;	See ptime.asm.
  9368                                  ;
  9369                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------
  9370                                  
  9371                                  	; 08/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
  9372                                  	; PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - BIOSCODE:03EAh
  9373                                  tim_writ:				; 2C7h:3DBh = 70h:294Bh
  9374 000003CF 268B05                  		mov	ax, [es:di]
  9375 000003D2 50                      		push	ax		; daycnt. we need to set this at the very
  9376                                  					; end to avoid tick windows.
  9377 000003D3 803E[EC04]00            		cmp	byte [havecmosclock], 0
  9378                                  		;cmp	ds:havecmosclock, 0
  9379 000003D8 7423                    		jz	short no_cmos_1
  9380 000003DA 268A4503                		mov	al, [es:di+3]	; near indirect	calls
  9381                                  					; get binary hours
  9382                                  					; convert to bcd
  9383                                  		;call	far [bintobcd]
  9384                                  		;;call	ds:bintobcd	; call far [bintobcd]
  9385                                  		; 08/08/2023
  9386 000003DE E8E800                  		call	bintobcd
  9387 000003E1 88C5                    		mov	ch, al		; ch = bcd hours
  9388 000003E3 268A4502                		mov	al, [es:di+2]	; get binary minutes
  9389                                  		;call	far [bintobcd]
  9390                                  		;;call	ds:bintobcd	; convert to bcd
  9391 000003E7 E8DF00                  		call	bintobcd
  9392 000003EA 88C1                    		mov	cl, al		; cl = bcd minutes
  9393 000003EC 268A4505                		mov	al, [es:di+5]	; get binary seconds
  9394                                  		;call	far [bintobcd]
  9395                                  		;;call	ds:bintobcd
  9396 000003F0 E8D600                  		call	bintobcd
  9397                                  
  9398 000003F3 88C6                    		mov	dh, al		; dh = bcd seconds
  9399 000003F5 B200                    		mov	dl, 0		; dl = 0 (st) or 1 (dst)
  9400 000003F7 FA                      		cli
  9401 000003F8 B403                    		mov	ah, 3
  9402 000003FA CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- SET REAL TIME	CLOCK (AT,XT286,CONV,PS)
  9403                                  					; CH = hours in	BCD, CL	= minutes in BCD
  9404                                  					;  DH =	seconds	in BCD,DL = 01h	if daylight savings, 00h if standard time
  9405                                  					; Return: CMOS clock set
  9406 000003FC FB                      		sti
  9407                                  no_cmos_1:				
  9408 000003FD 268B4D02                		mov	cx, [es:di+2]
  9409 00000401 268B5504                		mov	dx, [es:di+4]
  9410                                  		; 17/10/2022
  9411 00000405 FF1E[B806]              		call	far [ttticks]
  9412                                  		;call	dword ptr ds:ttticks ; call far	[ttticks]
  9413                                  					; convert time to ticks
  9414                                  					; cx:dx	now has	time in	ticks
  9415 00000409 FA                      		cli			; turn off timer
  9416 0000040A B401                    		mov	ah, 1
  9417 0000040C CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- SET TIME OF DAY
  9418                                  					; CX:DX	= clock	count
  9419                                  					; Return: time of day set

  9579                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9580                                  ; gettime reads date and time
  9581                                  ; and returns the following information:
  9582                                  ;
  9583                                  ;	es:[di]  =count of days since 1-1-80
  9584                                  ;	es:[di+2]=hours
  9585                                  ;	es:[di+3]=minutes
  9586                                  ;	es:[di+4]=seconds
  9587                                  ;	es:[di+5]=hundredths of seconds
  9588                                  ;
  9589                                  ;	NOTE:  Any changes in this routine probably require corresponding
  9590                                  ;	changes in the version that is built with the power manager driver.
  9591                                  ;	See ptime.asm.
  9592                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9593                                  
  9594                                  tim_read:				; 2C7h:435h = 70h:29A5h
  9595 000004CE E84A00                  		call	GetTickCnt
  9596 000004D1 8B36[E904]              		mov	si, [daycnt]
  9597                                  
  9598                                  ; we now need to convert the time in tick to the time in 100th of
  9599                                  ; seconds. the relation between tick and seconds is:
  9600                                  ;
  9601                                  ;		 65,536 seconds
  9602                                  ;	       ----------------
  9603                                  ;		1,193,180 tick
  9604                                  ;
  9605                                  ; to get to 100th of second we need to multiply by 100. the equation is:
  9606                                  ;
  9607                                  ;	ticks from clock  * 65,536 * 100
  9608                                  ;      --------------------------------- = time in 100th of seconds
  9609                                  ;		1,193,180
  9610                                  ;
  9611                                  ; fortunately this formula simplifies to:
  9612                                  ;
  9613                                  ;	ticks from clock * 5 * 65,536
  9614                                  ;      --------------------------------- = time in 100th of seconds
  9615                                  ;		59,659
  9616                                  ;
  9617                                  ; the calculation is done by first multipling tick by 5. next we divide by
  9618                                  ; 59,659. in this division we multiply by 65,536 by shifting the dividend
  9619                                  ; my 16 bits to the left.
  9620                                  ;
  9621                                  ; start with ticks in cx:dx
  9622                                  ; multiply by 5
  9623                                  
  9624 000004D5 89C8                    		mov	ax, cx
  9625 000004D7 89D3                    		mov	bx, dx		; start	with ticks in cx:dx
  9626                                  					; multiply by 5
  9627 000004D9 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
  9628 000004DB D1D1                    		rcl	cx, 1		; times	2
  9629 000004DD D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
  9630 000004DF D1D1                    		rcl	cx, 1		; times	4
  9631 000004E1 01DA                    		add	dx, bx
  9632 000004E3 11C8                    		adc	ax, cx		; times	5
  9633 000004E5 92                      		xchg	ax, dx
  9634                                  
  9635                                  ; now have ticks * 5 in	dx:ax
  9636                                  ; we now need to multiply by 65536 and divide by 59659 d.
  9637                                  
  9638 000004E6 B90BE9                  		mov	cx, 59659	; get divisor
  9639 000004E9 F7F1                    		div	cx		; dx now has remainder
  9640                                  					; ax has high word of final quotient
  9641                                  
  9642                                  		; 08/08/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
  9643                                  		;mov	bx, ax		; put high word	in safe	place
  9644 000004EB 93                      		xchg	bx, ax
  9645 000004EC 31C0                    		xor	ax, ax		; this is the multiply by 65536
  9646 000004EE F7F1                    		div	cx		; bx:ax	now has	time in	100th of seconds
  9647                                  
  9648                                  ; rounding based on the	remainder may be added here
  9649                                  ; the result in	bx:ax is time in 1/100 second.
  9650                                  
  9651 000004F0 89DA                    		mov	dx, bx		
  9652 000004F2 B9C800                  		mov	cx, 200		; extract 1/100's
  9653                                  
  9654                                  ; division by 200 is necessary to ensure no overflow--max result
  9655                                  ; is number of seconds in a day/2 = 43200.
  9656                                  
  9657 000004F5 F7F1                    		div	cx
  9658 000004F7 80FA64                  		cmp	dl, 100		; remainder over 100?
  9659 000004FA 7203                    		jb	short noadj
  9660 000004FC 80EA64                  		sub	dl, 100		; keep 1/100's less than 100
  9661                                  noadj:					
  9662 000004FF F5                      		cmc			; if we	subtracted 100,	carry is now set
  9663 00000500 88D3                    		mov	bl, dl		; save 1/100's
  9664                                  
  9665                                  ; to compensate	for dividing by	200 instead of 100, we now multiply
  9666                                  ; by two, shifting a one in if the remainder had exceeded 100.
  9667                                  
  9668 00000502 D1D0                    		rcl	ax, 1		
  9669 00000504 B200                    		mov	dl, 0
  9670 00000506 D1D2                    		rcl	dx, 1
  9671                                  		;mov	cx, 60		; divide out seconds
  9672                                  		; 20/12/2023
  9673 00000508 B13C                    		mov	cl, 60
  9674 0000050A F7F1                    		div	cx
  9675 0000050C 88D7                    		mov	bh, dl		; save the seconds
  9676 0000050E F6F1                    		div	cl		; break	into hours and minutes
  9677 00000510 86C4                    		xchg	al, ah
  9678                                  
  9679                                  ; time is now in ax:bx (hours, minutes, seconds, 1/100 sec)
  9680                                  
  9681                                  		; 08/08/2023
  9682                                  		;push	ax
  9683                                  		;mov	ax, si		; daycnt
  9684 00000512 96                      		xchg	ax, si
  9685 00000513 AB                      		stosw
  9686                                  		;pop	ax
  9687 00000514 96                      		xchg	ax, si		; al = hours, ah = minutes
  9688 00000515 AB                      		stosw
  9689 00000516 89D8                    		mov	ax, bx
  9690 00000518 AB                      		stosw
  9691 00000519 F8                      		clc			; [es:di] = count of days since 1-1-80
  9692                                  					;   [es:di+2] = hours
  9693                                  					;   [es:di+3] = minutes
  9694                                  					;   [es:di+4] = seconds
  9695                                  					;   [es:di+5] = hundredths of seconds
  9696 0000051A C3                      		retn
  9697

  9701                                  
  9702                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9703                                  ;
  9704                                  ; procedure : GetTickCnt
  9705                                  ;
  9706                                  ;		Returns the tick count in CX:DX. Takes care of DayCnt in case
  9707                                  ;		of rollover [except when power management driver is in use]. 
  9708                                  ;		Uses the following logic for updating Daycnt
  9709                                  ;
  9710                                  ;		if ( rollover ) {
  9711                                  ;			if ( t_switch )
  9712                                  ;				daycnt++ ;
  9713                                  ;			else
  9714                                  ;				daycnt += rollover ;
  9715                                  ;		}
  9716                                  ;
  9717                                  ; USES : AX
  9718                                  ;
  9719                                  ; RETURNS : CX:DX - tick count
  9720                                  ; MODIFIES : daycnt
  9721                                  ;
  9722                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9723                                  
  9724                                  		; 17/10/2022
  9725                                  GetTickCnt:	
  9726 0000051B 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah
  9727 0000051D CD1A                    		int	1Ah		; CLOCK	- GET TIME OF DAY
  9728                                  					; Return: CX:DX	= clock	count
  9729                                  					; AL = 00h if clock was	read or	written	(via AH=0,1) since the previous
  9730                                  					; midnight
  9731                                  					; Otherwise, AL	> 0
  9732                                  		; 20/12/2023
  9733 0000051F 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah
  9734 00000521 3826[EB04]              		cmp	byte [t_switch], ah ; 0
  9735                                  		;cmp	byte [t_switch], 0 ; use old method ? (>0 is yes)
  9736 00000525 7505                    		jnz	short inc_case	; old method assumes that Int 1Ah returns rollover flag
  9737                                  		;xor	ah, ah		; new method assumes that Int 1Ah returns roll over count
  9738                                  					; and not flag
  9739 00000527 0106[E904]              		add	[daycnt], ax
  9740 0000052B C3                      		retn
  9741                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9742                                  
  9743                                  inc_case:
  9744 0000052C 08C0                    		or	al, al
  9745 0000052E 7404                    		jz	short no_rollover
  9746 00000530 FF06[E904]              		inc	word [daycnt]
  9747                                  no_rollover:
  9748 00000534 C3                      		retn

  9781                                  ; device attribute bits:
  9782                                  ;	bit 6 - get/set map for logical drives and generic ioctl.
  9783                                  
  9784                                  ;MAXERR		equ	5
  9785                                  ;MAX_HD_FMT_ERR	equ	2
  9786                                  
  9787                                  ;LSTDRV	equ 504h
  9788                                  
  9789                                  ; some floppies do not have changeline. as a result, media-check would
  9790                                  ; normally return i-don't-know, the dos would continually reread the fat and
  9791                                  ; discard cached data. we optimize this by implementing a logical door-latch:
  9792                                  ; it is physically impossible to change a disk in under 2 seconds. we retain
  9793                                  ; the time of the last successful disk operation and compare it with the current
  9794                                  ; time during media-check. if < 2 seconds and at least 1 timer tick has passed,
  9795                                  ; the we say no change. if > 2 seconds then we say i-don't-know. finally, 
  9796                                  ; since we cannot trust the timer to be always available, we record the number 
  9797                                  ; of media checks that have occurred when no apparent time has elapsed. while
  9798                                  ; this number is < a given threshold, we say no change. when it exceeds that
  9799                                  ; threshold, we say i-don't-know and reset the counter to 0. when we store 
  9800                                  ; the time of last successful access, if we see that time has passed too,
  9801                                  ; we reset the counter.
  9802                                  
  9803                                  accessmax	equ	5
  9804                                  
  9805                                  ; due to various bogosities, we need to continually adjust what the head
  9806                                  ; settle time is.  the following algorithm is used:
  9807                                  ;
  9808                                  ;   get the current head settle value.
  9809                                  ;   if it is 0, then
  9810                                  ;	set slow = 15
  9811                                  ;   else
  9812                                  ;	set slow = value
  9813                                  ;   ...
  9814                                  ;*********************************************
  9815                                  ;************ old algorithm ******************
  9816                                  ;*   if we are seeking and writing then
  9817                                  ;*	 use slow
  9818                                  ;*   else
  9819                                  ;*	 use fast
  9820                                  ;*********************************************
  9821                                  ;*********** ibm's requested logic ***********
  9822                                  ;   if we are seeking and writing and not on an at then
  9823                                  ;	use slow
  9824                                  ;   else
  9825                                  ;	use fast
  9826                                  ;   ...
  9827                                  ;   restore current head settle value
  9828                                  ;
  9829                                  ;
  9830                                  ;---------------------------------------
  9831                                  multrk_on	equ	10000000b	;user spcified mutitrack=on, or system turns
  9832                                  					; it on after handling config.sys file as a
  9833                                  					; default value, if multrk_flag = multrk_off1.
  9834                                  multrk_off1	equ	00000000b	;initial value. no "multitrack=" command entered.
  9835                                  multrk_off2	equ	00000001b	;user specified multitrack=off.
  9836

 10259                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10260                                  ;	getbp - return bpb from the drive specified by the bds.
 10261                                  ;	    if the return_fake_bpb flag is set, then it does nothing.
 10262                                  ;	    note that we never come here for fixed disks.
 10263                                  ;	    for all other cases,
 10264                                  ;	      - it reads boot sector to pull out the bpb
 10265                                  ;	      - if no valid bpb is found, it then reads the fat sector,
 10266                                  ;		to get the fat id byte to build the bpb from there.
 10267                                  ;
 10268                                  ;   inputs:	es:di point to correct bds.
 10269                                  ;
 10270                                  ;   outputs:	fills in bpb in current bds if valid bpb or fat id on disk.
 10271                                  ;		carry set, and al=7 if invalid disk.
 10272                                  ;		carry set and error code in al if other error.
 10273                                  ;		if failed to recognize the boot record, then will set the
 10274                                  ;		set_id_flag to 0.
 10275                                  ;		this routine will only work for a floppy diskette.
 10276                                  ;		     for a fixed disk, it will just return.
 10277                                  ;
 10278                                  ;	****** Note: getbp is a clone of getbp which uses the newer
 10279                                  ;	  segment definitions. It should be migrated towards.
 10280                                  ;	   now es:di has the bds, ds: has Bios_Data
 10281                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 10283                                  		; 29/12/2023

 10479                                  ; 15/10/2022 - Retro DOS 4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 10480                                  
 10481                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------
 10482                                  ; read in the boot sector. set carry if error in reading sector.
 10483                                  ; bx is set to 1 if the boot sector is invalid, otherwise it is 0.
 10484                                  ;
 10485                                  ;	assumes es:di -> bds, ds-> Bios_Data
 10486                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------
 10487                                  
 10488                                  ; 10/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 10489                                  
 10490                                  readbootsec:	
 10491 00000740 B600                    		mov	dh, 0		; head 0
 10492 00000742 B90100                  		mov	cx, 1		; cylinder 0, sector 1
 10493 00000745 E8BF00                  		call	read_sector
 10494 00000748 7243                    		jb	short err_ret
 10495 0000074A 31DB                    		xor	bx, bx		; assume valid boot sector
 10496                                  
 10497                                  		; put a sanity check for the boot sector in here to detect
 10498                                  		; boot sectors that do not have valid bpbs. we examine the
 10499                                  		; first two bytes - they must contain a long jump (69h) or a
 10500                                  		; short jump (EBh) followed by a nop (90h), or a short jump
 10501                                  		; (E9h). if this test is passed, we further check by examining
 10502                                  		; the signature at the end of the boot sector for the word
 10503                                  		; AA55h. if the signature is not present, we examine the media
 10504                                  		; descriptor byte to see if it is valid. for dos 3.3, this
 10505                                  		; logic is modified a little bit. we are not going to check
 10506                                  		; signature. instead we are going to sanity check the media
 10507                                  		; byte in bpb regardless of the validity of signature. this is
 10508                                  		; to save the already developed commercial products that have
 10509                                  		; good jump instruction and signature but with the false bpb
 10510                                  		; informations
 10511                                  
 10512                                  ; that will crash the diskette drive operation. (for example, symphony diskette).
 10513                                  
 10514                                  		; 02/09/2023
 10515                                  		; 19/10/2022
 10516                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 69h ; is it a direct jump?
 10517                                  		;jz	short check_bpb_mediabyte ; don't need to find a nop
 10518                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 0E9h ; dos 2.0 jump?
 10519                                  		;jz	short check_bpb_mediabyte ; no need for	nop
 10520                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector], 0EBh ; how about a short jump?
 10521                                  		;jnz	short invalidbootsec
 10522                                  		;cmp	byte [disksector+2], 90h ; is next one a nop?
 10523                                  		;jnz	short invalidbootsec
 10524                                  
 10525                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
 10526 0000074C A0[4E01]                		mov	al, [disksector]
 10527 0000074F 3C69                    		cmp	al, 69h		; is it a direct jump?
 10528 00000751 740F                    		je	short check_bpb_mediabyte
 10529                                  					; don't need to find a nop
 10530 00000753 3CE9                    		cmp	al, 0E9h	; dos 2.0 jump?
 10531 00000755 740B                    		je	short check_bpb_mediabyte
 10532                                  					; no need for nop
 10533 00000757 3CEB                    		cmp	al, 0EBh	; how about a short jump?
 10534 00000759 7530                    		jne	short invalidbootsec
 10535 0000075B 803E[5001]90            		cmp	byte [disksector+2], 90h ; is next one a nop?
 10536 00000760 7529                    		jne	short invalidbootsec
 10537                                  
 10538                                  ; 15/10/5022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 10539                                  ;
 10540                                  ;; 10/03/2019
 10541                                  ;; (MSDOS 3.3, MSDISK.ASM, 1988)
 10542                                  ;;
 10543                                  ;; Don't have to perform the following signature check since
 10544                                  ;; we need to check the media byte even with the good signatured diskette.
 10545                                  ;;
 10546                                  ;;check_signature:
 10547                                  ;;		cmp	word [cs:disksector+1FEh],0AA55h ; see if non-ibm
 10548                                  ;;							 ; disk or 1.x media.
 10549                                  ;;		jz	short checksinglesided ; go see if singled sided medium.
 10550                                  ;;					       ; may need some special handling
 10551                                  
 10552                                  ; check for non-ibm disks which do not have the signature AA55h at the
 10553                                  ; end of the boot sector, but still have a valid boot sector. this is done
 10554                                  ; by examining the media descriptor in the boot sector.
 10555                                  
 10556                                  		; 19/10/2022
 10557                                  check_bpb_mediabyte:
 10558 00000762 A0[6301]                		mov	al, [disksector+15h]
 10559                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.MEDIADESCRIPTOR]
 10560 00000765 50                      		push	ax ; 02/09/2023
 10561 00000766 24F0                    		and	al, 0F0h
 10562 00000768 3CF0                    		cmp	al, 0F0h	; allow	for strange media
 10563 0000076A 58                      		pop	ax ; 02/09/2023
 10564 0000076B 751E                    		jnz	short invalidbootsec
 10565                                  
 10566                                  ; there were some (apparently a lot of them) diskettes that had been formatted
 10567                                  ; under dos 3.1 and earlier versions which have invalid bpbs in their boot
 10568                                  ; sectors. these are specifically diskettes that were formatted in drives
 10569                                  ; with one head, or whose side 0 was bad. these contain bpbs in the boot
 10570                                  ; sector that have the sec/clus field set to 2 instead of 1, as is standard
 10571                                  ; in dos. in order to support them, we have to introduce a "hack" that will
 10572                                  ; help our build bpb routine to recognise these specific cases, and to
 10573                                  ; set up out copy of the bpb accordingly.
 10574                                  ; we do this by checking to see if the boot sector is off a diskette that
 10575                                  ; is single-sided and is a pre-dos 3.20 diskette. if it is, we set the
 10576                                  ; sec/clus field to 1. if not, we carry on as normal.
 10577                                  
 10578                                  checksinglesided:
 10579                                  		;mov	al, [disksector+15h]
 10580                                  		; 02/09/2023
 10581                                  		; al = [disksector+15h]

 10584 00000771 A801                    		test	al, 1

 10588 0000077D 803E[5801]32            		cmp	byte [disksector+0Ah], 32h ; "2"
 10589 00000782 7308                    		jnb	short gooddsk

 10750                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10751                                  ; read a single sector into the temp buffer.
 10752                                  ; perform three retries in case of error.
 10753                                  ;   inputs:	es:[di].bds_drivenum has physical drive to use
 10754                                  ;		cx has sector and cylinder
 10755                                  ;		dh has head
 10756                                  ;		es:di has bds
 10757                                  ;		ds has Bios_Data
 10758                                  ;
 10759                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear
 10760                                  ;		    Bios_Data:bx point to sector
 10761                                  ;		       (note: some callers assume location of buffer)
 10762                                  ;
 10763                                  ;		carry set
 10764                                  ;		    ax has rom error code
 10765                                  ;
 10766                                  ; register bp is preserved.
 10767                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10768

 10783                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
 10784                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
 10785                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read
 10786 0000081A 07                      		pop	es
 10787 0000081B 734A                    		jnb	short okret2

 10816                                  					; AL = number of sectors to read, CH = track, CL = sector
 10817                                  					; DH = head, DL	= drive, ES:BX -> buffer to fill
 10818                                  					; Return: CF set on error, AH =	status,	AL = number of sectors read

 11076                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11077                                  ;	disk i/o handler
 11078                                  ;
 11079                                  ;	al = drive number (0-6)
 11080                                  ;	ah = media descriptor
 11081                                  ;	cx = sector count
 11082                                  ;	dx = first sector (low)
 11083                                  ;	[start_sec_h] = first sector (high)  32 bit calculation.
 11084                                  ;	ds = cs
 11085                                  ;	es:di = transfer address
 11086                                  ;	[rflag]=operation (2=read, 3=write)
 11087                                  ;	[verify]=1 for verify after write
 11088                                  ;
 11089                                  ;	if successful carry flag = 0
 11090                                  ;	  else cf=1 and al contains error code

 11586                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------
 11587                                  ; the request is for write. determine if we are talking about
 11588                                  ; the same track and drive. if so, use the fast speed.

 11611                                  
 11612                                  ; check the error returned in ah to see if it is a soft ecc error.
 11613                                  ; if it is not we needn't do anything special. if it is a soft
 11614                                  ; ecc error then decrement the soft_ecc_cnt error retry count. if
 11615                                  ; this retry count becomes 0 then we just ignore the error and go to
 11616                                  ; no_verify but if we can still try then we call the routine to reset
 11617                                  ; the disk and go to dskerr1 to retry the operation.
 11618                                  
 11619 00000BA8 80FC11                  		cmp	ah, 11h		; soft ecc error ?

 11621 00000BAD FF0E[2305]              		dec	word [soft_ecc_cnt]
 11622 00000BB1 749A                    		jz	short noverify	; no more retry
 11623 00000BB3 E83305                  		call	ResetDisk	; reset	disk

 11626

 11946 00000CD4 07                      		pop	es

 11994                                  ;	GetDeviceParameters implements the generic ioctl function:
 11995                                  ;	majorcode=RAWIO, minorcode=GetDeviceParameters (60h)
 11996                                  ;

 12004                                  GetDeviceParameters:
 12005                                  		; Copy info from bds to the device parameters packet
 12006

 12224                                  ; ==========================================================================
 12225                                  ; FormatTrack:
 12226                                  ; if specialfunction byte is 1,then this is a status call to see if there is
 12227                                  ; rom support for the combination of sec/trk and # of cyln,and if the
 12228                                  ; combination is legal. if specialfunction byte is 0,then format the track.
 12229                                  ;
 12230                                  ; input: ES:di points to bds for drive
 12231                                  ;
 12232                                  ; output:
 12233                                  ;	for status call:
 12234                                  ;	specialfunction byte set to:
 12235                                  ;		0 - rom support + legal combination
 12236                                  ;		1 - no rom support
 12237                                  ;		2 - illegal combination
 12238                                  ;		3 - no media present
 12239                                  ;	carry cleared.
 12240                                  ;
 12241                                  ;	for format track:
 12242                                  ;		carry set if error
 12243                                  ;
 12244                                  ; ==========================================================================

 12773                                  
 12774                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 12775                                  ;
 12776                                  ; Set Media Type for Format
 12777                                  ; Performs the int 13 with ah = 18h to see if the medium described in the
 12778                                  ; BPB area in the BDS can be handled by the rom.
 12779                                  ; On Input, ES:DI -> current BDS.
 12780                                  ; The status of the operation is returned in AL
 12781                                  ;
 12782                                  ;	- 0 - if the support is available,and the combination is valid.
 12783                                  ;	- 1 - no rom support
 12784                                  ;	- 2 - illegal combination
 12785                                  ;	- 3 - no media present (rom support exists but cannot determine now)
 12786                                  ;
 12787                                  ; Flags also may be altered. All other registers preserved.
 12788                                  ; If the call to rom returns no error,then the current Dpt is "replaced" by
 12789                                  ; the one returned by the rom. This is Done by changing the pointer in [Dpt]
 12790                                  ; to the one returned. the original pointer to the disk base table is stored
 12791                                  ; in TempDpt, until it is restored.
 12792                                  ;
 12793                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 12794                                  
 12795                                  		; 19/10/2022
 12796                                  SetMediaForFormat:

 13178                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13179                                  ;	get media id
 13180                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13181                                  ;
 13182                                  ; FUNCTION: get the volume label,the system id and the serial number from
 13183                                  ;	    the media that has the extended boot record.
 13184                                  ;	    for the conventional media,this routine will return "unknown
 13185                                  ;	    media type" error to dos.
 13186                                  ;
 13187                                  ; INPUT :   ES:di -> bds table for this drive.
 13188                                  ;
 13189                                  ; OUTPUT:   the request packet filled with the information,if not carry.
 13190                                  ;	    if carry set,then al contains the device driver error number
 13191                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.
 13192                                  ;	    register DS,DX,AX,CX,DI,SI destroyed.
 13193                                  ;
 13194                                  ; SUBROUTINES TO BE CALLED:
 13195                                  ;	BootIo:NEAR
 13196                                  ;
 13197                                  ; LOGIC:
 13198                                  ;	to recognize the extended boot record,this logic will actually
 13199                                  ;	access the boot sector even if it is a hard disk.
 13200                                  ;	note:the valid extended bpb is recognized by looking at the mediabyte
 13201                                  ;	field of bpb and the extended boot signature.
 13202                                  ;
 13203                                  ; {
 13204                                  ;	get logical drive number from bds table;
 13205                                  ;	rFlag = read operation;
 13206                                  ;	BootIo;		 /*get the media boot record into the buffer
 13207                                  ;	if (no error) then
 13208                                  ;	     if (extended boot record) then
 13209                                  ;		{ set volume label,volume serial number and system id
 13210                                  ;		  of the request packet to those of the boot record;
 13211                                  ;		};
 13212                                  ;	     else		  /*not an extended bpb */
 13213                                  ;		{ set register al to "unknown media.." error code;
 13214                                  ;		  set carry bit;
 13215                                  ;		};
 13216                                  ;	else
 13217                                  ;	     ret;	/*already error code is set in the register al
 13218                                  ;
 13219                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13220                                  
 13221                                  ;size_of_EXT_BOOT_SERIAL equ 4
 13222                                  ;;size_of_EXT_BOOT_VOL_LABEL equ 11
 13223                                  ;;size_of_EXT_SYSTEM_ID equ 8

 13279                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13280                                  ;  set media id
 13281                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13282                                  
 13283                                  ; function: set the volume label, the system id and the serial number of
 13284                                  ;	    the media that has the extended boot record.
 13285                                  ;	    for the conventional media, this routine will return "unknown
 13286                                  ;	    media.." error to dos.
 13287                                  ;	    this routine will also set the corresponding informations in
 13288                                  ;	    the bds table.
 13289                                  ;
 13290                                  ; input :   ES:di -> bds table for this drive.
 13291                                  ;
 13292                                  ; output:   the extended boot record in the media will be set according to
 13293                                  ;	    the request packet.
 13294                                  ;	    if carry set, then al contains the device driver error number
 13295                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.
 13296                                  ;
 13297                                  ; subroutines to be called:
 13298                                  ;	BootIo:NEAR
 13299                                  ;
 13300                                  ; logic:
 13301                                  ;
 13302                                  ; {
 13303                                  ;	get drive_number from bds;
 13304                                  ;	rFlag = "read operation";
 13305                                  ;	BootIo;
 13306                                  ;	if (no error) then
 13307                                  ;	     if (extended boot record) then
 13308                                  ;		{ set volume label,volume serial number and system id
 13309                                  ;		  of the boot record to those of the request packet;
 13310                                  ;		  rFlag = "write operation";
 13311                                  ;		  get drive number from bds;
 13312                                  ;		  BootIo;	  /*write it back*/
 13313                                  ;		};
 13314                                  ;	     else		  /*not an extended bpb */
 13315                                  ;		{ set register al to "unknown media.." error code;
 13316                                  ;		  set carry bit;
 13317                                  ;		  ret;	 /*return back to caller */
 13318                                  ;		};
 13319                                  ;	else
 13320                                  ;	     ret;		 /*already error code is set */
 13321                                  ;
 13322                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13323                                  
 13324                                  		; 24/12/2023
 13325                                  		; 19/10/2022

 13388                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13389                                  ;	BootIo
 13390                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13391                                  ;
 13392                                  ; function: read/write the boot record into boot sector.
 13393                                  ;
 13394                                  ; input :
 13395                                  ;	    al=logical drive number
 13396                                  ;	    rFlag = operation (read/write)
 13397                                  ;
 13398                                  ; output:   for read operation,the boot record of the drive specified in bds
 13399                                  ;	    be read into the DiskSector buffer.
 13400                                  ;	    for write operation,the DiskSector buffer image will be written
 13401                                  ;	    to the drive specified in bds.
 13402                                  ;	    if carry set,then al contains the device driver error number
 13403                                  ;	    that will be returned to dos.
 13404                                  ;	    AX,CX,DX register destroyed.
 13405                                  ;	    if carry set,then al will contain the error code from DiskIO.
 13406                                  ;
 13407                                  ; subroutines to be called:
 13408                                  ;	DiskIO:NEAR
 13409                                  ;
 13410                                  ; logic:
 13411                                  ;
 13412                                  ; {
 13413                                  ;	first_sector = 0;	 /*logical sector 0 is the boot sector */
 13414                                  ;	sectorcount = 1;	 /*read 1 sector only */
 13415                                  ;	buffer = DiskSector;	 /*read it into the DiskSector buffer */
 13416                                  ;	call DiskIO (rFlag,drive_number,first_sector,sectorcount,buffer);
 13417                                  ; }
 13418                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13419                                  
 13420                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13421                                  BootIo:	
 13422 00001244 06                      		push	es
 13423 00001245 57                      		push	di
 13424 00001246 53                      		push	bx
 13425 00001247 1E                      		push	ds
 13426 00001248 07                      		pop	es		; Point ES: to Bios_Data
 13427                                  
 13428                                  		; Call DiskIO to read/write the boot sec. The parameters which
 13429                                  		; need to be initialized for this subroutine out here are
 13430                                  		; - Transfer address to Bios_Data:DiskSector
 13431                                  		; - Low sector needs to be initalized to 0. this is a reg. param
 13432                                  		; - Hi sector in [Start_Sec_H] needs to be initialised to 0.
 13433                                  		; - Number of sectors <-- 1
 13434                                  
 13435 00001249 BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector	; es:di -> transfer address
 13436 0000124C 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx		; First	sector (h) -> 0
 13437 0000124E 8916[1C05]              		mov	[start_sec_h], dx ; Start sector (h) -> 0
 13438 00001252 B90100                  		mov	cx, 1
 13439 00001255 E8FBF6                  		call	diskio
 13440 00001258 5B                      		pop	bx
 13441 00001259 5F                      		pop	di
 13442 0000125A 07                      		pop	es
 13443 0000125B C3                      		retn
 13444                                  
 13445                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 13446                                  
 13447                                  ; 16/10/2022

 13449                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13450                                  ;	ChangeLineChk
 13451                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13452                                  ;
 13453                                  ; when the user calls get/set media id call before dos establishes the media
 13454                                  ; by calling "media_chk",the change line activity of the drive is going to be
 13455                                  ; lost.	this routine will check the change line activity and will save the
 13456                                  ; history in the flags.
 13457                                  ;
 13458                                  ; FUNCTION: check the change line error activity
 13459                                  ;
 13460                                  ; INPUT :  ES:di -> bds table.
 13461                                  ;
 13462                                  ; OUTPUT:   flag in bds table will be updated if change line occurs.
 13463                                  ;
 13464                                  ; SUBROUTINES TO BE CALLED:
 13465                                  ;	Set_Changed_DL
 13466                                  ;
 13467                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13468                                  
 13469                                  ChangeLineChk:	
 13470 0000125C 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 13471 00001260 08D2                    		or	dl, dl		; Fixed	disk?
 13472 00001262 7821                    		js	short ChangeLnChkRet ; Yes, skip it.
 13473                                  		; 12/12/2022
 13474 00001264 26F6452304              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 4
 13475                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 4 ; [es:di+BDS.flags]
 13476                                  					; return_fake_bpb
 13477 00001269 751A                    		jnz	short ChangeLnChkRet
 13478 0000126B 803E[7700]01            		cmp	byte [fhave96], 1	; This rom support change line?
 13479 00001270 7513                    		jnz	short ChangeLnChkRet
 13480 00001272 E8EA06                  		call	haschange	; This drive support change line?
 13481 00001275 740E                    		jz	short ChangeLnChkRet ; Do nothing
 13482                                  
 13483                                  		; Execute the rom disk interrupt to check changeline activity.
 13484                                  
 13485 00001277 B416                    		mov	ah, 16h
 13486 00001279 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - FLOPPY	DISK - CHANGE OF DISK STATUS (AT,XT2,XT286,CONV,PS)
 13487                                  					; DL = drive to	check
 13488                                  					; Return: AH = disk change status
 13489 0000127B 7308                    		jnb	short ChangeLnChkRet
 13490 0000127D 53                      		push	bx
 13491 0000127E BB4000                  		mov	bx, 40h		; fchanged
 13492                                  					; Update flag in BDS for this
 13493                                  					; physical drive
 13494 00001281 E8B406                  		call	set_changed_dl
 13495 00001284 5B                      		pop	bx
 13496                                  ChangeLnChkRet:				
 13497 00001285 C3                      		retn

 13629                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13630                                  ;	GetMediaSenseStatus
 13631                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13632                                  ;
 13633                                  ; FUNCTION: Will return the type of diskette media in the specified DOS
 13634                                  ;	    diskette drive and whether the media is the default type
 13635                                  ;	    for that drive. (default type means the max size for that
 13636                                  ;	    drive)
 13637                                  ;
 13638                                  ; INPUT :   ES:DI -> BDS table
 13639                                  ; OUTPUT:   If carry clear
 13640                                  ;	    DS:BX -> Updated IOCtlPacket
 13641                                  ;
 13642                                  ;			 Special Function at offset 0:
 13643                                  ;				0	- Media detected is not default type
 13644                                  ;				1	- Media detected is default type
 13645                                  ;
 13646                                  ;			 Device Type at offset 1:
 13647                                  ;				2       - 720K 3.5" 80 tracks
 13648                                  ;				7	- 1.44M 3.5" 80 tracks
 13649                                  ;				9	- 2.88M 3.5" 80 tracks
 13650                                  ;
 13651                                  ; Error Codes returned in AX if carry set:
 13652                                  ;
 13653                                  ; 8102 - Drive not ready	- No disk is in the drive.
 13654                                  ; 8107 - Unknown media type	- Drive doesn't support this function or
 13655                                  ;				  the media is really unkown, any error
 13656                                  ;				  other than "media not present"
 13657                                  ; 
 13658                                  ; ==========================================================================
 13659                                  
 13660                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13661                                  SenseMediaType:				
 13662 000012D7 C51E[1200]              		lds	bx, [ptrsav]	; DS:BX	points to request header.
 13663 000012DB C55F13                  		lds	bx, [bx+19]	; bx+IOCTL_REQ.GENERICIOCTL_PACKET]
 13664                                  		; 10/10/2022
 13665                                  		;mov	word [bx], 0	; Initialize the 2 packet bytes
 13666 000012DE 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 13667 000012E0 8917                    		mov	[bx], dx ; 0
 13668                                  		;
 13669 000012E2 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 13670                                  					; Get int 13h drive number from	BDS
 13671                                  		; 10/12/2022
 13672                                  		;xor	dh, dh		; DX = physical	drive number
 13673 000012E6 B420                    		mov	ah, 20h		; Get Media Type function
 13674                                  					; If no	carry media type in AL
 13675 000012E8 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - QCACHE	- DISMOUNT
 13676 000012EA 7216                    		jb	short MediaSenseEr ; error code	in AH
 13677 000012EC FE07                    		inc	byte [bx]	; Signal media type is default (bit 1)
 13678                                  DetermineMediaType:			
 13679 000012EE FEC8                    		dec	al
 13680 000012F0 3C02                    		cmp	al, 2		; Chk for 720K ie: (3-1) = 2
 13681 000012F2 740A                    		jz	short GotMediaType
 13682 000012F4 0404                    		add	al, 4
 13683 000012F6 3C07                    		cmp	al, 7		; Chk for 1.44M ie: (4-1+4) = 7
 13684 000012F8 7404                    		jz	short GotMediaType
 13685 000012FA 3C09                    		cmp	al, 9		; Chk for 2.88M	ie: (6-1+4) = 9
 13686 000012FC 7510                    		jnz	short UnknownMediaType ; Just didn't recognize media type
 13687                                  GotMediaType:				
 13688 000012FE 884701                  		mov	[bx+1],	al	; Save the return value
 13689                                  		; 10/12/2022
 13690                                  		; cf = 0
 13691                                  		;clc			; Signal success
 13692 00001301 C3                      		retn
 13693                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13694                                  
 13695                                  MediaSenseEr:				
 13696 00001302 80FC32                  		cmp	ah, 32h		; See if not default media error
 13697 00001305 74E7                    		jz	short DetermineMediaType ; Not really an error
 13698 00001307 B002                    		mov	al, 2		; Now assume drive not ready
 13699 00001309 80FC31                  		cmp	ah, 31h		; See if media was present
 13700 0000130C 7402                    		jz	short SenseErrExit ; Return drive not ready
 13701                                  UnknownMediaType:			
 13702 0000130E B007                    		mov	al, 7		; Just don't know the media type
 13703                                  SenseErrExit:				
 13704 00001310 B481                    		mov	ah, 81h		; Signal error return
 13705 00001312 F9                      		stc
 13706 00001313 C3                      		retn

 13713                                  ; 16/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 13714                                  
 13715                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13716                                  ; MSINT13.ASM - MSDOS 6.0 - 1991
 13717                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13718                                  ; 16/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 13719                                  
 13720                                  ;	int 2f function 13h allows the user to change the orig13 int_13 vector
 13721                                  ;	after booting. this allows testing and implementation of custom int_13
 13722                                  ;	handlers, without giving up ms-dos error recovery
 13723                                  ;	entry:	ds:dx	== addr. of new int_13 handler
 13724                                  ;		es:bx	== addr. of new int_13 vector used by warm boot (int19)
 13725                                  ;	exit:	orig13	== address of new int_13 handler
 13726                                  ;		ds:dx	== old orig13 value
 13727                                  ;		es:bx	== old old13  value
 13728                                  ;
 13729                                  ; int 2f handler for external block drivers to communicate with the internal
 13730                                  ; block driver in msdisk. the multiplex number chosen is 8. the handler
 13731                                  ; sets up the pointer to the request packet in [ptrsav] and then jumps to
 13732                                  ; dsk_entry, the entry point for all disk requests.
 13733                                  ;
 13734                                  ; on exit from this driver, we will return to the external driver
 13735                                  ; that issued this int 2f, and can then remove the flags from the stack.
 13736                                  ; this scheme allows us to have a small external device driver, and makes
 13737                                  ; the maintainance of the various drivers (driver and msbio) much easier,
 13738                                  ; since we only need to make changes in one place (most of the time).
 13739                                  ;
 13740                                  ;   ax=800h - check for installed handler - reserved
 13741                                  ;   ax=801h - install the bds into the linked list
 13742                                  ;   ax=802h - dos request
 13743                                  ;   ax=803h - return bds table starting pointer in ds:di
 13744                                  ;	   (ems device driver hooks int 13h to handle 16kb dma overrun
 13745                                  ;	    problem. bds table is going to be used to get head/sector
 13746                                  ;	    informations without calling generic ioctl get device parm call.)
 13747                                  
 13748                                  ;BIOSSEGMENT equ 70h
 13749                                  DOSBIOSSEG equ 0070h ; 17/10/2022	
 13750                                  
 13751                                  ;;BIOSCODE:1302h (MSDOS 6.21, IO.SYS)
 13752                                  
 13753                                  i2f_handler:				; here is 02C7h:1302h =	0070h:3872h
 13754 00001314 80FC13                  		cmp	ah, 13h
 13755 00001317 7413                    		jz	short int2f_replace_int13
 13756 00001319 80FC08                  		cmp	ah, 8
 13757 0000131C 7431                    		jz	short mine
 13758                                  
 13759                                  ; Check for WIN386 startup and return the BIOS instance data
 13760                                  
 13761 0000131E 80FC16                  		cmp	ah, 16h		; MultWin386
 13762 00001321 746C                    		jz	short win386call
 13763 00001323 80FC4A                  		cmp	ah, 4Ah		; multMULT
 13764 00001326 7503                    		jnz	short i2f_handler_iret
 13765 00001328 E99700                  		jmp	handle_multmult
 13766                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13767                                  
 13768                                  i2f_handler_iret:			
 13769 0000132B CF                      		iret
 13770                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13771                                  
 13772                                  int2f_replace_int13:
 13773 0000132C 50                      		push	ax	; free up a register for caller's ds
 13774 0000132D 8CD8                    		mov	ax, ds	; then we can use ds: -> Bios_Data
 13775                                  		;;mov	ds, word [cs:0030h] ; 15/10/2022	
 13776                                  		;mov	ds, word ptr cs:BIOSDATAWORD ; [cs:0030h]
 13777                                  					; = [02C7h:0030h] = [0070h:25A0h]
 13778 0000132F 2E8E1E[3000]            		mov	ds, [cs:BIOSDATAWORD] ; 17/10/2022
 13779                                  		; 19/10/2022
 13780                                  		;push	word ptr ds:Orig13	; save old value of old13 and
 13781                                  		;push	word ptr ds:Orig13+2	; orig13 so that we can
 13782                                  		;push	word ptr ds:Old13	; return them to caller
 13783                                  		;push	word ptr ds:Old13+2
 13784                                  		
 13785                                  		; 02/09/2023 (PCDOS 7.1)
 13786                                  		;push	word [Orig13]
 13787 00001334 FF36[B600]              		push	word [Orig13+2]
 13788                                  		;push	word [Old13]
 13789 00001338 FF36[0801]              		push	word [Old13+2]
 13790                                  
 13791                                  		;mov	word ptr ds:Orig13, dx	; orig13 := addr. of new int_13
 13792                                  		;mov	word ptr ds:Orig13+2, ax
 13793                                  		;mov	word ptr ds:Old13, bx	; old13 := addr. of new boot_13
 13794                                  		;mov	word ptr ds:Old13+2, es
 13795                                  		
 13796                                  		;mov	[Orig13], dx
 13797                                  		; 02/09/2023
 13798 0000133C 8716[B400]              		xchg	dx, [Orig13]
 13799 00001340 A3[B600]                		mov	[Orig13+2], ax
 13800                                  		;mov	[Old13], bx
 13801                                  		; 02/09/2023
 13802 00001343 871E[0601]              		xchg	bx, [Old13]
 13803 00001347 8C06[0801]              		mov	[Old13+2], es
 13804                                  
 13805 0000134B 07                      		pop	es			; es:bx := old old13 vector
 13806                                  		; 02/09/2023
 13807                                  		;pop	bx
 13808 0000134C 1F                      		pop	ds			; ds:dx := old orig13 vector
 13809                                  		;pop	dx ; 02/09/2023
 13810 0000134D 58                      		pop	ax
