 14015                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14016                                  ;
 14017                                  ; procedure : HMAPtr
 14018                                  ;
 14019                                  ;		Gets the offset of the free HMA area ( with respect to
 14020                                  ;							seg ffff )
 14021                                  ;		If DOS has not moved high, tries to move DOS high.
 14022                                  ;		In the course of doing this, it will allocate all the HMA
 14023                                  ;		and set the FreeHMAPtr to past the end of the BIOS and 
 14024                                  ;		DOS code. The call to MoveDOSIntoHMA (which is a pointer)
 14025                                  ;		enters the routine in sysinit1 called FTryToMovDOSHi.
 14026                                  ;
 14027                                  ;	RETURNS : offset of free HMA in DI
 14028                                  ;		  BIOS_DATA, seg in DS
 14029                                  ;
 14030                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14031                                  
 14032                                  		; 17/10/2022
 14033                                  HMAPtr:
 14034 0000140F 2E8E1E[3000]            		mov	ds, [cs:BIOSDATAWORD]
 14035                                  		;mov	ds, word ptr cs:BIOSDATAWORD ; [cs:Bios_Data_Word]
 14036 00001414 8B3E[8C08]              		mov	di, [FreeHMAPtr]
 14037                                  		;mov	di, ds:FreeHMAPtr
 14038 00001418 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 14039 0000141B 750F                    		jnz	short HMAPtr_retn
 14040 0000141D 803E[9208]00            		cmp	byte [SysinitPresent], 0
 14041                                  		;cmp	ds:SysinitPresent, 0
 14042 00001422 7408                    		jz	short HMAPtr_retn
 14043 00001424 FF1E[8E08]              		call	far [MoveDOSIntoHMA]
 14044                                  		;call	ds:MoveDOSIntoHMA ; call far [MoveDOSIntoHMA]
 14045 00001428 8B3E[8C08]              		mov	di, [FreeHMAPtr]
 14046                                  		;mov	di, ds:FreeHMAPtr
 14047                                  HMAPtr_retn:				
 14048 0000142C C3                      		retn
 14049                                  
 14050                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 14051                                  
 14052                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14053                                  
 14054                                  ; move a 512 byte sector from ds:si to es:di, do not trash cx
 14055                                  ; but go ahead and update direction flag, si, & di
 14056                                  
 14057                                  move_sector:
 14058                                  
 14059                                  ; The 80386 microprocessor considers an access to WORD 0FFFFh in
 14060                                  ; any segment to be a fault. Theoretically, this could be handled
 14061                                  ; by the fault handler and the behavior of an 8086 could be emulated
 14062                                  ; by wrapping the high byte to offset 0000h. This would be a lot
 14063                                  ; of work and was, indeed, blown off by the Win386 guys. COMPAQ
 14064                                  ; also handles the fault incorrectly in their ROM BIOS for real
 14065                                  ; mode. Their fault handler was only designed to deal with one
 14066                                  ; special case which occurred in a magazine benchmark, but didn't
 14067                                  ; handle the general case worth beans.
 14068                                  ;
 14069                                  ; Simply changing this code to do a byte loop would work okay but
 14070                                  ; would involve a general case performance hit. Therefore, we'll
 14071                                  ; check for either source or destination offsets being within one
 14072                                  ; sector of the end of their segments and only in that case fall
 14073                                  ; back to a byte move.
 14074                                  
 14075 0000142D FC                      		cld
 14076 0000142E 51                      		push	cx
 14077 0000142F B90001                  		mov	cx, 256
 14078 00001432 81FE00FE                		cmp	si, 0FE00h
 14079 00001436 770A                    		ja	short movsec_bytes
 14080 00001438 81FF00FE                		cmp	di, 0FE00h
 14081 0000143C 7704                    		ja	short movsec_bytes
 14082 0000143E F3A5                    		rep movsw
 14083 00001440 59                      		pop	cx
 14084 00001441 C3                      		retn
 14085                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14086                                  
 14087                                  movsec_bytes:				
 14088 00001442 D1E1                    		shl	cx, 1
 14089 00001444 F3A4                    		rep movsb
 14090 00001446 59                      		pop	cx
 14091 00001447 C3                      		retn
 14092                                  
 14093                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 14094                                  
 14095                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14096                                  
 14097                                  ; check_wrap is a routine that adjusts the starting sector, starting head
 14098                                  ; and starting cylinder for an int 13 request that requests i/o of a lot
 14099                                  ; of sectors. it only does this for fixed disks. it is used in the sections
 14100                                  ; of code that handle ecc errors and dma errors. it is necessary, because
 14101                                  ; ordinarily the rom would take care of wraps around heads and cylinders,
 14102                                  ; but we break down a request when we get an ecc or dma error into several
 14103                                  ; i/o of one or more sectors. in this case, we may already be beyond the
 14104                                  ; number of sectors on a track on the medium, and the request would fail.
 14105                                  ;
 14106                                  ; input conditions:
 14107                                  ;	all registers set up for an int 13 request.
 14108                                  ;
 14109                                  ; output:
 14110                                  ;	dh - contains starting head number for request
 14111                                  ;	cx - contains starting sector and cylinder numbers
 14112                                  ;	(the above may or may not have been changed, and are 0-based)
 14113                                  ;	all other registers preserved.
 14114                                  
 14115                                  check_wrap:	
 14116 00001448 50                      		push	ax
 14117 00001449 53                      		push	bx
 14118 0000144A 06                      		push	es
 14119 0000144B 57                      		push	di
 14120 0000144C E86C00                  		call	find_bds	; get pointer to bds for drive in dl
 14121 0000144F 725E                    		jb	short no_wrap	; finished if DOS doesn't use it
 14122                                  		; 12/12/2022
 14123 00001451 26F6452301              		test	byte [es:di+23h], 1
 14124                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 1 ; [es:di+BDS.flags],fnon_removable
 14125 00001456 7457                    		jz	short no_wrap	; no wrapping for removable media
 14126 00001458 268B5D13                		mov	bx, [es:di+13h]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 14127 0000145C 89C8                    		mov	ax, cx
 14128 0000145E 83E03F                  		and	ax, 3Fh		; extract sector number
 14129 00001461 39D8                    		cmp	ax, bx		; are we going to wrap?
 14130 00001463 764A                    		jbe	short no_wrap
 14131 00001465 F6F3                    		div	bl		; ah=new sector	#, al=#	of head	wraps
 14132                                  
 14133                                  ; we need to be careful here. if the new sector # is 0, then we are on the
 14134                                  ; last sector on that track.
 14135                                  
 14136 00001467 08E4                    		or	ah, ah
 14137 00001469 7503                    		jnz	short not_on_bound
 14138                                  		; 18/12/2022
 14139 0000146B 48                      		dec	ax ; *
 14140 0000146C 88DC                    		mov	ah, bl		; set sector=BDS_BPB.BPB_SECTORSPERTRACK
 14141                                  					; if on	boundary
 14142                                  		;dec	al ; *		; also decrement # of head wraps
 14143                                  not_on_bound:
 14144 0000146E 80E1C0                  		and	cl, 0C0h	; zero out sector #
 14145 00001471 08E1                    		or	cl, ah		; or in	new sector #
 14146 00001473 30E4                    		xor	ah, ah		; ax = # of head wraps
 14147 00001475 40                      		inc	ax
 14148 00001476 00F0                    		add	al, dh		; add in starting head #
 14149 00001478 80D400                  		adc	ah, 0		; catch	any carry
 14150                                  		; 02/09/2023
 14151 0000147B 268B5D15                		mov	bx, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14152 0000147F 39D8                    		cmp	ax, bx
 14153                                  		;cmp	ax, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14154                                  					; are we going to wrap around a	head?
 14155 00001481 7632                    		jbe	short no_wrap_head ; do	not lose new head number!!
 14156 00001483 52                      		push	dx		; preserve drive number and head number
 14157 00001484 31D2                    		xor	dx, dx
 14158                                  		;mov	bx, [es:di+15h]	; [es:di+BDS.heads]
 14159 00001486 F7F3                    		div	bx		; dx=new head #, ax=# of cylinder wraps
 14160                                  
 14161                                  ; careful here! if new head # is 0, then we are on the last head.
 14162                                  
 14163 00001488 09D2                    		or	dx, dx
 14164 0000148A 7507                    		jnz	short no_head_bound
 14165 0000148C 89DA                    		mov	dx, bx		; on boundary. set to BDS_BPB.BPB_HEADS
 14166                                  
 14167                                  ; if we had some cylinder wraps, we need to reduce them by one!!
 14168                                  
 14169 0000148E 09C0                    		or	ax, ax
 14170 00001490 7401                    		jz	short no_head_bound
 14171 00001492 48                      		dec	ax		; reduce number	of cylinder wraps
 14172                                  no_head_bound:				
 14173 00001493 88D7                    		mov	bh, dl		; bh has new head number
 14174 00001495 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore drive number and head number
 14175 00001496 FECF                    		dec	bh		; get it 0-based
 14176 00001498 88FE                    		mov	dh, bh		; set up new head number in dh
 14177 0000149A 88CF                    		mov	bh, cl
 14178 0000149C 80E73F                  		and	bh, 3Fh		; preserve sector number
 14179 0000149F B306                    		mov	bl, 6
 14180 000014A1 86CB                    		xchg	cl, bl
 14181 000014A3 D2EB                    		shr	bl, cl		; get ms cylinder bits to ls end
 14182 000014A5 00C5                    		add	ch, al		; add in cylinder wrap
 14183 000014A7 10E3                    		adc	bl, ah		; add in high byte
 14184 000014A9 D2E3                    		shl	bl, cl		; move up to ms	end
 14185 000014AB 86D9                    		xchg	bl, cl		; restore cylinder bits	into cl
 14186 000014AD 08F9                    		or	cl, bh		; or in	sector number
 14187                                  no_wrap:				
 14188 000014AF F8                      		clc
 14189 000014B0 5F                      		pop	di
 14190 000014B1 07                      		pop	es
 14191 000014B2 5B                      		pop	bx
 14192 000014B3 58                      		pop	ax
 14193 000014B4 C3                      		retn
 14194                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14195                                  
 14196                                  no_wrap_head:				
 14197 000014B5 88C6                    		mov	dh, al		; do not lose new head number
 14198 000014B7 FECE                    		dec	dh		; get it 0-based
 14199 000014B9 EBF4                    		jmp	short no_wrap
 14200

 14202                                  
 14203                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14204                                  
 14205                                  ; this is a special version of the bds lookup code which is
 14206                                  ; based on physical drives rather than the usual logical drives
 14207                                  ; carry is set if the physical drive in dl is found, es:di -> its bds
 14208                                  ; otherwise carry is clear
 14209                                  ;
 14210                                  ; guaranteed to trash no registers except es:di
 14211                                  
 14212                                  		; 19/10/2022
 14213                                  find_bds:	
 14214 000014BB C43E[1901]              		les	di, [start_bds]	; point es:di to first bds
 14215                                  fbds_1:					
 14216 000014BF 26385504                		cmp	[es:di+4], dl	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 14217 000014C3 7409                    		jz	short fdbs_2
 14218 000014C5 26C43D                  		les	di, [es:di]	; [es:di+BDS.link]
 14219                                  					; go to next bds
 14220 000014C8 83FFFF                  		cmp	di, 0FFFFh
 14221 000014CB 75F2                    		jnz	short fbds_1
 14222 000014CD F9                      		stc
 14223                                  fdbs_2:					
 14224 000014CE C3                      		retn

 14254 000014E5 8F4610                  		pop	word [bp+10h]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.oldf]
 14255                                  		;db	8Fh, 86h, 10h, 0 ; pop word [bp+10h]
 14256                                  dointdone:				
 14257 000014E8 C3                      		retn

 14259                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14260                                  
 14261                                  ; 16/10/2022
 14262                                  
 14263                                  ; this is the true int 13 handler. we parse the request to see if there is
 14264                                  ; a dma violation. if so, depending on the function, we:
 14265                                  ;   read/write break the request into three pieces and move the middle one
 14266                                  ;	       into our internal buffer.
 14267                                  ;
 14268                                  ;   format     copy the format table into the buffer
 14269                                  ;   verify     point the transfer address into the buffer
 14270                                  ;
 14271                                  ; this is the biggest bogosity of all. the ibm controller does not handle
 14272                                  ; operations that cross physical 64k boundaries. in these cases, we copy
 14273                                  ; the offending sector into the buffer below and do the i/o from there.
 14274                                  
 14275                                  ;struc INT13FRAME
 14276                                  ;.oldbp: resw
 14277                                  ;.oldax: resw 
 14278                                  ;.oldbx: resw
 14279                                  ;.oldcx: resw
 14280                                  ;.olddx: resw
 14281                                  ;.oldds: resw	; now we save caller's ds, too
 14282                                  ;.olddd: resd
 14283                                  ;.oldf:	resw
 14284                                  ;end struc
 14285                                  
 14286                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14287                                  
 14288                                  ;   entry conditions:
 14289                                  ;	ah = function
 14290                                  ;	al = number of sectors
 14291                                  ;	es:bx = dma address
 14292                                  ;	cx = packed track and sector
 14293                                  ;	dx = head and drive
 14294                                  ;   output conditions:
 14295                                  ;	no dma violation.
 14296                                  
 14297                                  ;	use extreme caution when working with this code. In general,
 14298                                  ;	  all registers are hot at all times.
 14299                                  ;
 14300                                  ;	question:  does this code handle cases where dma errors
 14301                                  ;	  occur during ecc retries, and where ecc errors occur during
 14302                                  ;	  dma breakdowns???? Hmmmmm.
 14303                                  
 14304                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14305                                  
 14306                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14307                                  
 14308 000014E9 90004000                dtype_array:	dd 400090h		; 40:90	is drive type array
 14309                                  
 14310                                  ; 17/10/2022
 14311                                  ;DTYPEARRAY equ dtype_array - DOSBIOSEG_2C7h ; (14F5h for MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 14312                                  ; 09/12/2022
 14313                                  DTYPEARRAY equ dtype_array

 14497                                  loop_ecc:
 14498 000015B3 B80102                  		mov	ax, 201h	; read one sector
 14499                                  
 14500                                  ; we do reads one sector at a time. this ensures that we will eventually
 14501                                  ; finish the request since ecc errors on one sector do read in that sector.
 14502                                  ;

 14504                                  ; that attempt to read more sectors than are available on a particular

 14508                                  ; this request.

 14587                                  ; we truly have a dma violation. restore register ax and retry the
 14588                                  ; operation as best we can.

 14590                                  gotdmaerr:

 14592 00001609 FB                      		sti

 14595                                  					; just pass dma error thru for
 14596                                  					; functions we don't handle

 14598 00001612 743C                    		jz	short intverify

 14600 00001617 7448                    		jz	short intformat
 14601 00001619 772F                    		ja	short i13_done_dmaerr
 14602                                  
 14603                                  ; we are doing a read/write call. check for dma problems
 14604                                  
 14605                                  ;	******** set up stack frame here!!! ********
 14606                                  
 14607 0000161B 52                      		push	dx
 14608 0000161C 51                      		push	cx
 14609 0000161D 53                      		push	bx
 14610 0000161E 50                      		push	ax
 14611 0000161F 55                      		push	bp
 14612 00001620 89E5                    		mov	bp, sp
 14613 00001622 8CC2                    		mov	dx, es		; check	for 64k	boundary error
 14614 00001624 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 14615 00001626 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 14616 00001628 D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1
 14617 0000162A D1E2                    		shl	dx, 1		; segment converted to absolute	address
 14618 0000162C 01DA                    		add	dx, bx		; combine with offset
 14619 0000162E 81C2FF01                		add	dx, 511		; simulate a transfer
 14620                                  
 14621                                  ; if carry is set, then we are within 512 bytes of the end of the segment.
 14622                                  ; we skip the first transfer and perform the remaining buffering and transfer
 14623

 14625 00001634 E98300                  		jmp	bufferx		; restore dh=head & do buffer
 14626                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14627                                  
 14628                                  no_skip_first:

 14630 00001639 B480                    		mov	ah, 128		; ah = max number of sectors in	segment
 14631 0000163B 28F4                    		sub	ah, dh
 14632                                  
 14633                                  ; ah is now the number of sectors that we can successfully write in this
 14634                                  ; segment. if this number is above or equal to the requested number, then we
 14635                                  ; continue the operation as normal. otherwise, we break it into pieces.
 14636                                  ;
 14637                                  ; wait a sec. this is goofy. the whole reason we got here in the
 14638                                  ; first place is because we got a dma error. so it's impossible
 14639                                  ; for the whole block to fit, unless the dma error was returned
 14640                                  ; in error.
 14641                                  
 14642 0000163D 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; can we fit it	in?
 14643 0000163F 7236                    		jb	short doblock	; no, perform blocking.
 14644

 14646                                  
 14647 00001641 8A7609                  		mov	dh, [bp+9]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx+1]
 14648                                  					; set up head number
 14649 00001644 E888FE                  		call	doint

 14657                                  					; we know it's not a changeline error

 14667                                  dosimple:

 14669                                  					; do the i/o from Bios_Data:disksector
 14670                                  		;;call	far 70:797h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS BIOSCODE:1665h
 14671                                  		; 17/10/2022

 14678                                  
 14679                                  ; format operation. copy the parameter table into Bios_Data:disksector
 14680                                  
 14681                                  intformat:
 14682 00001661 06                      		push	es
 14683 00001662 53                      		push	bx
 14684 00001663 56                      		push	si
 14685 00001664 57                      		push	di
 14686 00001665 1E                      		push	ds
 14687                                  
 14688                                  ; point ds to the caller's dma buffer, es to Bios_Data
 14689                                  ; in other words, swap (ds, es)
 14690

 14692 00001667 1E                      		push	ds
 14693 00001668 07                      		pop	es

 14696 0000166C BF[4E01]                		mov	di, disksector
 14697 0000166F E8BBFD                  		call	move_sector	; user's data into Bios_Data:disksector

 14699 00001673 5F                      		pop	di
 14700 00001674 5E                      		pop	si		; do the i/o from
 14701 00001675 EBDD                    		jmp	short dosimple	; Bios_Data:disksector
 14702                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14703                                  
 14704                                  ; we can't fit the request into the entire block. perform the operation on
 14705                                  ; the first block.
 14706                                  ;
 14707                                  ; doblock is modified to correctly handle multi-sector disk i/o.
 14708                                  ; old doblock had added the number of sectors i/oed (ah in old doblock) after
 14709                                  ; the doint call to cl. observing only the lower 6 bits of cl(=max. 64) can
 14710                                  ; represent a starting sector, if ah was big, then cl would be clobbered.
 14711                                  ; by the way, we still are going to use cl for this purpose since checkwrap
 14712                                  ; routine will use it as an input. to prevent cl from being clobbered, a
 14713                                  ; safe number of sectors should be calculated like "63 - # of sectors/track".
 14714                                  ; doblock will handle the first block of requested sectors within the
 14715                                  ; boundary of this safe value.
 14716                                  
 14717                                  doblock:
 14718                                  
 14719                                  ; try to get the # of sectors/track from bds via rom drive number.
 14720                                  ; for any mini disks installed, here we have to pray that they have the
 14721                                  ; same # of sector/track as the main dos partition disk drive.
 14722                                  				
 14723 00001677 8B5608                  		mov	dx, [bp+8]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.olddx]
 14724                                  					; get head #, drive #
 14725 0000167A 51                      		push	cx
 14726 0000167B 06                      		push	es
 14727 0000167C 57                      		push	di		; ah - # of sectors before dma boundary
 14728                                  					; al - requested # of sectors for i/o.
 14729 0000167D E83BFE                  		call	find_bds
 14730 00001680 268B4D13                		mov	cx, [es:di+13h]	; [es:di+BDS.secpertrack]
 14731                                  		; 12/12/2022

 14733                                  		;test	word [es:di+23h], 1 ; [es:di+BDS.flags],fnon_removable

 14739 00001691 28CC                    		sub	ah, cl		; al - # of sectors before dma boundary
 14740                                  doblockflop:

 14742                                  doblockcontinue:

 14744 00001696 7305                    		jnb	short doblocklast ; then #_of_sectors_to_go as it is for doint.

 14749                                  
 14750                                  doblocklast:

 14756 000016A5 58                      		pop	ax

 14758                                  					; decrement by the successful operation
 14759 000016A9 00E1                    		add	cl, ah		; advance sector #. safety gauranteed.
 14760 000016AB 00E7                    		add	bh, ah		; advance dma addres
 14761 000016AD 00E7                    		add	bh, ah		; twice	for 512	byte sectors
 14762 000016AF 38C4                    		cmp	ah, al		; check	the previous value
 14763 000016B1 740A                    		jz	short buffer	; if #_of_sectors_to_go	< safe_#,
 14764                                  					; then we are done already.

 14766                                  					; #_sector_to_go = #_of_sector_to_go - safe_#

 14769                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 14770                                  
 14771                                  bufferx:

 14773                                  					; set up head number
 14774                                  buffer:
 14775 000016BD 53                      		push	bx
 14776 000016BE 8A6603                  		mov	ah, [bp+3]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax+1]
 14777 000016C1 80FC03                  		cmp	ah, 3		; romwrite
 14778 000016C4 7525                    		jnz	short doread	;

 14781

 14847                                  ; note the fact that we've done 1 more sector
 14848                                  
 14849                                  dotail:

 14851 0000170E 80C702                  		add	bh, 2		; advance over sector
 14852 00001711 41                      		inc	cx
 14853 00001712 8A4602                  		mov	al, [bp+2]	; [bp+INT13FRAME.oldax]
 14854 00001715 F8                      		clc
 14855 00001716 FEC8                    		dec	al
 14856 00001718 7409                    		jz	short bad13	; no more i/o

 14859                                  ; we already have the correct head number to pass to check_wrap
 14860

 14863 00001720 E8ACFD                  		call	doint

 14865                                  ; we are done. ax has the final code; we throw away what we got before
 14866                                  
 14867                                  ; M046  -- okay gang. Now we've either terminated our DMA loop,
 14868                                  ;	   or we've finished. If carry is set now, our only
 14869                                  ;	   hope for salvation is that it was a read operation
 14870                                  ;	   and the error code is ECC error. In that case, we'll
 14871                                  ;	   just pop the registers and go do the old ECC thing.

 14873                                  ;	   place occurs, it'll handle it.

 15088                                  
 15089                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15090                                  ; at media check time, we need to really get down and check what the change is.
 15091                                  ; this is guaranteed to be expensive.
 15092                                  ;
 15093                                  ;	es:di -> bds, ds -> Bios_Data
 15094                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15095                                  
 15096                                  mediacheck:	
 15097 0000180A E8BCF0                  		call	checksingle	; make sure correct disk is in place
 15098 0000180D 31F6                    		xor	si, si
 15099 0000180F E84D01                  		call	haschange
 15100 00001812 742F                    		jz	short mediaret
 15101 00001814 E83C01                  		call	checkromchange
 15102 00001817 752B                    		jnz	short mediadovolid
 15103 00001819 50                      		push	ax
 15104 0000181A 52                      		push	dx
 15105 0000181B 268A5504                		mov	dl, [es:di+4]	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 15106                                  					; set logical drive number
 15107 0000181F B416                    		mov	ah, 16h
 15108 00001821 CD13                    		int	13h		; DISK - FLOPPY	DISK - CHANGE OF DISK STATUS (AT,XT2,XT286,CONV,PS)
 15109                                  					; DL = drive to	check
 15110                                  					; Return: AH = disk change status
 15111 00001823 5A                      		pop	dx
 15112 00001824 58                      		pop	ax
 15113 00001825 721D                    		jb	short mediadovolid
 15114 00001827 BE0100                  		mov	si, 1		; signal no change
 15115                                  
 15116                                  ; there are some drives with changeline that "lose" the changeline indication
 15117                                  ; if a different drive is accessed after the current one. in order to avoid
 15118                                  ; missing a media change, we return an "i don't know" to dos if the changeline
 15119                                  ; is not active and we are accessing a different drive from the last one.
 15120                                  ; if we are accessing the same drive, then we can safely rely on the changeline
 15121                                  ; status.
 15122                                  		; 19/10/2022
 15123 0000182A 8A1E[1E01]              		mov	bl, [tim_drv]	; get last drive accessed
 15124 0000182E 26385D04                		cmp	[es:di+4], bl	; [es:di+BDS.drivenum]
 15125                                  					; (If the last drive accessed is not current drive
 15126                                  					; media	change status may be incorrect.	So,
 15127                                  					; "I don't now" will be returned even if it is indicated
 15128                                  					; as media is not changed.)
 15129 00001832 740F                    		jz	short mediaret	; (same	drive,
 15130                                  					; media	changeline indication is reliable)
 15131                                  
 15132                                  ; do the 2 second twiddle. if time >= 2 seconds, do a volid check.
 15133                                  ; otherwise return "i don't know" (strictly speaking, we should return a
 15134                                  ; "not changed" here since the 2 second test said no change.)
 15135                                  
 15136 00001834 50                      		push	ax
 15137 00001835 51                      		push	cx
 15138 00001836 52                      		push	dx
 15139 00001837 E8B6ED                  		call	Check_Time_Of_Access
 15140 0000183A 5A                      		pop	dx
 15141 0000183B 59                      		pop	cx
 15142 0000183C 58                      		pop	ax
 15143 0000183D 09F6                    		or	si, si
 15144 0000183F 7403                    		jz	short mediadovolid ; check_time	says ">= 2 secs	passed"
 15145                                  					; (volume id will be checked)
 15146 00001841 31F6                    		xor	si, si		; return "i don't know"
 15147                                  mediaret:				
 15148 00001843 C3                      		retn
 15149                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15150                                  
 15151                                  ; somehow the media was changed. look at vid to see. we do not look at fat
 15152                                  ; because this may be different since we only set medbyt when doing a read
 15153                                  ; or write.
 15154                                  
 15155                                  mediadovolid:				
 15156 00001844 E849EE                  		call	GetBp		; build	a new bpb in current bds
 15157 00001847 72FA                    		jb	short mediaret
 15158 00001849 E82D00                  		call	check_vid
 15159 0000184C 73F5                    		jnb	short mediaret
 15160 0000184E E9FDF3                  		jmp	maperror	; fix up al for	return to dos
 15161                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15162                                  
 15163                                  ; simple, quick check of latched change. if no indication, then return
 15164                                  ; otherwise do expensive check. if the expensive test fails, pop off the
 15165                                  ; return and set al = 15 (for invalid media change) which will be returned to
 15166                                  ; dos.
 15167                                  ;
 15168                                  ; for dos 3.3, this will work only for the drive that has changeline.
 15169                                  
 15170                                  ;	call with es:di -> bds, ds -> Bios_Data
 15171                                  ;	***** warning:  this routine will return one level up on the stack
 15172                                  ;			if an error occurs!
 15173                                  
 15174                                  checklatchio:	
 15175                                  
 15176                                  ; if returning fake bpb then assume the disk has not changed
 15177                                  			
 15178 00001851 E8B0FF                  		call	chkopcnt
 15179 00001854 741B                    		jz	short checkret	; done if zero
 15180                                  
 15181                                  ; check for past rom indications. if no rom change indicated, then return ok.
 15182                                  
 15183 00001856 E8FA00                  		call	checkromchange
 15184 00001859 7416                    		jz	short checkret
 15185                                  
 15186                                  ; we now see that a change line has been seen in the past. let's do the
 15187                                  ; expensive verification.
 15188                                  
 15189 0000185B E832EE                  		call	GetBp		; build	bpb in current bds
 15190 0000185E 720F                    		jb	short ret_no_error_map ; getbp has already called maperror
 15191 00001860 E81600                  		call	check_vid
 15192 00001863 7207                    		jb	short checklatchret ; disk error trying	to read	in.
 15193 00001865 09F6                    		or	si, si		; is changed for sure?
 15194 00001867 7908                    		jns	short checkret
 15195 00001869 E87B00                  		call	returnvid
 15196                                  checklatchret:				
 15197 0000186C E8DFF3                  		call	maperror	; fix up al for	return to dos
 15198                                  ret_no_error_map:			
 15199 0000186F F9                      		stc
 15200 00001870 5E                      		pop	si		; pop off return address
 15201                                  checkret:				
 15202 00001871 C3                      		retn
 15203                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15204                                  
 15205                                  ; check the fat and the vid. return in di -1 or 0. return with carry set
 15206                                  ; only if there was a disk error. return that error code in ax.
 15207                                  ;
 15208                                  ;	called with es:di -> bds, ds -> Bios_Data
 15209                                  
 15210                                  checkfatvid:				
 15211 00001872 E8BC01                  		call	fat_check	; check	the fat	and the	vid
 15212 00001875 09F6                    		or	si, si
 15213 00001877 7827                    		js	short changed_drv ;
 15214                                  
 15215                                  ; the fat was the same. fall into check_vid and check volume id.
 15216                                  
 15217                                  		; fall into check_vid
 15218                                  
 15219                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 15220                                  
 15221                                  ; now with the extended boot record, the logic should be enhanced.
 15222                                  ;
 15223                                  ; if it is the extended boot record, then we check the volume serial
 15224                                  ; number instead of volume id. if it is different, then set si to -1.
 15225                                  ;
 15226                                  ; if it is same, then si= 1 (no change).
 15227                                  ;
 15228                                  ; if it is not the extended boot record, then just follows the old
 15229                                  ; logic. dos 4.00 will check if the # of fat in the boot record bpb
 15230                                  ; is not 0.  if it is 0 then it must be non_fat based system and
 15231                                  ; should have already covered by extended boot structure checking.
 15232                                  ; so, we will return "i don't know" by setting si to 0.
 15233                                  ;
 15234                                  ; this routine assume the newest valid boot record is in cs:[disksector].
 15235                                  ; (this will be gauranteed by a successful getbp call right before this
 15236                                  ; routine.)
 15237                                  ;
 15238                                  ;	called with es:di -> bds, ds -> bds
 15239                                  
 15240                                  		; 19/10/2022
 15241                                  check_vid:
 15242                                  
 15243                                  ; check the disksector.EXT_BOOT_SIG variable for the extended
 15244                                  ; boot signature. if it is set then go to do the extended
 15245                                  ; id check otherwise continue with code below
 15246                                  
 15247 00001879 803E[7401]29            		cmp	byte [disksector+26h], 29h
 15248                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.SIG],
 15249                                  					; EXT_BOOT_SIGNATURE
 15250 0000187E 7427                    		jz	short do_ext_check_id
 15251 00001880 E8DC00                  		call	haschange
 15252 00001883 74EC                    		jz	short checkret
 15253 00001885 31F6                    		xor	si, si
 15254 00001887 803E[5E01]00            		cmp	byte [disksector+10h], 0 
 15255                                  					; [disksector+EXT_BOOT.BPB+EBPB.NUMBEROFFATS]
 15256 0000188C 7411                    		jz	short checkfatret ; don't read vol id
 15257                                  					; if not fat system
 15258 0000188E E8EE00                  		call	read_volume_id
 15259 00001891 720C                    		jb	short checkfatret
 15260 00001893 E89201                  		call	check_volume_id
 15261 00001896 BEFFFF                  		mov	si, 0FFFFh	; -1
 15262                                  					; definitely changed
 15263 00001899 7505                    		jnz	short changed_drv
 15264                                  
 15265 0000189B 46                      		inc	si		; not changed
 15266                                  vid_no_changed:				
 15267 0000189C E8BA00                  		call	resetchanged
 15268                                  		; 12/12/2022
 15269                                  		; cf=0 ('and' instruction in 'resetchanged' clears cf) 
 15270                                  		;clc
 15271                                  checkfatret:				
 15272 0000189F C3                      		retn
 15273                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15274                                  
 15275                                  		; 12/12/2022
 15276                                  changed_drv:
 15277 000018A0 F8                      		clc			; cas -- return	no error
 15278 000018A1 C606[1E01]FF            		mov	byte  [tim_drv], 0FFh 
 15279                                  					; ensure that we ask rom for media
 15280 000018A6 C3                      		retn			; check	next time round
 15281                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15282                                  
 15283                                  ; extended id check
 15284                                  
 15285                                  ; 16/10/2022
 15286                                  
 15287                                  ; the code to check extended id is basically a check to see if the
 15288                                  ; volume serial number is still the same. the volume serial number
 15289                                  ; previously read is in cs:disksector.EXT_BOOT_SERIAL
 15290                                  ; ds:di points to the bds of the drive under consideration.
 15291                                  ; the bds has fields containing the high and low words 
 15292                                  ; of the volume serial number of the media in the drive.
 15293                                  ; compare these fields to the fields mentioned above. if these fields
 15294                                  ; do not match the media has changed and so we should jump to the code
 15295                                  ; starting at ext_changed else return "i don't know" status
 15296                                  ; in the register used for the changeline status and continue executing
 15297                                  ; the code given below. for temporary storage use the register which
 15298                                  ; has been saved and restored around this block.
 15299                                  ;
 15300                                  ; bds fields in inc\msbds.inc
 15301                                  
 15302                                  		; 19/10/2022
 15303                                  do_ext_check_id:
 15304 000018A7 50                      		push	ax
 15305                                  		;mov	ax, word ptr ds:disksector+27h
 15306                                  					; [DiskSector+EXT_BOOT.SERIAL]
 15307 000018A8 A1[7501]                		mov	ax, [disksector+27h]
 15308                                  		; 02/09/2023
 15309 000018AB 31F6                    		xor	si, si ; 0
 15310 000018AD 263B4557                		cmp	ax, [es:di+57h]	; [di+BDS.vol_serial]
 15311 000018B1 750C                    		jnz	short ext_changed
 15312 000018B3 A1[7701]                		mov	ax, [disksector+29h] ; [DiskSector+EXT_BOOT.SERIAL+2]
 15313 000018B6 263B4559                		cmp	ax, [es:di+59h]	; [di+BDS.vol_serial+2]
 15314 000018BA 7503                    		jnz	short ext_changed
 15315                                  		;xor	si, si		; 0
 15316                                  					; don't know
 15317 000018BC 58                      		pop	ax
 15318 000018BD EBDD                    		jmp	short vid_no_changed
 15319                                  					; reset the flag
 15320                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15321                                  
 15322                                  ext_changed:
 15323 000018BF 58                      		pop	ax
 15324                                  		; 02/09/2023
 15325 000018C0 4E                      		dec	si ; mov si, 0FFFFh ; -1
 15326                                  		;mov	si, 0FFFFh	; -1
 15327                                  					; disk changed!
 15328                                  		; 12/12/2022
 15329                                  		; ('changed_drv' clears cf)
 15330                                  		;clc
 15331 000018C1 EBDD                    		jmp	short changed_drv
 15332                                  
 15333                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15334                                  
 15335                                  ; at i/o time, we detected the error. now we need to determine whether the
 15336                                  ; media was truly changed or not. we return normally if media change unknown.
 15337                                  ; and we pop off the call and jmp to harderr if we see an error.
 15338                                  ;
 15339                                  ; es:di -> bds
 15340                                  
 15341                                  checkio:				
 15342 000018C3 80FC06                  		cmp	ah, 6
 15343 000018C6 75D7                    		jnz	short checkfatret
 15344 000018C8 E839FF                  		call	chkopcnt
 15345 000018CB 74D2                    		jz	short checkfatret
 15346 000018CD E8C0ED                  		call	GetBp
 15347 000018D0 7212                    		jb	short no_error_map
 15348 000018D2 E89DFF                  		call	checkfatvid
 15349 000018D5 7209                    		jb	short checkioret ; disk	error trying to	read in.
 15350 000018D7 09F6                    		or	si, si		; is changed for sure?
 15351 000018D9 7802                    		js	short checkioerr ; yes changed
 15352 000018DB 45                      		inc	bp		; allow	a retry
 15353 000018DC C3                      		retn
 15354                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15355                                  
 15356                                  checkioerr:				
 15357 000018DD E80700                  		call	returnvid
 15358                                  
 15359                                  checkioret:				
 15360 000018E0 F9                      		stc			; make sure carry gets passed through
 15361 000018E1 E91BF3                  		jmp	harderr
 15362                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15363                                  
 15364                                  no_error_map:				
 15365 000018E4 E91BF3                  		jmp	harderr2
 15366                                  
 15367                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 15368                                  
 15369                                  ; return vid sets up the vid for a return to dos.
 15370                                  ;  es:di -> bds, returns pointer in packet to bds_volid
 15371                                  ;  **** trashes si! ****
 15372                                  
 15373                                  returnvid:		
 15374 000018E7 BE1600                  		mov	si, 22		; extra
 15375                                  					; offset into pointer to return	value
 15376 000018EA E80700                  		call	vid_into_packet
 15377 000018ED B406                    		mov	ah, 6
 15378 000018EF F9                      		stc
 15379 000018F0 C3                      		retn
 15380                                  
 15381                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15382                                  
 15383                                  ; moves the pointer to the volid for the drive into the original request packet
 15384                                  ; no attempt is made to preserve registers.
 15385                                  ;
 15386                                  ; assumes es:di -> bds
 15387                                  ; **trashes si**
 15388                                  
 15389                                  media_set_vid:				
 15390 000018F1 BE0F00                  		mov	si, 15		; trans+1
 15391                                  					; return the value here	in packet
 15392                                  
 15393                                  		; fall into vid_into_packet
 15394                                  
 15395                                  ; =============== S U B	R O U T	I N E =======================================
 15396                                  
 15397                                  ; return pointer to vid in bds at es:di in packet[si]
 15398                                  
 15399                                  		; 19/10/2022
 15400                                  vid_into_packet:
 15401 000018F4 1E                      		push	ds		; return pointer to vid	in bds at es:di	in packet[si]
 15402 000018F5 C51E[1200]              		lds	bx, [ptrsav]
 15403 000018F9 83C74B                  		add	di, 75		; BDS.volid
 15404 000018FC 8938                    		mov	[bx+si], di

 15406 00001901 8C4002                  		mov	[bx+si+2], es
 15407 00001904 1F                      		pop	ds
 15408                                  dofloppy:	; 18/12/2022
 15409 00001905 C3                      		retn

 15413                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15414                                  ;   hidensity - examine a drive/media descriptor to set the media type. if
 15415                                  ;   the media descriptor is not f9 (not 96tpi or 3 1/2), we return and let the
 15416                                  ;   caller do the rest. otherwise, we pop off the return and jump to the tail
 15417                                  ;   of getbp. for 3.5" media, we just return.
 15418                                  ;
 15419                                  ;   inputs:	es:di point to correct bds for this drive
 15420                                  ;		ah has media byte
 15421                                  ;
 15422                                  ;   outputs:	carry clear
 15423                                  ;		    no registers modified
 15424                                  ;		carry set
 15425                                  ;		    al = sectors/fat
 15426                                  ;		    bh = number of root directory entries
 15427                                  ;		    bl = sectors per track
 15428                                  ;		    cx = number of sectors
 15429                                  ;		    dh = sectors per allocation unit
 15430                                  ;		    dl = number of heads
 15431                                  ;
 15432                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 15441                                  					; [es:di+BDS.flags], fchangeline
 15442 0000190B 74F8                    		jz	short dofloppy	; no, do normal floppy test
 15443

 15445                                  ; table to see what kind it is.
 15446                                  
 15447 0000190D 26807D2202              		cmp	byte [es:di+22h], 2 ; is it single-media?
 15448 00001912 74F1                    		jz	short dofloppy	; [es:di+BDS.formfactor], ffSmall
 15449                                  					; yes, use fatid...
 15450                                  ; 96 tpi drive?

 15452 00001917 75EC                    		jnz	short dofloppy

 15470                                  					; & 0Fh sector max

 15472                                  					; 80 tracks, 15 sectors/track,
 15473                                  					; 2 sides

 15478                                  					; & head max

 15498                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15499                                  ; set_changed_dl - sets flag bits according to bits set in bx.
 15500                                  ;		   essentially used to indicate changeline, or format.
 15501                                  ;
 15502                                  ;   inputs:	dl contains physical drive number
 15503                                  ;		bx contains bits to set in the flag field in the bdss
 15504                                  ;   outputs:	none
 15505                                  ;   registers modified: flags
 15506                                  ;
 15507                                  ;	called from int13 hooker.  Must preserve ALL registers!!!
 15508                                  ;
 15509                                  ; in the virtual drive system we *must* flag the other drives as being changed
 15510                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 15512                                  set_changed_dl:	
 15513 00001938 06                      		push	es
 15514 00001939 57                      		push	di
 15515                                  		;les	di, ds:start_bds

 15518

 15523 00001942 7504                    		jnz	short get_next_bds

 15526                                  ; noted. there are *no* other compromising circumstances.
 15527

 15529                                  					; signal change	on other drive

 15598                                  
 15599                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15600                                  ; set_volume_id      -	main routine, calls other routines.
 15601                                  ; read_volume_id     -	read the volume id and tells if it has been changed.
 15602                                  ; transfer_volume_id -	copy the volume id from tmp to special drive.
 15603                                  ; check_volume_id    -	compare volume id in tmp area with one expected for drive.
 15604                                  ; fat_check          -	see of the fatid has changed in the specified drive.
 15605                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15606                                  
 15607                                  ; set_volume_id
 15608                                  ;   if drive has changeline support, read in and set the volume_id
 15609                                  ; and the last fat_id byte. if no change line support then do nothing.
 15610                                  ;
 15611                                  ;   on entry:
 15612                                  ;	es:di points to the bds for this disk.
 15613                                  ;	ah contains media byte
 15614                                  ;
 15615                                  ;   on exit:
 15616                                  ;	carry clear:
 15617                                  ;	   successful call
 15618                                  ;	carry set
 15619                                  ;	   error and ax has error code
 15620                                  
 15621                                  set_volume_id:				
 15622 00001965 52                      		push	dx		; save registers
 15623 00001966 50                      		push	ax
 15624 00001967 E8F5FF                  		call	haschange	; does drive have changeline support?
 15625 0000196A 740B                    		jz	short setvret	; no, get out
 15626 0000196C E81000                  		call	read_volume_id
 15627 0000196F 7209                    		jb	short seterr
 15628 00001971 E8A800                  		call	transfer_volume_id ; copy the volume id	to special drive
 15629 00001974 E8E2FF                  		call	resetchanged	; restore value	of change line
 15630                                  setvret:				
 15631                                  		; 10/12/2022
 15632                                  		; cf = 0
 15633                                  		;clc			; no error, clear carry flag
 15634 00001977 58                      		pop	ax		; restore registers
 15635 00001978 5A                      		pop	dx
 15636 00001979 C3                      		retn
 15637                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15638                                  
 15639                                  seterr:					
 15640 0000197A 5A                      		pop	dx		; pop stack but don't overwrite ax
 15641 0000197B 5A                      		pop	dx		; restore dx
 15642 0000197C C3                      		retn
 15643                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15644 0000197D 0000                    root_sec:	dw 0			; root sector #

 15655                                  ; read_volume_id read the volume id and tells if it has been changed.
 15656                                  ;
 15657                                  ;   on entry:
 15658                                  ;	es:di points to current bds for drive.
 15659                                  ;
 15660                                  ;   on exit:
 15661                                  ;	carry clear
 15662                                  ;	    si = 1  no change
 15663                                  ;	    si = 0  ?
 15664                                  ;	    si = -1 change
 15665                                  ;
 15666                                  ;	carry set:
 15667                                  ;	    error and ax has error code.

 15671 00001980 51                      		push	cx

 15997                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------
 15998                                  ; SYSINIT.TXT (27/01/1983)
 15999                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------
 16000                                  ;    SYSINIT is  a module linked behind the OEM bios.  It takes
 16001                                  ;over  the  system  initialization  after  the  OEM  bios   has
 16002                                  ;performed any  initialization  it  needs  to  do.   Control is
 16003                                  ;transfered with a long jump to the external  variable  SYSINIT
 16004                                  ;
 16005                                  ;
 16006                                  ;   The OEM  has  the  following  variables declared external:
 16007                                  ;
 16008                                  ;   CURRENT_DOS_LOCATION    WORD
 16009                                  ;
 16010                                  ;This word  contains  the  segment  number of the DOS before it
 16011                                  ;is relocated.  The OEM bios must set this value.
 16012                                  ;
 16013                                  ;   FINAL_DOS_LOCATION      WORD
 16014                                  ;
 16015                                  ;This word contains the segment number of the DOS after SYSINIT
 16016                                  ;moves it.  The OEM bios must set this value.
 16017                                  ;
 16018                                  ;   DEVICE_LIST             DWORD
 16019                                  ;
 16020                                  ;This  double  word  pointer  points  to  the  linked  list  of
 16021                                  ;character and block device drivers.  The  OEM  must  set  this
 16022                                  ;value.
 16023                                  ;
 16024                                  ;   MEMORY_SIZE             WORD
 16025                                  ;
 16026                                  ;This word  contains  the  number  of  RAM  paragraphs.  If the
 16027                                  ;bios doesn't set  this  variable  SYSINIT  will  automatically
 16028                                  ;calculate it.   NOTE:  systems with PARITY checked memory must
 16029                                  ;size memory in the BIOS.  SYSINITs method is to  write  memory
 16030                                  ;and read it back until it gets a mismatch.
 16031                                  ;
 16032                                  ;   DEFAULT_DRIVE           BYTE
 16033                                  ;
 16034                                  ;This is  the initial default drive when the system first comes
 16035                                  ;up.  drive a=0, drive b=1,  etc.   If  the  bios  doesn't  set
 16036                                  ;it then drive a is assumed.
 16037                                  ;
 16038                                  ;   BUFFERS                 BYTE
 16039                                  ;
 16040                                  ;This is  the  default  number of buffers for the system.  This
 16041                                  ;value may be overridden by the user in  the  CONFIG.SYS  file.
 16042                                  ;It is DBed to 2 in SYSINIT it should be greater than 1.
 16043                                  ;
 16044                                  ;   FILES                   BYTE
 16045                                  ;
 16046                                  ;This is  the  default  number  of  files for the system.  This
 16047                                  ;value may be overridden by the user in  the  CONFIG.SYS  file.
 16048                                  ;It is  DBed  to  8 in SYSINIT, values less than 5 are ignored.
 16049                                  ;
 16050                                  ;   SYSINIT                 FAR
 16051                                  ;
 16052                                  ;The entry  point  of  the  SYSINIT  module.  OEM BIOS jumps to
 16053                                  ;this label at the end of its INIT code.
 16054                                  ;
 16055                                  ;   The OEM  has  the  following  variables declared public:
 16056                                  ;
 16057                                  ;   RE_INIT                 FAR
 16058                                  ;
 16059                                  ;This is an entry point which allows the BIOS to do some INIT
 16060                                  ;work  after  the  DOS is initialized.  ALL REGISTERS MUST BE
 16061                                  ;PRESERVED.  On entry DS points to the first available memory
 16062                                  ;(after  the DOS).  DS:0 points to a 100H byte program header
 16063                                  ;prefix which represents  the  "program"  currently  running.
 16064                                  ;This  program  should  be  thought  of  as  the OEM BIOS and
 16065                                  ;SYSINIT taken together.  This is not  a  normal  program  in
 16066                                  ;that  no  memory  is  allocated to it, it is running in free
 16067                                  ;memory.
 16068                                  ;NOTES:
 16069                                  ;     At the time this routine is called SYSINIT occupies the
 16070                                  ;highest 10K of memory ("highest" is determined by the  value
 16071                                  ;of the MEMORY_SIZE variable), DO NOT DO WRITES THERE.
 16072                                  ;     Since this is called AFTER DOS is initialized, you can
 16073                                  ;make system calls.  This also implies that the code for this
 16074                                  ;routine    CANNOT   be   thrown   away   by   use   of   the
 16075                                  ;FINAL_DOS_LOCATION since the DOS has already been moved.
 16076                                  ;     If you don't want  anything done just set this to point
 16077                                  ;at a FAR RET instruction.
 16078                                  
 16079                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16080                                  ; TITLE   BIOS SYSTEM INITIALIZATION
 16081                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16082                                  
 16083                                  ;include version.inc
 16084                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16085                                  
 16086                                  ;FALSE   EQU     0
 16087                                  ;TRUE    EQU     0FFFFh
 16088                                  
 16089                                  ;IBMVER	    EQU     TRUE
 16090                                  ;IBMCOPYRIGHT EQU   FALSE
 16091                                  ;STACKSW    EQU	    TRUE		;Include Switchable Hardware Stacks
 16092                                  ;IBMJAPVER  EQU     FALSE		; If TRUE set KANJI true also
 16093                                  ;MSVER      EQU     FALSE
 16094                                  ;ALTVECT    EQU     FALSE		; Switch to build ALTVECT version
 16095                                  ;KANJI      EQU     FALSE
 16096                                  
 16097                                  ;(MSDOS 6.0, versiona.inc, 1991)
 16098                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16099                                  ;MAJOR_VERSION  EQU	6
 16100                                  ;;MINOR_VERSION	EQU	0	;6.00
 16101                                  ;MINOR_VERSION  EQU	21	;6.21  ; 21/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 16102                                  
 16103                                  ; 22/10/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0)
 16104                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16105                                  ;MAJOR_VERSION   EQU	5
 16106                                  ;MINOR_VERSION   EQU	0

 16109                                  MAJOR_VERSION   EQU	6

 16115                                  				; currently 0.
 16116                                  DOSREVNM equ	00000111b	; [[[ 7 for Retro DOS v4.0 ]]] (21/03/2019)	
 16117                                  DOSINROM equ	00001000B       ; bit 3 of ver flags returned in BH
 16118                                  DOSINHMA equ	00010000B       ; bit 4 of ver flags 
 16119                                  
 16120                                  ;      if1
 16121                                  ;      %OUT  ... for DOS Version 5.00 ...
 16122                                  ;      endif

 16124                                         ;******************************
 16125                                         ;Each assembler program should:
 16126                                         ;  mov ah,030h                   ;DOS Get Version function
 16127                                         ;  int 021h                      ;Version ret. in AX,minor version first
 16128                                         ;  cmp ax,expected_version       ;ALL utilities should check for an
 16129                                         ;  jne error_handler             ; EXACT version match.

 16133                                  ; device definitions
 16134                                  
 16135                                  ;Attribute bit masks
 16136                                  DEVTYP  EQU     8000h           ;Bit 15 - 1  if Char, 0 if block
 16137                                  DEVIOCTL EQU    4000h           ;Bit 14 - CONTROL mode bit
 16138                                  ISFATBYDEV EQU  2000h           ;Bit 13 - Device uses FAT ID bytes, comp media.
 16139                                  ISCIN   EQU     0001h           ;Bit 0 - This device is the console input.
 16140                                  ISCOUT  EQU     0002h           ;Bit 1 - This device is the console output.
 16141                                  ISNULL  EQU     0004h           ;Bit 2 - This device is the null device.
 16142                                  ISCLOCK EQU     0008h           ;Bit 3 - This device is the clock device.
 16143                                  ISIBM   EQU     0010h           ;Bit 4 - This device is special
 16144

 16146                                  struc	SYSDEV

 16160 00000003 ????                    .REQSTAT:	resw 1		;Status Word

 16163                                  endstruc

 16201 00000010 ????                    .fcb_FILSIZ:	resw 1	; Size of file in bytes; used with the following
 16202                                                          ; word
 16203 00000012 ????                    .fcb_DRVBP:	resw 1	; BP for SEARCH FIRST and SEARCH NEXT
 16204 00000014 ????                    .fcb_FDATE:	resw 1	; Date of last writing
 16205 00000016 ????                    .fcb_FTIME:	resw 1	; Time of last writing
 16206 00000018 ??                      .fcb_DEVID:	resb 1	; Device ID number, bits 0-5 if file.
 16207                                                          ; bit 7=0 for file, bit 7=1 for I/O device
 16208                                                          ; If file, bit 6=0 if dirty
 16209                                                          ; If I/O device, bit 6=0 if EOF (input)
 16210                                                          ;               Bit 5=1 if Raw mode
 16211                                                          ;               Bit 0=1 if console input device
 16212                                                          ;               Bit 1=1 if console output device
 16213                                                          ;               Bit 2=1 if null device
 16214                                                          ;               Bit 3=1 if clock device
 16215 00000019 ????                    .fcb_FIRCLUS:	resw 1	; First cluster of file
 16216 0000001B ????                    .fcb_CLUSPOS:	resw 1	; Position of last cluster accessed
 16217 0000001D ????                    .fcb_LSTCLUS:	resw 1	; Last cluster accessed and directory
 16218 0000001F ??                                   	resb 1	; pack 2 12 bit numbers into 24 bits...
 16219 00000020 ??                      .fcb_NR:	resb 1	; Next record
 16220 00000021 ????????                .fcb_RR:	resb 4	; Random record
 16221                                  .size:
 16222                                  endstruc

 16224                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 16225                                  ; Field definition for I/O buffer information
 16226                                  
 16227                                  ; 22/03/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0 (MSDOS 6.0, BUFFER.INC, 1991)
 16228                                  
 16229                                  struc buffinfo
 16230 00000000 ????                    .buf_next:	resw 1	; Pointer to next buffer in list
 16231 00000002 ????                    .buf_prev:	resw 1	; Pointer to previous buffer in list
 16232 00000004 ??                      .buf_ID:	resb 1	; Drive of buffer (bit 7 = 0)
 16233                                  			; SFT table index (bit 7 = 1)
 16234                                  			; = FFh if buffer free
 16235 00000005 ??                      .buf_flags:	resb 1	; Bit 7 = 1 if Remote file buffer
 16236                                  			;	= 0 if Local device buffer
 16237                                  			; Bit 6 = 1 if buffer dirty
 16238                                  			; Bit 5 = Reserved
 16239                                  			; Bit 4 = Search bit (bit 7 = 1)
 16240                                  			; Bit 3 = 1 if buffer is DATA
 16241                                  			; Bit 2 = 1 if buffer is DIR
 16242                                  			; Bit 1 = 1 if buffer is FAT
 16243                                  			; Bit 0 = Reserved
 16244 00000006 ????????                .buf_sector:	resd 1	; Sector number of buffer (bit 7 = 0)
 16245                                  ; The next two items are often refed as a word (bit 7 = 0)
 16246 0000000A ??                      .buf_wrtcnt:	resb 1	; For FAT sectors, # times sector written out
 16247 0000000B ????                    .buf_wrtcntinc:	resw 1	; "   "     "   , # sectors between each write
 16248 0000000D ????????                .buf_DPB :	resd 1	; Pointer to drive parameters
 16249 00000011 ????                    .buf_fill:	resw 1	; How full buffer is (bit 7 = 1)
 16250 00000013 ??                      .buf_reserved:	resb 1	; make DWORD boundary for 386
 16251                                  .size:
 16252                                  endstruc
 16253                                  
 16254                                  %define buf_offset	dword [buf_sector]
 16255                                  			;For bit 7 = 1, this is the byte
 16256                                  			;offset of the start of the buffer in
 16257                                  			;the file pointed to by buf_ID.  Thus
 16258                                  			;the buffer starts at location
 16259                                  			;buf_offset in the file and contains
 16260                                  			;buf_fill bytes.
 16261                                  
 16262                                  bufinsiz	equ	buffinfo.size ; ; Size of structure in bytes
 16263                                  
 16264                                  
 16265                                  buf_Free	equ	0FFh		; buf_id of free buffer
 16266                                  
 16267                                  ;Flag byte masks
 16268                                  buf_isnet	EQU	10000000B
 16269                                  buf_dirty	EQU	01000000B
 16270                                  ;***
 16271                                  buf_visit	EQU	00100000B
 16272                                  ;***
 16273                                  buf_snbuf	EQU	00010000B
 16274                                  
 16275                                  buf_isDATA	EQU	00001000B
 16276                                  buf_isDIR	EQU	00000100B
 16277                                  buf_isFAT	EQU	00000010B
 16278                                  buf_type_0	EQU	11110001B	; AND sets type to "none"
 16279                                  
 16280                                  buf_NetID	EQU	bufinsiz
