 27314                                  ; 31/12/2022
 27315                                  ; 27/10/2022
 27316                                  ;ifdef	MULTI_CONFIG
 27317                                  ;
 27318                                  ;  The size of the CONFIG.SYS workspace (for recreating the in-memory
 27319                                  ;  CONFIG.SYS image, and later for building the initial environment) need
 27320                                  ;  not be any larger than CONFIG.SYS itself, EXCEPT for the fact that
 27321                                  ;  we (may) add a variable to the environment that does not explicity appear
 27322                                  ;  in CONFIG.SYS, and that variable is CONFIG (as in CONFIG=COMMON).
 27323                                  ;  The default setting for CONFIG cannot result in more than 1 paragraph
 27324                                  ;  of extra space, so here we account for it (the worst case of course is
 27325                                  ;  when CONFIG.SYS is some very small size, like 0 -JTP)
 27326                                  ;

 27328 00001FB4 8916[9714]              	mov	[config_wrkseg],dx      ;this is the segment to be used for

 27723                                  ; output:								      *

 29463                                  ;**************************************************************************
 29464                                  ;									  *
 29465                                  ; function: parse the parameters of stacks= command.			  *
 29466                                  ;	    the minimum value for "number of stacks" and "stack size" is  *
 29467                                  ;	    8 and 32 each.  in the definition of sysparse value list,they *
 29468                                  ;	    are set to 0.  this is for accepting the exceptional case of  *
 29469                                  ;	    stacks=0,0 case (,which means do not install the stack.)	  *
 29470                                  ;	    so,after sysparse is done,we have to check if the entered	  *
 29471                                  ;	    values (stack_count,stack_size) are within the actual range,  *
 29472                                  ;	    (or if "0,0" pair has been entered.)			  *

 29487                                  ;	     { if (cx == 1) then /* first positional = stack count */	  *
 29488                                  ;		   p_stack_count = result_val._$P_picked_val;		  *

 29491                                  ;	     }								  *

 29493                                  ;	     error exit;						  *
 29494                                  ;	};								  *

 30779                                  ;include highload.inc	; Routines for devicehigh parsing, control of HIDDEN
 30780                                  ;include highexit.inc	; umb's, etc
 30781                                  
 30782                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 30783                                  ; HIGHLOAD.INC (MSDOS 6.0 - 1991) 	
 30784                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 30785                                  ; 07/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 30786                                  
 30787                                  ;******************************************************************************
 30788                                  ;
 30789                                  ; This file contains routines needed to parse and implement user-given
 30790                                  ; command-line options of the form "/S/L:3,0x500;2;7,127;0x0BE4". InitVar()
 30791                                  ; and Parsevar() are used to parse this data and place it in encoded form into
 30792                                  ; the variables in highvar.inc, for use by the rest of the routines.
 30793                                  ;
 30794                                  ; DeviceHigh accepts this command-line (handled in sysconf.asm, not here):
 30795                                  ;    DEVICEHIGH SIZE=hhhhhh module opts
 30796                                  ; Or, DeviceHigh and LoadHigh accept any of the following:
 30797                                  ;    DH/LH module opts
 30798                                  ;    DH/LH [/S][/L:umb[,size][;umb[,size]]*] module opts
 30799                                  ;    DH/LH [/L:umb[,size][;umb[,size]]*][/S] module opts
 30800                                  ; The initial UMB,SIZE pair designates the module's load address; the remainder
 30801                                  ; of the UMB and SIZE pairs are used to indicate specific UMBs to be left
 30802                                  ; available during the load.
 30803                                  ;
 30804                                  ; When an actual load is ready to be performed, a call to HideUMBs() will
 30805                                  ; temporarily allocate (as owner 8+"HIDDEN  ") all free elements in any
 30806                                  ; upper-memory block which was not specified by the user... in addition, if
 30807                                  ; UMBs were marked to shrink (/S option) to a certain size ("umb,size"), any
 30808                                  ; elements in that umb SAVE the lower-half of the newly-shrunken one are also
 30809                                  ; allocated. After the load, the function UnHideUMBs() (in highexit.inc) will
 30810                                  ; free any UMBs so allocated.
 30811                                  ;
 30812                                  ; When a device driver loads, there is the additional problem of allocating its
 30813                                  ; initial load site; this should be restricted to the first UMB specified on
 30814                                  ; the command-line. The function FreezeUM temporarily allocates all remaining
 30815                                  ; free upper-memory elements (as owner 8+"FROZEN  "), except those in the load
 30816                                  ; UMB. Then the initial allocation may be made, and a call to UnFreeze will
 30817                                  ; return any so-allocated memory elements to FREE, for the true load. Note
 30818                                  ; that UnFreeze leaves HIDDEN elements allocated; it only frees FROZEN ones.
 30819                                  ;
 30820                                  ;******************************************************************************
 30821                                  
 30822                                  SWTCH	equ	'/'		; Switch character
 30823                                  
 30824                                  DOS_CHECK_STRATEGY  equ	5800h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 0 = check alloc strat
 30825                                  DOS_SET_STRATEGY    equ	5801h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 1 = set alloc strategy
 30826                                  DOS_CHECK_UMBLINK   equ	5802h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 2 = check link state
 30827                                  DOS_GET_UMBLINK	    equ 5802h ; 20/04/2019
 30828                                  DOS_SET_UMBLINK     equ	5803h	; Int 21h, Func 58h, Svc 3 = set link state
 30829                                  DOS_GET_DOS_LISTS   equ	  52h	; Int 21h, Func 52h = return list of lists
 30830                                  DOS_UMB_HEAD        equ	  8Ch	; Offset from ES (after func52h) to get UMBHead
 30831                                  
 30832                                  CR	equ	0Dh		; Carriage Return
 30833                                  LF	equ	0Ah		; Line Feed
 30834                                  TAB	equ	09h		; Tab character (^I)
 30835

 30906                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30907                                  ;*** FixMem - scans the upper memory chain and concatenates adjacent free MCBs
 30908                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30909                                  ; ENTRY   : None
 30910                                  ; EXIT    : None
 30911                                  ; ERROR   : None
 30912                                  ; USES    : Flags, fm_umb, fm_strat
 30913                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30914                                  
 30915                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 30916                                  	; (SYSINIT:2F22h)
 30917                                  FixMem:
 30918                                  	; 01/01/2023
 30919                                  	;push	ax
 30920                                  	;push	bx
 30921                                  	;push	cx
 30922                                  	;push	dx
 30923 000029FE 06                      	push	es
 30924                                  
 30925 000029FF E84900                  	call	fm_link		; Link in UMBs
 30926                                  
 30927 00002A02 E80002                  	call	UmbHead		; Get first upper-memory MCB address (0x9FFF)
 30928 00002A05 723F                    	jc	short fmX	; (if couldn't get it, leave now).
 30929                                  
 30930 00002A07 8EC0                    	mov	es,ax		; It returns in AX, so move it to ES.
 30931                                  
 30932                                  ; - Walk MCB Chain ------------------------------------------------------------
 30933                                  
 30934 00002A09 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx		; We're keeping the address of the last MCB
 30935 00002A0B 89D1                    	mov 	cx,dx		; in CX... and the last owner
 30936 00002A0D 42                      	inc	dx		; in dx as we go through the loop:
 30937                                  
 30938                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 30939                                  ; FM10--DX  = last MCB's owner's PSP address
 30940                                  ;       CX  = last MCB's address (segment)
 30941                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 30942                                  
 30943 00002A0E 26A00000                fm10:	mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE] ; if 'Z', don't repeat loop
 30944 00002A12 268B1E0100              	mov	bx,[es:ARENA.OWNER]	; if not zero, do nothing
 30945 00002A17 09D3                    	or	bx,dx			; dx was owner of previous MCB
 30946 00002A19 7516                    	jnz	short fm30		; If not both zero, don't cat.
 30947                                  
 30948                                  	; - Coalesce memory blocks at ES:00 and CX:00 -------------------------
 30949                                  
 30950 00002A1B 268B1E0300              fm20:	mov	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; Grab this block's Size,
 30951 00002A20 8EC1                    	mov	es,cx			; Go back to prev MCB's address
 30952 00002A22 26A20000                	mov	[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],al ; & move the SECOND sig here
 30953                                  
 30954 00002A26 26031E0300              	add	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]	; Size += first MCB's size
 30955                                  	;add	bx,1			; And add one for the header
 30956                                  	; 11/07/2023
 30957 00002A2B 43                      	inc	bx
 30958 00002A2C 26891E0300              	mov	[es:ARENA.SIZE],bx	; Write the size
 30959                                  
 30960                                  	; ---------------------------------------------------------------------
 30961                                  
 30962 00002A31 8CC1                    fm30:	mov	cx,es			; Save MCB address
 30963 00002A33 268B160100              	mov	dx,[es:ARENA.OWNER]	; And remember its owner
 30964                                  
 30965 00002A38 8CC3                    	mov	bx,es			; Move to the next MCB
 30966                                  	;add	bx,[es:3]
 30967 00002A3A 26031E0300              	add	bx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 30968 00002A3F 43                      	inc	bx
 30969 00002A40 8EC3                    	mov	es,bx
 30970                                  
 30971                                  	;cmp	al,'Z'
 30972 00002A42 3C5A                    	cmp	al,arena_signature_end
 30973 00002A44 75C8                    	jne	short fm10		; If signature != 'Z', there are more.
 30974                                  fmX:	
 30975 00002A46 E81300                  	call	fm_unlink		; Unlink UMBs
 30976                                  
 30977 00002A49 07                      	pop	es
 30978                                  	; 01/01/2023
 30979                                  	;pop	dx
 30980                                  	;pop	cx
 30981                                  	;pop	bx
 30982                                  	;pop	ax
 30983                                  
 30984 00002A4A C3                      	retn
 30985                                  
 30986                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30987                                  ;*** fm_link - links UMBs not already linked in
 30988                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30989                                  ; ENTRY:    None
 30990                                  ; EXIT:     fm_umb == 0 if not linked in previously, 1 if already linked in
 30991                                  ; ERROR:    None
 30992                                  ; USES:     AX, BX, fm_umb
 30993                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30994                                  
 30995                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2
 30996                                  fm_link:
 30997 00002A4B B80258                  	mov	ax,DOS_CHECK_UMBLINK ; 5802h
 30998 00002A4E CD21                    	int	21h			; Current link-state is now in al
 30999                                  
 31000                                  	;putdata fm_umb,al		; So store it in fm_umb for later
 31001                                  	;
 31002                                  	;push	es
 31003                                  	;push	cs
 31004                                  	;pop	es
 31005                                  	;mov	[es:fm_umb],al
 31006                                  	;pop	es
 31007                                  	
 31008                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31009                                  	; ds = cs
 31010                                  	;mov	[cs:fm_umb],al
 31011 00002A50 A2[351F]                	mov	[fm_umb],al
 31012                                  
 31013 00002A53 B80358                  	mov	ax,DOS_SET_UMBLINK ; 5803h
 31014 00002A56 BB0100                  	mov	bx,1
 31015 00002A59 CD21                    	int	21h
 31016 00002A5B C3                      	retn
 31017                                  
 31018                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31019                                  ;*** fm_unlink - unlinks UMBs if fm_umb is set to 0
 31020                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31021                                  ; ENTRY:    fm_umb == 1 : leave linked, else unlink
 31022                                  ; EXIT:     None
 31023                                  ; ERROR:    None
 31024                                  ; USES:     AX, BX
 31025                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31026                                  
 31027                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2
 31028                                  fm_unlink:
 31029 00002A5C 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx
 31030                                  	
 31031                                  	;getdata bl,fm_umb		; fm_umb already has the old link-state
 31032                                  	;
 31033                                  	;push	ds
 31034                                  	;push	cs
 31035                                  	;pop	ds
 31036                                  	;mov	bl,[fm_umb]	
 31037                                  	;pop	ds
 31038                                  	
 31039                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31040                                  	; ds = cs
 31041                                  	;mov	bl,[cs:fm_umb]
 31042 00002A5E 8A1E[351F]              	mov	bl,[fm_umb]
 31043                                  
 31044 00002A62 B80358                  	mov	ax,DOS_SET_UMBLINK ; 5803h
 31045 00002A65 CD21                    	int	21h			; so just use that, and call int 21h
 31046 00002A67 C3                      	retn

 31050                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31051                                  ;*** ParseVar - parses [/S][/L:umb[,size][;umb[,size]]*] and builds the table
 31052                                  ; laid out in highvar.inc
 31053                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31054                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to command tail of LoadHigh/DeviceHigh (whitespace ok)
 31055                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI points to first character in child program name
 31056                                  ; ERROR:    ES:SI points to character which caused error, carry set, AX == code
 31057                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, AX, flags, variables in highvar.inc
 31058                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31059                                  ; Error codes (in AX if carry set on return):
 31060                                  ;
 31061                                  PV_InvArg	equ	1	; Invalid argument passed
 31062                                  PV_BadUMB	equ	2	; Bad UMB number passed (duplicate?)
 31063                                  PV_InvSwt	equ	3	; Unrecognized switch passed
 31064                                  ;
 31065                                  ; This routine exects ES:SI to point to a string much like the following:
 31066                                  ;    "/S/L:1,200;2 module options"
 31067                                  ; Optionally, the string can begin with whitespace; neither /S nor /L is
 31068                                  ; required, though that's what this routine is supposed to parse.
 31069                                  ;
 31070                                  optS		equ	'S'	; /S
 31071                                  optL		equ	'L'	; /L:...
 31072                                  ;
 31073                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31074                                  ; LoadHigh has a list of arguments, returned by cparse, which is used to create
 31075                                  ; a command-line for spawning a child process. For a typical LH command, say,
 31076                                  ;     lh /l:1,1000;2 print/d:lpt2
 31077                                  ; the arguments would look like (one per line):
 31078                                  ;     lh
 31079                                  ;     /l
 31080                                  ;     1
 31081                                  ;     1000
 31082                                  ;     2
 31083                                  ;     print
 31084                                  ;     /d
 31085                                  ;     :lpt2
 31086                                  ; In short, if "print" were, say, "43", there'd be no way to determine which
 31087                                  ; arg was the filename. So, inside this routine, we keep a running counter
 31088                                  ; of the number of arguments LH will need to skip in order to get to the
 31089                                  ; program name. The "lh" is implicit--it'll always have to skip that. So if
 31090                                  ; there's no "/l" or "/s", fm_argc will be 0 ... other than that, 1 is added
 31091                                  ; for:
 31092                                  ;    Each /L
 31093                                  ;    Each /S (there should be only one)
 31094                                  ;    Each UMB number (they follow ":" or ";")
 31095                                  ;    Each UMB size   (they follow ",")
 31096                                  ; So, in the above example, fm_argc would be 4-- and LH would skip right to
 31097                                  ; "print".  Note that InitVar initializes fm_argc to zero.
 31098                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31099                                  
 31100                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 31101                                  	; (SYSINIT:2F9Fh)
 31102                                  
 31103                                  ParseVar:
 31104                                  	;pushreg <di, ds, es>
 31105                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31106                                  	;push	di ; * ; (not required) ; 01/01/2023
 31107 00002A68 1E                      	push	ds
 31108 00002A69 06                      	push	es
 31109                                  
 31110 00002A6A 06                      	push	es		; Make DS:SI point to it, as well as ES:SI
 31111 00002A6B 1F                      	pop	ds		; (regardless if we're in devhigh or loadhigh)
 31112 00002A6C FC                      	cld
 31113                                  
 31114                                  ; ------------------------------------------------
 31115                                  ; PV10--ES:SI = any whitespace on the command-line
 31116                                  ; ------------------------------------------------
 31117                                  
 31118 00002A6D AC                      pv10:	lodsb			; here, ES:SI=="  /L..."--must eat whitespace
 31119 00002A6E E8A200                  	call	isWhite
 31120 00002A71 74FA                    	jz	short pv10	;       ES:SI==" /L..."--keep eating.
 31121                                  	;cmp	al,'/'
 31122 00002A73 3C2F                    	cmp	al,SWTCH
 31123 00002A75 7404                    	je	short pv20	;       ES:SI=="/L..."--go process a switch
 31124                                  
 31125 00002A77 4E                      	dec	si		; Backup--it's now "odule options", and we need
 31126 00002A78 F8                      	clc			; that "m" we just read (or whatever it is).
 31127 00002A79 EB2B                    	jmp	short pvX	; Then return with carry clear == we're done.
 31128                                  pv20:	
 31129 00002A7B AC                      	lodsb			; Just read 'S' or 'L', hopefully
 31130                                  	;toUpper al		; So we make it upper-case, and...
 31131 00002A7C 24DF                    	and	al,0DFh
 31132                                  	;cmp	al,'S'
 31133 00002A7E 3C53                    	cmp	al,optS		; just read 'S'?
 31134 00002A80 750D                    	jne	short pv30
 31135                                  
 31136                                  	;call	incArgc		; If it's /S, it's another arg for LH to skip.
 31137 00002A82 2EFE06[371F]            	inc	byte [cs:fm_argc] ; 19/04/2019
 31138                                  
 31139                                  	;putdata fUmbTiny,1	; /S, so ES:SI=="  /L..." or " module opts", or
 31140                                  	;
 31141                                  	;push	es
 31142                                  	;push	cs
 31143                                  	;pop	es
 31144                                  	;mov	[es:fUmbTiny],1	
 31145                                  	;pop	es
 31146                                  
 31147 00002A87 2EC606[011F]01          	mov	byte [cs:fUmbTiny],1
 31148                                  
 31149 00002A8D EBDE                    	jmp	short pv10	; possibly even "/L...".
 31150                                  
 31151                                  pv30:	;cmp	al,'L'
 31152 00002A8F 3C4C                    	cmp	al,optL		; If it's not 'L' either, then it's a bad
 31153 00002A91 750D                    	jne	short pvE1	; switch!
 31154                                  
 31155                                  	;call	incArgc		; If it's /L, it's another arg for LH to skip.
 31156 00002A93 2EFE06[371F]            	inc	byte [cs:fm_argc] ; 19/04/2019
 31157                                  
 31158 00002A98 E80E00                  	call	parseL
 31159 00002A9B 73D0                    	jnc	short pv10	; If no carry, go back and look for more
 31160                                  
 31161 00002A9D 4E                      	dec	si		; Else, back up and exit.
 31162 00002A9E EB03                    	jmp	short pvErr	; AX has already been set by parseL
 31163                                  
 31164                                  pvE1:	;mov	ax,3
 31165 00002AA0 B80300                  	mov	ax,PV_InvSwt	; Unrecognized switch passed
 31166 00002AA3 4E                      pvErr:	dec	si
 31167 00002AA4 4E                      	dec	si
 31168 00002AA5 F9                      	stc
 31169                                  pvX:	;popreg	<es, ds, di>
 31170 00002AA6 07                      	pop	es
 31171 00002AA7 1F                      	pop	ds
 31172                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31173                                  	;pop	di ; * ; (not required) ; 01/01/2023
 31174 00002AA8 C3                      	retn
 31175                                  
 31176                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31177                                  ;*** parseL - parses ":nnnn[,nnnn][;nnnn[,nnnn]]*" for ParseVar
 31178                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31179                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to colon
 31180                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI points to first character not parsed
 31181                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set; rewind three characters and return (see ParseVar)
 31182                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, flags, AX, CX, DX, variables in highvar.inc
 31183                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31184                                  ; If the string here is terminated with anything other than whitespace or a
 31185                                  ; switchchar (perhaps it's /S or another /L:... ), then we return with carry
 31186                                  ; set, indicating that they've screwed up the syntax. The 3-character rewind
 31187                                  ; makes sure the app /L: is reported as being the culprit.
 31188                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31189                                  
 31190                                  parseL:
 31191 00002AA9 AC                      	lodsb
 31192 00002AAA 3C3A                    	cmp	al,':'		; Make sure they did /L:
 31193 00002AAC 754E                    	jne	short plE1	; If they didn't, return with carry set.
 31194                                  
 31195                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 31196                                  ; PL10--ES:SI = a UMB number, after /L: or ;
 31197                                  ; ------------------------------------------
 31198                                  
 31199 00002AAE E8DB00                  pl10:	call	GetXNum		; After this, it's ",size" or ";umb" or " mod"
 31200 00002AB1 724F                    	jc	short plE2	; And error if it's a bad number.
 31201 00002AB3 E89D01                  	call	convUMB		; Convert any address to a UMB number
 31202                                  
 31203 00002AB6 88C1                    	mov	cl,al		; Remember the UMB number
 31204 00002AB8 E87600                  	call	stowUMB		; Mark this UMB # as used;
 31205 00002ABB 7245                    	jc	short plE2	; If it was already marked, it'll error
 31206                                  
 31207                                  	;call	incArgc		; Each UMB number is another arg for LH to skip
 31208 00002ABD 2EFE06[371F]            	inc	byte [cs:fm_argc] ; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31209                                  
 31210 00002AC2 AC                      	lodsb
 31211 00002AC3 3C3B                    	cmp	al,';'		; Did "umb;" ?
 31212 00002AC5 74E7                    	je	short pl10	; Yep: go back and get another UMB.
 31213                                  
 31214 00002AC7 E84900                  	call	isWhite		; Did "umb " ?
 31215 00002ACA 743B                    	jz	short plX	; Yep: return (it'll go back to whitespace)
 31216                                  
 31217 00002ACC E83900                  	call	isEOL		; Did "umb" ?
 31218 00002ACF 7435                    	jz	short plSwX	; If so, backup and exit like everything's ok
 31219                                  
 31220                                  	;cmp	al,'/'
 31221 00002AD1 3C2F                    	cmp	al,SWTCH 	; Did "umb/" ? (as in, "/L:1,100;2/S")
 31222 00002AD3 7431                    	je	short plSwX	; If so, back up ES:SI one character and return
 31223                                  
 31224 00002AD5 3C2C                    	cmp	al,','		; Did "umb," ?
 31225 00002AD7 7523                    	jne	short plE1	; Just what the heck DID they do? Return error.
 31226                                  
 31227                                  ; --- Read a size -------------------------------------------------------------
 31228                                  
 31229 00002AD9 E8B000                  	call	GetXNum		; Stop on "size;" or "size " or anything else
 31230 00002ADC 721E                    	jc	short plE1	; And error if it's a bad size.
 31231                                  
 31232 00002ADE E81601                  	call	toPara		; Convert from bytes to paragraphs
 31233

 31498                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31499                                  ;*** toDigit - converts a character-digit to its binary counterpart
 31500                                  ;            -- verifies that CL contains a valid character-digit; if so, it
 31501                                  ; changes CL to its counterpart binary digit ((CL-'0') or (CL-'A'+10)).
 31502                                  ; A-F are considered valid if gnradix is 16.
 31503                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31504                                  ; ENTRY:    CL contains a digit ('0' to '9' or, if gnradix==16, 'A' to 'F')
 31505                                  ; EXIT:     CL contains digit in binary (0 to 9 or, if gnradix==16, 0 to 15)
 31506                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set indicates invalid digit; carry clear indicates good digit
 31507                                  ; USES:     CL, Flags
 31508                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31509                                  ; If the string is preceeded with "0x", the value is read as hexadecimal; else,
 31510                                  ; as decimal. After a read, you may check the radix by examining gnradix--it
 31511                                  ; will be 10 or 16.
 31512                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31513                                  
 31514                                  gnradix:
 31515 00002B56 0000                    	dw	0		; Must be a word--16x16 multiplication
 31516                                  
 31517                                  toDigit:
 31518 00002B58 2E833E[562B]10          	cmp	word [cs:gnradix],16
 31519 00002B5E 751C                    	jne	short td20	; Don't check hex digits if radix isn't 16
 31520                                  
 31521                                  toDigit_hex:
 31522 00002B60 80F961                  	cmp	cl,'a'	; 61h
 31523 00002B63 7209                    	jb	short td10
 31524 00002B65 80F966                  	cmp	cl,'f'	; 66h
 31525 00002B68 7720                    	ja	short tdE	; Nothing valid above 'f' at all...
 31526 00002B6A 80E957                  	sub	cl,'a'-10 ; 57h	; Make 'a'==10 and return.
 31527                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 31528 00002B6D C3                      	retn
 31529                                  td10:	
 31530 00002B6E 80F941                  	cmp	cl,'A'  ; 41h
 31531 00002B71 7209                    	jb	short td20	; Below 'A'? Not a letter...
 31532 00002B73 80F946                  	cmp	cl,'F'	; 46h
 31533 00002B76 7712                    	ja	short tdE	; Above 'F'? Not a digit.
 31534 00002B78 80E937                  	sub	cl,'A'-10 ; 37h	; Make 'A'==10 and return.
 31535                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 31536 00002B7B C3                      	retn
 31537                                  toDigit_dec:
 31538                                  td20:	
 31539 00002B7C 80F930                  	cmp	cl,'0'		; If less than zero,
 31540                                  	;jb	short tdE	; Done.
 31541 00002B7F 720A                    	jb	short tdEr ; 08/04/2019
 31542 00002B81 80F939                  	cmp	cl,'9'		; Or, if greater than nine,
 31543 00002B84 7704                    	ja	short tdE	; Done.
 31544 00002B86 80E930                  	sub	cl,'0'	; 30h	; Okay--make '0'==0 and return.
 31545                                  	;clc			; <- CLC is implicit from last SUB
 31546 00002B89 C3                      	retn
 31547                                  tdE:	
 31548 00002B8A F9                      	stc
 31549                                  tdEr:		; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0	
 31550 00002B8B C3                      	retn
 31551                                  
 31552                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31553                                  ;*** GetXNum - reads a 32-bit ASCII number at ES:SI and returns it in DX:AX
 31554                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31555                                  ; ENTRY:    ES:SI points to an ascii string to scan
 31556                                  ; EXIT:     ES:SI moved to first invalid digit, DX:AX contains value read
 31557                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if # is too big, or has no digits (EOL possibly)
 31558                                  ; USES:     ES:SI, DX, AX, Flags, gnradix
 31559                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31560                                  ; If the string is preceeded with "0x", the value is read as hexadecimal; else,
 31561                                  ; as decimal. After a read, you may check the radix by examining gnradix--it
 31562                                  ; will be 10 or 16.
 31563                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31564                                  
 31565                                  ; 08/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 31566                                  
 31567                                  ; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 31568                                  ; (SYSINIT:3109h)
 31569                                  
 31570                                  GetXNum:
 31571                                  	;pushreg <bx, cx, ds>
 31572                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31573                                  	;push	bx
 31574 00002B8C 51                      	push	cx ; *
 31575                                  	;push	ds
 31576                                  
 31577 00002B8D FC                      	cld
 31578 00002B8E 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax
 31579 00002B90 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx
 31580 00002B92 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx
 31581 00002B94 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx			; Start with 0 (makes sense)
 31582                                  
 31583 00002B96 2EC706[562B]0A00        	mov	word [cs:gnradix],10	; And default to a radix of 10 (dec)
 31584                                  
 31585 00002B9D 268A0C                  	mov	cl,[es:si]		; Now AX=0, BX=0, CH=0/CL=char, DX=0
 31586                                  	;call	toDigit
 31587 00002BA0 E8D9FF                  	call	toDigit_dec
 31588                                  	;jc	short gxnE		; If it's not a digit, leave now.
 31589                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31590 00002BA3 7233                    	jc	short gxnX
 31591                                  
 31592 00002BA5 08C9                    	or	cl,cl
 31593 00002BA7 7517                    	jnz	short gxn20		; Doesn't have '0x'
 31594 00002BA9 268A4C01                	mov	cl,[es:si+1]
 31595 00002BAD 80F978                  	cmp	cl,'x'			; Either 'x'...
 31596 00002BB0 7405                    	je	short gxn10
 31597 00002BB2 80F958                  	cmp	cl,'X'			; ...or 'X' means it's hexadecimal
 31598 00002BB5 7509                    	jne	short gxn20
 31599                                  
 31600                                  gxn10:	
 31601 00002BB7 2EC706[562B]1000        	mov	word [cs:gnradix], 16
 31602 00002BBE 46                      	inc	si			; Since we read "0x", march over it.
 31603 00002BBF 46                      	inc	si
 31604                                  
 31605                                  ; ------------------------------------------------------
 31606                                  ; GXN20--ES:SI = a digit in a number; if not, we're done
 31607                                  ;        DX:AX = current total
 31608                                  ;        BX    = 0
 31609                                  ;        CH    = 0
 31610                                  ; ------------------------------------------------------
 31611                                  
 31612                                  gxn20:	
 31613 00002BC0 268A0C                  	mov	cl,[es:si]	; Now DX:AX=current total, CH=0/CL=char
 31614 00002BC3 46                      	inc	si

 31620 00002BCC 720A                    	jc	short gxnX	; (if it's too big, error out)
 31621                                  
 31622 00002BCE 01C8                    	add	ax,cx		; Add the digit
 31623 00002BD0 11DA                    	adc	dx,bx		; (BX is 0!)--Adds 1 if last add wrapped
 31624                                  	;jc	short gxnX	; If _that_ wrapped, it's too big.
 31625                                  	;jmp	short gxn20
 31626 00002BD2 73EC                    	jnc	short gxn20
 31627                                  gxnE:	
 31628                                  	;stc			; In this case, we need to set the carry
 31629 00002BD4 EB02                    	jmp	short gxnX	; and leave--there were no digits given.
 31630                                  gxnQ:	
 31631 00002BD6 4E                      	dec	si		; Don't read in the offensive character.
 31632 00002BD7 F8                      	clc			; And clear carry, so they know it's okay.
 31633                                  gxnX:	
 31634                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31635                                  	;pop	ds
 31636 00002BD8 59                      	pop	cx ; *
 31637                                  	;pop	bx
 31638 00002BD9 C3                      	retn

 31640                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31641                                  ;*** mul32 - multiplies the number in DX:AX by gnradix
 31642                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31643                                  ; ENTRY:   DX:AX = the number to be multiplied, BX = 0, gnradix = multiplier
 31644                                  ; EXIT:    DX:AX has been multiplied by gnradix if carry clear; BX still 0
 31645                                  ; ERROR:   Carry set if number was too large
 31646                                  ; USES:    Flags, AX, DX
 31647                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31648                                  
 31649                                  mul32:
 31650 00002BDA 50                      	push	ax		; DX=old:hi, AX=old:lo, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31651 00002BDB 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx		; DX=old:hi, AX=old:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31652 00002BDD 2EF726[562B]            	mul	word [cs:gnradix] ; DX=?, AX=new:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31653 00002BE2 7211                    	jc	short m32E	; Too big?
 31654                                  
 31655 00002BE4 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:hi, TOS=old:lo, BX=0
 31656 00002BE6 58                      	pop	ax		; DX=new:hi, AX=old:lo, TOS=orig, BX=0
 31657                                  
 31658 00002BE7 87D3                    	xchg	dx,bx		; DX=0, AX=old:lo, TOS=orig, BX=new:hi
 31659 00002BE9 2EF726[562B]            	mul	word [cs:gnradix] ; DX=carry, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=new:hi
 31660 00002BEE 87D3                    	xchg	dx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=carry
 31661 00002BF0 01DA                    	add	dx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=carry
 31662 00002BF2 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx		; DX=new:hi, AX=new:lo, TOS=orig, BX=0
 31663 00002BF4 C3                      	retn
 31664                                  m32E:	
 31665 00002BF5 58                      	pop	ax

 31668                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31669                                  ;*** toPara - divides DX:AX by 16; result in AX only (discards extra DX data)
 31670                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31671                                  ; ENTRY:   DX:AX = the number to be divided
 31672                                  ; EXIT:    Interpereting DX:AX as bytes, AX=paragraph equivalent, 0xFFFF max
 31673                                  ; ERROR:   None

 31677                                  ;       can't ensure a 386 host machine. Sorry.

 31680                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2
 31681                                  toPara:

 31684 00002BF8 B104                    	mov	cl,4		;

 31686 00002BFC 92                      	xchg	ax,dx		; DX:AX=0000 LLLL llll llll:HHHH hhhh hhhh hhhh
 31687 00002BFD B10C                    	mov	cl,12

 31689 00002C01 09D0                    	or	ax,dx		;    AX=hhhh LLLL llll llll

 31696                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 31699                                  ; ERROR:  Carry set if pointer is 0xFFFF (if not set up yet--DH runs into this)

 31780                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31781                                  ;*** AddrToUmb - converts a segment address in AX to its appropriate UMB number
 31782                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31783                                  ; ENTRY:  AX contains a segment address
 31784                                  ; EXIT:   AX will contain the UMB number which contains the address (0==conv)
 31785                                  ; ERROR:  If the address is above UM Range, AX will return as FFFF.
 31786                                  ; USES:   Flags, AX
 31787                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31788                                  ; An address in the following areas is treated as:
 31789                                  ;    0      <-> umbhead (0x9FFF)          = Conventional memory
 31790                                  ;    0x9FFF <-> addr of first UM sys MCB  = UMB #1
 31791                                  ;      ...
 31792                                  ;    addr of last UM sys MCB <-> TOM      = invalid; returns #0xFFFF
 31793                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31794                                  
 31795                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2
 31796                                  AddrToUmb:
 31797                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31798                                  	;push	cx
 31799                                  	;push	dx
 31800 00002C22 06                      	push	es
 31801                                  
 31802 00002C23 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax		; DX = address to search for
 31803                                  
 31804 00002C25 E8DDFF                  	call	UmbHead		; AX = first segment
 31805 00002C28 7222                    	jc	short atuE	; If it couldn't get it, error out.
 31806                                  
 31807                                  	; 22/07/2023
 31808                                  	;mov	es,ax ; *	; ES = first UMB segment
 31809 00002C2A 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx ; 0	; Pretend we're on UMB 0 for now... (cx = UMB#)
 31810                                  
 31811                                  	; 22/07/2023
 31812                                  atu10:
 31813 00002C2C 8EC0                    	mov	es,ax ; * ; ** ; 22/07/2023
 31814                                  ; ----------------------------------------
 31815                                  ; ATU10--ES - Current MCB address
 31816                                  ;        DX - Address given for conversion
 31817                                  ;        CX - Current UMB #
 31818                                  ; ----------------------------------------
 31819                                  
 31820                                  ;atu10:	
 31821                                  	;mov	ax,es ; * ; 18/07/2023
 31822 00002C2E 39D0                            cmp	ax,dx		; Present segment >= given segment?
 31823 00002C30 731D                    	jae	short atuX	; Yep--done.
 31824                                  
 31825 00002C32 E8DDFF                  	call	isSysMCB	; Returns with ZF set if this is a system MCB
 31826 00002C35 7501                    	jnz	short atu20
 31827                                  
 31828 00002C37 41                      	inc	cx		; If it _was_ a system MCB, we're in a new UMB.
 31829                                  atu20:	
 31830                                  	;mov	al,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 31831                                  	;cmp	al,arena_signature_end  ; 'Z'
 31832                                  	; 22/07/2023
 31833                                  	; ax = es
 31834                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 31835 00002C38 2603060300              	add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31836 00002C3D 26803E00005A            	cmp	byte [es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],arena_signature_end
 31837 00002C43 7403                    	je	short atu30		; 'Z' means this was the last MCB... that's it.
 31838                                  
 31839                                  	;NextMCB es,ax
 31840                                  
 31841                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 31842                                  	;;add	ax,[es:3]
 31843                                  	;add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 31844 00002C45 40                      	inc	ax
 31845                                  	; 22/07/2023
 31846                                  	;mov	es,ax ; *
 31847 00002C46 EBE4                    	jmp	short atu10
 31848                                  
 31849                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31850                                  ; if we get to atu30, they specified a number that was past the last MCB.
 31851                                  ; make sure it's not _inside_ that MCB before we return an error condition.
 31852                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31853                                  
 31854                                  atu30:	
 31855                                  	; 22/07/2023
 31856                                  	; ax = es + [es:ARENA.SIZE] 
 31857                                  	;mov	ax,es ; **
 31858                                  	;add	ax,[es:ARENA.SIZE] ; **
 31859 00002C48 39D0                    	cmp	ax,dx		; Present >= given?
 31860 00002C4A 7303                    	jae	short atuX	; Yep! It _was_ inside.
 31861                                  atuE:	
 31862 00002C4C 31C9                    	xor	cx,cx ; 0	; Else, fall through with UMB # == -1
 31863 00002C4E 49                      	dec	cx		; (that makes it return 0xFFFF and sets CF)
 31864                                  atuX:	
 31865 00002C4F 89C8                    	mov	ax,cx		; Return the UMB number in AX
 31866                                  	
 31867 00002C51 07                      	pop	es	
 31868                                  	; 01/01/2023
 31869                                  	;pop	dx
 31870                                  	;pop	cx
 31871 00002C52 C3                      	retn
 31872                                  
 31873                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31874                                  ;*** convUMB - checks after GetXNum to convert an address to a UMB number
 31875                                  ;            -- if GetXNum read a hex number, we interperete that as a segment
 31876                                  ; address rather than a UMB number... and use that address to look up a UMB.
 31877                                  ; This routine checks for that condition and calls AddrToUmb if necessary.
 31878                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31879                                  ; ENTRY:  AX contains a UMB number or segment, gnradix has been set by GetXNum
 31880                                  ; EXIT:   AX will contain a UMB number

 32620                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32621                                  ;*** shrinkMCB - breaks an MCB into two pieces, the lowest one's size==AX
 32622                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32623                                  ; ENTRY:    AX == new size, ES:0 == current MCB
 32624                                  ; EXIT:     None; MCB broken if carry clear
 32625                                  ; ERROR:    Carry set if MCB isn't as large as AX+0x20 (not a useful split)
 32626                                  ; USES:     Flags
 32627                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32628                                  ; If the size of the to-be-split MCB isn't at least 0x20 bytes greater than
 32629                                  ; the specified new size, the split is useless; if it's only 0x10 bytes, that
 32630                                  ; 0x10 will be used to make a header that mentions a 0-byte free space, and
 32631                                  ; that just sucks up 0x10 bytes for nothing. So we make 0x20 bytes the
 32632                                  ; minimum for performing a split.
 32633                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32634                                  
 32635                                  MIN_SPLIT_SIZE	equ 20h
 32636                                  
 32637                                  	; 02/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 32638                                  
 32639                                  shrinkMCB:
 32640                                  	;pushreg <bx,cx,es>
 32641                                  	; 02/01/2023
 32642                                  	;push	bx
 32643 00002DA1 51                      	push	cx
 32644 00002DA2 06                      	push	es
 32645                                  
 32646 00002DA3 89C3                    	mov	bx,ax			; Move things around... and
 32647                                  	; 02/01/2023
 32648                                  	;mov	ax,es			; save this one for later.
 32649                                  
 32650 00002DA5 268B0E0300              	mov	cx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32651                                  	; 02/01/2023
 32652 00002DAA 89C8                    	mov	ax,cx 
 32653                                  
 32654 00002DAC 83E820                  	sub	ax,MIN_SPLIT_SIZE ; 32
 32655                                  	;sub	cx,MIN_SPLIT_SIZE ; 32
 32656                                  	;;cmp	bx,cx			; {New size} vs {Current Size-20h}
 32657                                  	;ja	short smE		; if wanted_size > cur-20h, abort.
 32658                                  	; 18/12/2022
 32659                                  	;cmp	cx,bx
 32660                                  	; 02/01/2023
 32661 00002DAF 39D8                    	cmp	ax,bx
 32662 00002DB1 7228                    	jb	short smE ; (*)
 32663                                  
 32664 00002DB3 268A160000              	mov	dl,[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE]
 32665                                  	
 32666                                  	;mov	cx,[es:ARENA.SIZE]
 32667                                  	; 02/01/2023
 32668 00002DB8 8CC0                    	mov	ax,es
 32669                                  
 32670 00002DBA 26891E0300              	mov	[es:ARENA.SIZE],bx
 32671 00002DBF 26C60600004D            	mov	byte [es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],'M'
 32672                                  
 32673 00002DC5 01D8                    	add	ax,bx
 32674 00002DC7 40                      	inc	ax
 32675 00002DC8 8EC0                    	mov	es,ax			; Move to new arena area
 32676                                  
 32677 00002DCA 89C8                    	mov	ax,cx
 32678 00002DCC 29D8                    	sub	ax,bx
 32679                                  	; 12/12/2022
 32680                                  	; ax > 0
 32681 00002DCE 48                      	dec	ax			; And prepare the new size
 32682                                  
 32683                                  	; 18/12/2022
 32684 00002DCF 2688160000              	mov	[es:ARENA.SIGNATURE],dl
 32685                                  	;mov	word [es:ARENA.OWNER],0 ; (**)
 32686 00002DD4 26A30300                	mov	[es:ARENA.SIZE],ax
 32687                                  	;mov	ax,'  ' ; 2020h
 32688                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+0],ax ; (**)
 32689                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+2],ax ; (**)
 32690                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+4],ax ; (**)
 32691                                  	;mov	[es:ARENA.NAME+6],ax ; (**)
 32692                                  
 32693                                  	; 18/12/2022
 32694 00002DD8 E8A801                  	call	freeMCB	; (**)
 32695                                  
 32696                                  	; 12/12/2022
 32697                                  	; cf=0
 32698                                  	;clc
 32699                                  	; 18/12/2022
 32700                                  	;jmp	short smX
 32701                                  smE:	
 32702                                  	; 18/12/2022
 32703                                  	; cf=1 (*)
 32704                                  	;stc
 32705                                  smX:	
 32706                                  	;popreg	<es,cx,bx>
 32707 00002DDB 07                      	pop	es
 32708 00002DDC 59                      	pop	cx
 32709                                  	; 02/01/2023
 32710                                  	;pop	bx
 32711 00002DDD C3                      	retn

 32713                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32714                                  ;*** hideUMB? - hides as appropriate the UMB in CL
 32715                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32716                                  ; ENTRY:    CL should be to a valid UMB number, and AX to its address (findUMB)
 32717                                  ; EXIT:     None; UMB is hidden as necessary
 32718                                  ; ERROR:    None
 32719                                  ; USES:     Flags, AX, CX
 32720                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 32721                                  ; PRIMARY LOGIC:
 32722                                  ;
 32723                                  ; If the UMB is specified in the DH/LH statement, then:
 32724                                  ;    If the largest free segment is too small (check specified size), then:
 32725                                  ;       Pretend it wasn't ever specified, and fall out of this IF.
 32726                                  ;    Else, if largest free segment is LARGER than specified size, then:
 32727                                  ;       If /S was given on the command-line, then:
 32728                                  ;          Break that element into two pieces
 32729                                  ;          Set a flag that we're shrinking
 32730                                  ;       Endif
 32731                                  ;    Endif
 32732                                  ; Endif
 32733                                  ; If the UMB is NOT specified (or was removed by the above):
 32734                                  ;    Hide all free elements in the UMB
 32735                                  ;    If the flag that we're shrinking was set, then:
 32736                                  ;       UN-hide the lower portion of the shrunken UMB
 32737                                  ;    ENDIF
 32738                                  ; ENDIF
 32739                                  ; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 33419                                  ;
 33420                                  ; procedure : InitDevLoad
 33421                                  ;
 33422                                  ;	Input : DeviceHi = 0 indicates load DD in low memory
 33423                                  ;			 = 1 indicates load in UMB:
 33424                                  ;		           ConvLoad = 0 indicates a new-style load (see below)
 33425                                  ;		                    = 1 indicates a DOS 5-style load
 33426                                  ;		DevSize  = Size of the device driver file in paras
 33427                                  ;
 33428                                  ;	Output : none
 33429                                  ;
 33430                                  ;	Initializes DevLoadAddr, DevLoadEnd & DevEntry.
 33431                                  ;	Also sets up a header for the Device driver entry for mem utility
 33432                                  ;
 33433                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33434                                  ; For a "new-style load", we break off the current DevEntry and link the umbs
 33435                                  ; as we see fit, using HideUMBs (and UnHideUMBs at exit, though _it_ decides
 33436                                  ; whether it's entitled to do anything). HideUMBs uses the chart built by
 33437                                  ; ParseVar to determine which UMBs to leave FREE, and which not.
 33438                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 33439                                  
 33440                                  	; 01/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 33441                                  	; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 33442                                  	; (SYSINIT:364Ah)
 33443                                  InitDevLoad:
 33444                                  	; 01/01/2023
 33445                                  	;push	es ; *
 33446                                  
 33447                                  	; 11/12/2022
 33448                                  	; ds = cs
 33449 00002FBD 803E[561F]00            	cmp	byte [DeviceHi],0
 33450                                  	;cmp	byte [cs:DeviceHi],0	; Are we loading in UMB ?
 33451                                  	;je	short InitForLo		; no, init for lo mem
 33452 00002FC2 7439                    	je	short initforlo_x ; 09/04/2019
 33453                                  
 33454                                  ; 01/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 33455                                  ; 01/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 33456                                  ; %if 0
 33457                                  	; 01/01/2023
 33458 00002FC4 803E[461F]01            	cmp	byte [ConvLoad],1
 33459                                  	;cmp	byte [cs:ConvLoad],1	; Are we loading as per DOS 5?
 33460 00002FC9 7413                    	je	short InitForConv
 33461                                  
 33462                                  ; There are two stages to preparing upper-memory; first, we mark as 8+HIDDEN
 33463                                  ; any areas not specified on the /L:... chain. Second, we mark as 8+FROZEN
 33464                                  ; any areas left in upper-memory, except for elements in the load UMB...
 33465                                  ; we then malloc space as per Dos-5 style, and mark as free any spaces which
 33466                                  ; are 8+FROZEN (but leave 8+HIDDEN still hidden). The load is performed,
 33467                                  ; and UnHideUMBs later on marks all 8+HIDDEN as free.
 33468                                  
 33469 00002FCB E85704                  	call	ShrinkUMB		; Stop using the old device arena
 33470                                  
 33471 00002FCE E892FC                  	call	HideUMBs		; Mark up the UM area as we see fit
 33472 00002FD1 E8CBFE                  	call	FreezeUM		; Hide everything BUT the load area
 33473 00002FD4 E85700                  	call	GetUMBForDev		; And grab that load area as needed
 33474 00002FD7 9C                      	pushf
 33475 00002FD8 E851FE                  	call	UnFreeze		; Then unhide everything frozen
 33476 00002FDB 9D                      	popf
 33477                                  	;jc	short InitForLo		; (if carry, it's loading low)
 33478                                  	;jmp	short InitForHi
 33479                                  	; 06/07/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 IO.SYS (optimization)
 33480 00002FDC EB0B                    	jmp	short idl0
 33481                                  
 33482                                  ;%endif ; 01/11/2022
 33483                                  
 33484                                  	; 01/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS)
 33485                                  	; (SYSINIT:2B67h)
 33486                                  InitForConv:
 33487                                  	; 11/12/2022
 33488                                  	; ds = cs
 33489 00002FDE E83700                  	call	SpaceInUMB		; Do we have space left in the
 33490                                  					;  current UMB ?
 33491 00002FE1 7308                    	jnc	short InitForHi		; yes, we have
 33492 00002FE3 E83F04                  	call	ShrinkUMB		; shrink the current UMB in use
 33493 00002FE6 E84500                  	call	GetUMBForDev		; else try to allocate new UMB
 33494                                  idl0: ; 06/07/2023
 33495 00002FE9 720D                    	jc	short InitForLo		; we didn't succeed, so load
 33496                                  					;  in low memory

 33498                                  	; 11/12/2022
 33499                                  	; ds = cs
 33500                                  	;mov	ax,[cs:DevUMBFree]	; get Para addr of free mem
 33501                                  	;mov	dx,[cs:DevUMBAddr]	; UMB start addr
 33502                                  	;add	dx,[cs:DevUMBSize]	; DX = UMB End addr

 33504 00002FEE 8B16[481F]              	mov	dx,[DevUMBAddr]
 33505 00002FF2 0316[4A1F]              	add	dx,[DevUMBSize]
 33506 00002FF6 EB0C                    	jmp	short idl1
 33507                                  
 33508                                  InitForLo:
 33509                                  	; 11/12/2022
 33510                                  	; ds = cs
 33511                                  	;mov	byte [cs:DeviceHi],0	; in case we failed to load
 33512 00002FF8 C606[561F]00            	mov	byte [DeviceHi],0
 33513                                  initforlo_x:
 33514                                  	; 11/12/2022
 33515                                  	; ds = cs
 33516                                  					;  into UMB indicate that
 33517                                  					;  we are loading low
 33518                                  	;mov	ax,[cs:memhi]		; AX = Start of Low memory
 33519                                  	;mov	dx,[cs:ALLOCLIM]	; DX = End of Low memory
 33520 00002FFD A1[6403]                	mov	ax,[memhi]
 33521 00003000 8B16[A502]              	mov	dx,[ALLOCLIM]
 33522                                  idl1:
 33523 00003004 E86600                  	call	DevSetMark		; setup a sub-arena for DD
 33524                                  	; 11/12/2022
 33525                                  	; ds = cs
 33526                                  	;mov	[cs:DevLoadAddr],ax	; init the Device load address
 33527                                  	;mov	[cs:DevLoadEnd],dx	; init the limit of the block
 33528                                  	;mov	word [cs:DevEntry],0	; init Entry point to DD
 33529                                  	;mov	[cs:DevEntry+2],ax
 33530 00003007 A3[3A1F]                	mov	[DevLoadAddr],ax
 33531 0000300A 8916[3C1F]              	mov	[DevLoadEnd],dx
 33532 0000300E C706[3E1F]0000          	mov	word [DevEntry],0
 33533 00003014 A3[401F]                	mov	[DevEntry+2],ax
 33534                                  	; 01/01/2023
 33535                                  	;pop	es ; *
 33536 00003017 C3                      	retn

 33609                                  ;	DevUMBSize, DevUMBAddr & DevUMBFree if it succeeded in allocating
 33610                                  ;	UMB.

 33646 00003047 721D                    	jc	short gufd_err
 33647

 33649                                  	;dec	ax
 33650                                  	;call	PrepareMark
 33651                                  	;

 33703                                  ; procedure : DevSetMark
 33704                                  ;
 33705                                  ;	Input : AX - Free segment were device is going to be loaded
 33706                                  ;	Output : AX - Segment at which device can be loaded (AX=AX+1)
 33707                                  ;
 33708                                  ;	Creates a sub-arena for the device driver
 33709                                  ;	puts 'D' marker in the sub-arena

 33712                                  ;

 33714                                  ;	completion of Device load.

 34235                                  ; procedure : GetHexNum
 34236                                  ;
 34237                                  ;	Converts an ascii string terminated by a delimiter into binary.
 34238                                  ;	Assumes that the ES:SI points to a Hexadecimal string
 34239                                  ;
 34240                                  ;	Returns in AX the number of paras equivalent to the
 34241                                  ;	hex number of bytes specified by the hexadecimal string.
 34242                                  ;
 34243                                  ;	Returns carry in case it encountered a non-hex character or
 34244                                  ;	if it encountered crlf
 34245                                  ;
 34246                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 34247                                  
 34248                                  ; 13/05/2019
 34249                                  
 34250                                  	; 03/01/2023 - Retro DOS v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 34251                                  	; (SYSINIT:38C5h)
 34252

 34254                                  	; (SYSINIT:2DA5h)

 34257 000031F3 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 34258                                  ghn_next:

 34511                                  ;
 34512                                  ;**	umb_coalesce - Combine free blocks ahead with current block
 34513                                  ;
 34514                                  ;	Coalesce adds the block following the argument to the argument block,
 34515                                  ;	if it's free.  Coalesce is usually used to join free blocks, but
 34516                                  ;	some callers (such as $setblock) use it to join a free block to it's
 34517                                  ;	preceeding allocated block.

 34521                                  ;		  (ax) = address of next block, IF not at end
 34522                                  ;		'C' set if arena trashed

 34524                                  ;

 34554                                  					; Y: coalesce

 34884                                  ; SYSINIT2.ASM - MSDOS 6.0 - 1991
 34885                                  ; ----------------------------------------------------------------------
 34886                                  ; 14/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 34887                                  
 34888                                  ; Multiple configuration block support  Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 34889                                  ;
 34890                                  ; Summary:
 34891                                  ;
 34892                                  ;   The procedure "organize" crunches the in-memory copy of config.sys
 34893                                  ;   into lines delimited by CR/LF (sometimes no CR, but *always* an LF)
 34894                                  ;   with the leading "keyword=" replaced by single character codes (eg, B
 34895                                  ;   for BUFFERS, D for DEVICE, Z for any unrecognized keyword); see comtab
 34896                                  ;   and/or config.inc for the full list.
 34897                                  ;
 34898                                  ;   [blockname] and INCLUDE are the major syntactical additions for multi-
 34899                                  ;   configuration support. blockname is either MENU, which contains one
 34900                                  ;   or more MENUITEM lines, an optional MENUDEFAULT (which includes optional
 34901                                  ;   time-out), or any user-defined keyword, such as NETWORK, CD-ROM, etc.
 34902                                  ;   INCLUDE allows the current block to name another block for inclusion
 34903                                  ;   during the processing phase of CONFIG.SYS. An INCLUDE is only honored
 34904                                  ;   once, precluding nasty infinite-loop scenarios. If blocks are present
 34905                                  ;   without a MENU block, then only lines inside COMMON blocks are processed.
 34906                                  ;
 34907                                  ; Example:
 34908                                  ;
 34909                                  ;   [menu]
 34910                                  ;   menuitem=misc,Miscellaneous
 34911                                  ;   menuitem=network,Network Configuration
 34912                                  ;   menudefault=network,15
 34913                                  ;
 34914                                  ;   [network]
 34915                                  ;   include misc
 34916                                  ;   device=foo
 34917                                  ;
 34918                                  ;   [misc]
 34919                                  ;   device=bar
 34920                                  ;   include alternate
 34921                                  ;
 34922                                  ;   [alternate]
 34923                                  ;   device=tar
 34924                                  ;
 34925                                  ;
 34926                                  ;   When the menu is displayed
 34927                                  ;
 34928                                  ;    1. Miscellaneous
 34929                                  ;    2. Network Configuration
 34930                                  ;
 34931                                  ;   #2 is highlighted as the default option, and will be automatically
 34932                                  ;   selected after 15 seconds. It will invoke the following lines in the
 34933                                  ;   following order:
 34934                                  ;
 34935                                  ;       DEVICE=BAR
 34936                                  ;       DEVICE=TAR
 34937                                  ;       DEVICE=FOO
 34938                                  ;
 34939                                  
 34940                                  ;MULTI_CONFIG equ 1
 34941                                  
 34942                                  ; the following depend on the positions of the various letters in switchlist
 34943                                  
 34944                                  switchnum	equ 11111000b ; 0F8h	; which switches require number
 34945                                  
 34946                                  flagec35	equ 00000100b ; 4	; electrically compatible 3.5 inch disk drive
 34947                                  flagdrive	equ 00001000b ; 8 
 34948                                  flagcyln	equ 00010000b ; 16
 34949                                  flagseclim	equ 00100000b ; 32
 34950                                  flagheads	equ 01000000b ; 64
 34951                                  flagff		equ 10000000b ; 128
 34952

 35111                                  	; 03/01/2023

 35113                                  
 35114                                  	;push	ds ; *

 35119                                  nextswtch:
 35120                                  	cmp	al,cr			; carriage return?
 35121                                  	je	short done_line
 35122                                  	cmp	al,lf			; linefeed?
 35123                                  	je	short put_back		; put it back and done
 35124

 35463                                  ; procedure : setdeviceparameters
 35464                                  ;
 35465                                  ; setdeviceparameters sets up the recommended bpb in each bds in the
 35466                                  ; system based on the form factor. it is assumed that the bpbs for the
 35467                                  ; various form factors are present in the bpbtable. for hard files,
 35468                                  ; the recommended bpb is the same as the bpb on the drive.
 35469                                  ; no attempt is made to preserve registers since we are going to jump to
 35470                                  ; sysinit straight after this routine.
 35471                                  ;
 35472                                  ;	if we return carry, the DRIVPARM will be aborted, but presently
 35473                                  ;	  we always return no carry

 36254                                  ;   kbd_read: wait for keystroke
 36255                                  ;
 36256                                  ;   INPUT
 36257                                  ;       DS == CS == sysinitseg
 36258                                  ;
 36259                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36260                                  ;       Carry SET to clean boot, CLEAR otherwise
 36261                                  ;
 36262                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36263                                  ;       All
 36264                                  ;
 36265                                  ;   HISTORY
 36266                                  ;       Created 16-Nov-1992 by JeffPar

 36275 00003883 29C0                            sub     ax,ax           ; 18.2 times per second;

 36277                                  	;mov	dx,[046Ch]	; get initial value
