 36279 00003887 B401                            mov     ah,1            ;
 36280 00003889 CD16                            int     16h             ; peek the keyboard
 36281 0000388B 7514                            jnz	short kbd_loopdone ; something's there, get out
 36282 0000388D B402                            mov     ah,2            ; peek the shift states
 36283 0000388F CD16                            int     16h             ;
 36284 00003891 A803                            test    al,03h          ; either right or left shift key bits set?
 36285 00003893 750C                            jnz	short kbd_loopdone ; yes
 36286 00003895 A16C04                          mov     ax,[046Ch]	;
 36287                                  	;sub	ax,dx           ; get difference
 36288                                  	; 15/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 36290

 36292 0000389F 72E6                            jb	short kbd_loop	; not yet
 36293                                  kbd_loopdone:
 36294 000038A1 1F                              pop     ds              ; delay complete!
 36295                                  kbd_nodelay:

 36297 000038A4 B402                            mov     ah,2            ; peek the shift states
 36298 000038A6 CD16                            int     16h             ;

 36307 000038B5 CD16                            int     16h             ;

 36310 000038BB 753A                            jnz	short kbd_test	; no

 36312                                  	; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS - SYSINIT:430Bh
 36313 000038BD 80FC62                          cmp     ah,62h          ; CTRL F5

 36315                                  	
 36316 000038C2 80FC3F                          cmp     ah,3Fh          ; F5 function key?
 36317 000038C5 750D                            jne	short kbd_notf5	; no
 36318                                  kbd_cfg_bypass:

 36322 000038CD 800E[DC46]04            	or	byte [bQueryOpt],4 
 36323 000038D2 EB16                            jmp     short kbd_eat   ; yes, clean boot selected
 36324                                  kbd_notf5:
 36325                                  	; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS - SYSINIT:4322h
 36326 000038D4 80FC65                          cmp     ah,65h          ; CTRL F8
 36327 000038D7 7405                            je	short kbd_cfg_confirm
 36328                                  
 36329 000038D9 80FC42                          cmp     ah,42h          ; F8 function key?
 36330 000038DC 7523                            jne	short kbd_exit	; no
 36331                                  kbd_cfg_confirm:
 36332 000038DE BA[AD4B]                        mov     dx,_$InterMsg
 36333 000038E1 E8C60B                          call    print           ;

 36335 000038E6 881E[DC46]                      mov     [bQueryOpt],bl  ; change default setting
 36336                                  kbd_eat:                        ;
 36337 000038EA B400                            mov     ah,0            ;
 36338 000038EC CD16                            int     16h             ; eat the key we assumed was a signal
 36339 000038EE C606[E246]FF                    mov	byte [secElapsed],-1
 36340 000038F3 09DB                            or      bx,bx           ;
 36341 000038F5 7405                            jz	short kbd_clean	;
 36342                                  kbd_test:                       ;
 36343 000038F7 80FB02                          cmp     bl,2            ;
 36344 000038FA 7205                            jb	short kbd_exit	;
 36345                                  kbd_clean:                      ;

 36347 000038FF F9                              stc                     ; set carry to indicate abort
 36348 00003900 C3                              retn			;
 36349                                  kbd_exit:                       ;
 36350 00003901 F8                              clc                     ; clear carry to indicate success
 36351 00003902 C3                              retn			;

 36357                                  ;   INPUT

 36374                                          ; 04/01/2023
 36375                                  	;push	ax

 36378 00003906 8ED8                            mov     ds,ax

 36399                                  ;   menu_check: check for presence of menu (and other) configuration blocks
 36400                                  ;
 36401                                  ;   INPUT
 36402                                  ;       CX == "organized" config.sys memory image length
 36403                                  ;    ES:SI -> "organized" config.sys memory image
 36404                                  ;       DS == CS == sysinitseg
 36405                                  ;
 36406                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36407                                  ;       Same as above; the idea is that menu_check simply transforms
 36408                                  ;       a block-structured config.sys image into a conventional image,
 36409                                  ;       based on the user's block selection and any other boot-time options

 36411                                  ;

 36413                                  ;       All
 36414                                  ;
 36415                                  ;   NOTES
 36416                                  ;       [count] and [org_count] are set to the new config.sys image length

 36822                                  copyblock_loop:

 36831                                  
 36832                                  ; 10/09/2023

 36891                                  ;   since the configuration name only currently exists in the "confbot" area
 36892                                  ;

 36898                                                                  ; zero the first byte of the workspace (below)

 36979                                  ;	position (then 'retn' just after it)
 36980                                  ;	but MSDOS 6.21 and PCDOS 7.1 SYSINITs contain only 'retn' here.
 36981                                  
 36982                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36983                                  ;
 36984                                  ;   copy_envvar: copy the envvar at ES:SI to "config_wrkseg"
 36985                                  ;
 36986                                  ;   INPUT
 36987                                  ;    ES:SI -> environment variable (in the form "var=string<cr/lf>")
 36988                                  ;
 36989                                  ;   OUTPUT
 36990                                  ;       config_envlen (ie, where to put next envvar) updated appropriately
 36991                                  ;       carry set if error (eg, missing =); clear otherwise
 36992                                  ;
 36993                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 36994                                  ;       None
 36995                                  ;
 36996                                  ;   NOTES
 36997                                  ;       None
 36998                                  ;
 36999                                  ;   HISTORY
 37000                                  ;       Created 29-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37001                                  ;
 37002                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37003                                  
 37004                                  	; 04/01/2023 - Retrodos v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 37005                                  	; (SYSINIT:46D4h)
 37006                                  
 37007                                  copy_envvar:
 37008 00003C6E 51                              push    cx              ;
 37009 00003C6F 56                              push    si              ;
 37010 00003C70 1E                              push    ds              ;
 37011 00003C71 06                              push    es              ;
 37012 00003C72 06                              push    es              ;
 37013 00003C73 8E06[9714]                      mov     es,[config_wrkseg] ; ES:DI to point to next available byte
 37014 00003C77 1F                              pop     ds                 ; DS:SI to point to envvar
 37015                                  
 37016                                  ;   Have to calculate the length of the variable name (and if we hit
 37017                                  ;   the end of the line before we hit '=', then it's curtains for this
 37018                                  ;   config.sys line)
 37019                                  ;
 37020                                  ;   The check for NULL is important because copy_envvar is also used to copy
 37021                                  ;   the initial CONFIG= setting, which will have been zapped by a NULL if no
 37022                                  ;   menu block existed (in order to prevent the creation of an environment)
 37023                                  
 37024 00003C78 29C9                            sub     cx,cx           ;
 37025                                  copy_varlen:                    ;
 37026 00003C7A AC                              lodsb                   ;
 37027 00003C7B 08C0                            or      al,al           ; NULL?
 37028                                          ;stc	; 10/09/2023 (x)
 37029 00003C7D 746B                            jz	short copy_envexit ; yes, abort
 37030 00003C7F 3C0D                            cmp     al,cr           ;
 37031                                          ;stc	; 10/09/2023 (x)
 37032 00003C81 7467                            je	short copy_envexit
 37033 00003C83 3C0A                            cmp     al,lf           ;
 37034                                          ;stc	; 10/09/2023 (x)
 37035 00003C85 7463                            je	short copy_envexit
 37036 00003C87 41                              inc     cx              ;
 37037 00003C88 3C3D                            cmp     al,'='          ;
 37038 00003C8A 75EE                            jne	short copy_varlen
 37039 00003C8C B000                            mov     al,0            ;
 37040 00003C8E 8A24                            mov     ah,[si]         ; save char after '='
 37041 00003C90 29CE                            sub     si,cx           ; back up to given varname
 37042 00003C92 49                              dec     cx              ; CX == # of bytes in varname
 37043 00003C93 29FF                            sub     di,di           ; start looking for DS:SI at ES:0
 37044                                  copy_varsrch:
 37045 00003C95 263805                          cmp     byte [es:di],al
 37046 00003C98 7425                            je	short copy_envprep ; search failed, just copy var
 37047 00003C9A 89FB                            mov     bx,di           ; ES:BX -> start of this varname
 37048 00003C9C 51                              push    cx              ;
 37049 00003C9D 56                              push    si              ;
 37050 00003C9E F3A6                            repe    cmpsb           ;
 37051 00003CA0 5E                              pop     si              ;
 37052 00003CA1 59                              pop     cx              ;
 37053 00003CA2 7531                            jne	short copy_varnext ; no match, skip to next varname
 37054 00003CA4 26803D3D                        cmp     byte [es:di],'='
 37055 00003CA8 752B                            jne     short copy_varnext ; no match, there's more characters
 37056                                  
 37057                                  ;   Previous occurrence of variable has been found; determine the
 37058                                  ;   entire length and then destroy it
 37059                                  
 37060 00003CAA B9FFFF                          mov     cx,-1           ;
 37061 00003CAD F2AE                            repne   scasb           ; guaranteed to get null (since we put it there)
 37062 00003CAF 56                              push    si              ;
 37063 00003CB0 89FE                            mov     si,di           ;
 37064 00003CB2 89DF                            mov     di,bx           ;
 37065 00003CB4 2E8B0E[9514]                    mov     cx,[cs:config_envlen]
 37066 00003CB9 29F1                            sub     cx,si           ; destroy variable now
 37067                                  	;rep movs byte ptr es:[di],byte ptr es:[si]
 37068                                  	;;db 0F3h,26h,0A4h ; MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS - SYSINIT:4724h
 37069                                  
 37070 00003CBB F3                      	rep	; 0F3h
 37071 00003CBC 26                      	es	; 26h
 37072 00003CBD A4                      	movsb	; 0A4h
 37073                                  
 37074 00003CBE 5E                      	pop     si
 37075                                  copy_envprep:
 37076 00003CBF 80FC0D                          cmp     ah,cr          ; if there is nothing after the '='

 37127                                  ;
 37128                                  ;   copy_block: copy the current block to the new config.sys workspace
 37129                                  ;
 37130                                  ;   INPUT
 37131                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in "organized" config.sys memory image
 37132                                  ;    ES:SI -> remaining bytes in "organized" config.sys memory image
 37133                                  ;    DS:DI -> new config.sys workspace (equal in size to the original
 37134                                  ;             config.sys image) where the current block is to be copied
 37135                                  ;

 37137                                  ;       Same as above
 37138                                  ;       AL also equals the last character read from the organized image
 37139                                  ;
 37140                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED

 37143                                  ;   NOTES

 37145                                  ;
 37146                                  ;   HISTORY

 37154                                  copy_block:

 37167                                  ;   then search for the named block and call copy_block again.

 37197 00003D32 EB2B                            jmp     short copy_nextline

 37241                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37242                                  ;
 37243                                  ;   get_linenum: return line # (in BX) of current line (@ES:SI)
 37244                                  ;
 37245                                  ;   INPUT
 37246                                  ;    ES:SI -> some line in the config.sys memory image
 37247                                  ;
 37248                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37249                                  ;       BX == line # (relative to 1)
 37250                                  ;
 37251                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37252                                  ;       DX
 37253                                  ;
 37254                                  ;   NOTES
 37255                                  ;       None
 37256                                  ;
 37257                                  ;   HISTORY
 37258                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37259                                  ;
 37260                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37261                                  
 37262                                  get_linenum:
 37263 00003D64 50                              push    ax              ;
 37264 00003D65 29DB                            sub     bx,bx           ; BX == line # (to be returned)
 37265 00003D67 51                              push    cx              ;
 37266 00003D68 89F2                            mov     dx,si           ; DX == the offset we're looking for
 37267 00003D6A 56                              push    si              ;
 37268 00003D6B 2E8B0E[5603]                    mov     cx,[cs:count]   ;
 37269 00003D70 29F6                            sub     si,si           ; prepare to scan entire file
 37270                                  get_linenum_loop:               ;
 37271 00003D72 E8C402                          call    skip_line       ;
 37272 00003D75 7205                            jc	short get_linenum_done
 37273 00003D77 43                              inc     bx              ;
 37274 00003D78 39D6                            cmp     si,dx           ; have we exceeded the desired offset yet?
 37275 00003D7A 72F6                            jb	short get_linenum_loop ; no
 37276                                  get_linenum_done:               ;
 37277 00003D7C 5E                              pop     si              ;
 37278 00003D7D 59                              pop     cx              ;
 37279 00003D7E 58                              pop     ax              ;

 37282                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37283                                  ;
 37284                                  ;   srch_block: searches entire config.sys for block name @ES:DI
 37285                                  ;
 37286                                  ;   INPUT
 37287                                  ;       ES -> config.sys image
 37288                                  ;    ES:DI -> block name to find
 37289                                  ;
 37290                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37291                                  ;       ZF flag set, if found
 37292                                  ;    ES:DI -> just past the name in the block heading, if found
 37293                                  ;       BX == # bytes remaining from that point, if found
 37294                                  ;
 37295                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37296                                  ;       None
 37297                                  ;
 37298                                  ;   NOTES
 37299                                  ;       This differs from "find_block" in that it searches the ENTIRE
 37300                                  ;       config.sys image, not merely the remaining portion, and that it
 37301                                  ;       takes a pointer to block name that is *elsewhere* in the image
 37302                                  ;       (ie, ES) as opposed to some string constant in our own segment (DS).
 37303                                  ;
 37304                                  ;   HISTORY
 37305                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37306                                  ;
 37307                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37308                                  
 37309                                  srch_block:	          ; returns BX -> named block in CONFIG.SYS
 37310 00003D80 50                              push    ax              ;
 37311 00003D81 51                              push    cx              ;
 37312 00003D82 2E8B0E[5603]                    mov     cx,[cs:count]   ;
 37313 00003D87 56                              push    si              ;
 37314 00003D88 29F6                            sub     si,si           ;
 37315 00003D8A 1E                              push    ds              ;
 37316 00003D8B 06                              push    es              ;
 37317 00003D8C 1F                              pop     ds              ;
 37318 00003D8D E80900                          call    find_block      ;
 37319 00003D90 89F7                            mov     di,si           ;
 37320 00003D92 89CB                            mov     bx,cx           ;
 37321 00003D94 1F                              pop     ds              ;
 37322 00003D95 5E                              pop     si              ;
 37323 00003D96 59                              pop     cx              ;
 37324 00003D97 58                              pop     ax              ;
 37325                                  find_exit: ; 16/04/2019
 37326 00003D98 C3                              retn			;
 37327                                  
 37328                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37329                                  ;
 37330                                  ;   find_block: searches rest of config.sys for block name @DS:DI
 37331                                  ;
 37332                                  ;   INPUT
 37333                                  ;    DS:DI -> block name to find
 37334                                  ;    ES:SI -> remainder of config.sys image
 37335                                  ;       CX == remaining size of config.sys image
 37336                                  ;
 37337                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37338                                  ;       ZF flag set, if found (also, CF set if EOF)
 37339                                  ;    ES:SI -> where the search stopped (at end of block name or EOF)
 37340                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 37341                                  ;
 37342                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37343                                  ;       AX
 37344                                  ;
 37345                                  ;   NOTES
 37346                                  ;       This differs from "srch_block" in that it searches only the
 37347                                  ;       remaining portion of the config.sys image and leaves SI and CX
 37348                                  ;       pointing to where the search left off, and that it takes a pointer
 37349                                  ;       to search string in our own segment (DS:DI instead of ES:DI).
 37350                                  ;
 37351                                  ;   HISTORY
 37352                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37353                                  ;
 37354                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37355                                  
 37356                                  find_block:
 37357 00003D99 E8C802                          call    get_char        ; get line code
 37358 00003D9C 72FA                            jc	short find_exit	; end of file
 37359 00003D9E 247F                            and     al,~CONFIG_OPTION_QUERY
 37360 00003DA0 3C5B                            cmp     al,CONFIG_BEGIN ; beginning of a block?
 37361 00003DA2 740C                            je	short check_line ; no
 37362 00003DA4 3C4A                            cmp     al,CONFIG_INCLUDE
 37363 00003DA6 7513                            jne	short next_line	;
 37364 00003DA8 2E800E[9A14]01                  or	byte [cs:config_multi],1
 37365 00003DAE EB0B                            jmp     short next_line ;
 37366                                  check_line:
 37367 00003DB0 2E800E[9A14]01                  or      byte [cs:config_multi],1
 37368 00003DB6 E80700                          call    comp_names      ; compare block names
 37369 00003DB9 76DD                            jbe	short find_exit	; end of file, or names matched
 37370                                  next_line:
 37371 00003DBB E88002                          call    skip_opt_line   ; no, so skip to next line
 37372 00003DBE EBD9                            jmp	short find_block  ;
 37373                                  ;find_exit:
 37374                                  ;	retn
 37375                                  
 37376                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37377                                  ;
 37378                                  ;   comp_names: compares keyword @DS:DI to position in config.sys @ES:SI
 37379                                  ;
 37380                                  ;   INPUT
 37381                                  ;    DS:DI -> keyword to compare
 37382                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 37383                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 37384                                  ;
 37385                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37386                                  ;       ZF flag set, if match (also, CF set if EOF)
 37387                                  ;    ES:SI -> where the comparison stopped (at end of block name or EOF)
 37388                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 37389                                  ;
 37390                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37391                                  ;       AX
 37392                                  ;
 37393                                  ;   NOTES
 37394                                  ;       None
 37395                                  ;
 37396                                  ;   HISTORY
 37397                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37398                                  ;
 37399                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37400                                  
 37401                                  comp_names:
 37402 00003DC0 57                              push    di              ;
 37403                                  comp_loop:                      ;
 37404 00003DC1 E8A002                          call    get_char        ;
 37405 00003DC4 7210                            jc	short comp_exit	;
 37406 00003DC6 E80704                          call    any_delim       ; is next character a delimiter?
 37407 00003DC9 8A25                            mov     ah,[di]         ; (get next character we're supposed to match)
 37408 00003DCB 740B                            je	short comp_almost ; yes, it *could* be a match
 37409 00003DCD 47                              inc     di              ;
 37410 00003DCE 25DFDF                          and     ax,~2020h ; 0DFDFh 
 37411                                  				; BUGBUG -- assumes both names are alphanumeric -JTP
 37412 00003DD1 38E0                            cmp     al,ah           ; match?
 37413 00003DD3 74EC                            je	short comp_loop ; yes, keep looking at the characters
 37414 00003DD5 F8                              clc                     ; prevent erroneous eof indication: clear carry
 37415                                  comp_exit:                      ;
 37416 00003DD6 5F                              pop     di              ;
 37417 00003DD7 C3                              retn			;
 37418                                  comp_almost:                    ;
 37419 00003DD8 86C4                            xchg    al,ah           ; we don't know for sure if it's a match
 37420 00003DDA E8F303                          call    any_delim       ; until we verify that the second string has
 37421 00003DDD 86C4                            xchg    al,ah           ; been exhausted also...
 37422 00003DDF EBF5                            jmp     short comp_exit ; if we are, this call to any_delim will tell...
 37423                                  
 37424                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37425

 37427                                  comp_names_x:
 37428                                  	;

 37469 00003DEF 50                              push    ax              ;
 37470 00003DF0 53                              push    bx              ;
 37471 00003DF1 51                              push    cx              ;

 37485 00003E0C 8A26[D346]                      mov     ah,[bMenuColor] ; normal attribute

 37487 00003E14 7510                            jne	short print_other ; no
 37488 00003E16 80CC70                          or      ah,70h          ; yes, set bgnd color to white
 37489 00003E19 88E5                            mov     ch,ah           ;
 37490 00003E1B B104                            mov     cl,4            ;
 37491 00003E1D D2C5                            rol     ch,cl           ;

 37493 00003E21 7503                            jne	short print_other ; no

 37504 00003E3B FEC2                            inc     dl              ; increment column
 37505 00003E3D B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;
 37506 00003E3F CD10                            int     10h             ;
 37507                                          ;mov	ax,0900h+'.'    ;

 37509 00003E44 CD10                    	int     10h             ; display '.'

 37511 00003E48 B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;
 37512 00003E4A CD10                            int     10h             ;
 37513                                          ;mov	ax,0900h+' '    ;
 37514 00003E4C B82009                          mov	ax,0920h
 37515 00003E4F CD10                    	int     10h             ; display ' '
 37516 00003E51 FEC2                            inc     dl              ; increment column
 37517 00003E53 B402                            mov     ah,02h          ;

 37520                                  print_loop:                     ;
 37521 00003E58 268A05                          mov     al,[es:di]	; get a character of the description
 37522 00003E5B 47                              inc     di              ;
 37523 00003E5C 3C09                            cmp     al,TAB ; 9	; substitute spaces for tabs
 37524 00003E5E 7502                            jne	short print_nontab ;
 37525 00003E60 B020                            mov     al,' '          ;
 37526                                  print_nontab:                   ;

 37529 00003E66 3C24                            cmp     al,'$'          ;

 37547 00003E84 5B                              pop     bx              ;
 37548 00003E85 58                              pop     ax              ;
 37549 00003E86 C3                              retn			;

 37554                                  ;

 37843                                  ;   skip_token: advances ES:SI/CX past the current token
 37844                                  ;
 37845                                  ;   INPUT
 37846                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 37847                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 37848                                  ;
 37849                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37850                                  ;       CF set if EOL/EOF hit
 37851                                  ;       AL == 1st char of delimiter
 37852                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past the delimiter
 37853                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 37854                                  ;
 37855                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37856                                  ;       AX
 37857                                  ;
 37858                                  ;   NOTES
 37859                                  ;       None
 37860                                  ;
 37861                                  ;   HISTORY
 37862                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37863                                  ;
 37864                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37865                                  
 37866                                  skip_token:
 37867 00004014 E84D00                          call    get_char
 37868 00004017 7210                            jc	short skip_token_done
 37869 00004019 E8B401                          call    any_delim
 37870 0000401C 75F6                            jne	short skip_token
 37871                                  skip_check_eol:
 37872 0000401E 3C0D                            cmp     al,cr ; 0Dh
 37873 00004020 7406                            je	short skip_token_eol
 37874 00004022 3C0A                            cmp     al,lf ; 0Ah
 37875 00004024 7402                            je	short skip_token_eol
 37876 00004026 F8                              clc
 37877                                          ;jmp	short skip_token_done
 37878 00004027 C3                      	retn
 37879                                  skip_token_eol:
 37880 00004028 F9                              stc
 37881                                  skip_token_done:
 37882 00004029 C3                              retn
 37883                                  
 37884                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37885                                  ;
 37886                                  ;   skip_delim: advances ES:SI/CX past the current delimiter
 37887                                  ;
 37888                                  ;   INPUT
 37889                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 37890                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 37891                                  ;
 37892                                  ;   OUTPUT
 37893                                  ;       CF set if EOF hit
 37894                                  ;       AL == 1st char of token
 37895                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past the token
 37896                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 37897                                  ;    ES:BX -> new token (since ES:SI is already pointing 1 byte past token)
 37898                                  ;
 37899                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 37900                                  ;       AX
 37901                                  ;
 37902                                  ;   NOTES
 37903                                  ;       None
 37904                                  ;
 37905                                  ;   HISTORY
 37906                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 37907                                  ;
 37908                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 37909                                  
 37910                                  skip_delim:	; returns carry set if eol/eof
 37911 0000402A E83700                          call    get_char        ;
 37912 0000402D 8D5CFF                          lea     bx,[si-1]       ; also returns BX -> next token
 37913 00004030 72F7                            jc	short skip_token_done ;
 37914 00004032 E8AB01                          call    delim           ;
 37915 00004035 74F3                            je	short skip_delim ;
 37916 00004037 EBE5                            jmp	short skip_check_eol  ; 13/05/2019

 37921                                  ;

 37928                                  ;       CF set if EOF hit

 37939                                  ;       it would be if the last character fetched -- AL -- was a linefeed)
 37940                                  ;
 37941                                  ;   HISTORY
 37942                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar

 37951                                  	; fall into skip_line

 37963                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past 1st char of new line

 38040                                  ;
 38041                                  ;   get_char: return next character, advance ES:SI, and decrement CX
 38042                                  ;
 38043                                  ;   INPUT
 38044                                  ;    ES:SI -> position in config.sys
 38045                                  ;       CX == remaining bytes in config.sys
 38046                                  ;
 38047                                  ;   OUTPUT
 38048                                  ;       AL == next character
 38049                                  ;    ES:SI -> just past next character
 38050                                  ;       CX == # bytes remaining from that point
 38051                                  ;
 38052                                  ;   OTHER REGS USED
 38053                                  ;       AX
 38054                                  ;
 38055                                  ;   NOTES
 38056                                  ;       None
 38057                                  ;
 38058                                  ;   HISTORY
 38059                                  ;       Created 16-Mar-1992 by JeffPar
 38060                                  ;
 38061                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38062                                  
 38063                                  get_char:
 38064 00004064 83E901                          sub     cx,1            ; use SUB to set carry,zero
 38065 00004067 7205                            jb	short get_fail	; out of data
 38066                                          ;lods	byte ptr es:[si] ;
 38067 00004069 26                      	es	
 38068 0000406A AC                      	lodsb
 38069 0000406B 88C4                            mov     ah,al           ;
 38070 0000406D C3                              retn			;

 38664                                  ;
 38665                                  ; procedure : getnum
 38666                                  ;
 38667                                  ; getnum parses a decimal number.
 38668                                  ; returns it in ax, sets zero flag if ax = 0 (may be considered an
 38669                                  ; error), if number is bad carry is set, zero is set, ax=0.
 38670                                  ;
 38671                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38672                                  
 38673                                  getnum:
 38674 000042BB 53                      	push	bx
 38675 000042BC 31DB                    	xor	bx,bx			; running count is zero
 38676                                  b2:
 38677 000042BE E8F2FF                  	call	todigit 		; do we have a digit ?
 38678 000042C1 7247                    	jc	short badnum		; no, bomb
 38679                                  
 38680 000042C3 93                      	xchg	ax,bx			; put total in ax
 38681 000042C4 53                      	push	bx			; save digit (0 to 9)
 38682                                  	;mov	bx,10			; base of arithmetic
 38683                                  	; 12/12/2022
 38684 000042C5 B30A                    	mov	bl,10
 38685 000042C7 F7E3                    	mul	bx			; shift by one decimal digit
 38686 000042C9 5B                      	pop	bx			; get back digit (0 to 9)
 38687 000042CA 00D8                    	add	al,bl			; get total
 38688 000042CC 80D400                  	adc	ah,0			; make that 16 bits
 38689 000042CF 7239                    	jc	short badnum		; too big a number
 38690                                  
 38691 000042D1 93                      	xchg	ax,bx			; stash total
 38692                                  
 38693 000042D2 E830FF                  	call	getchr			; get next digit
 38694 000042D5 722D                    	jc	short b1		; no more characters
 38695 000042D7 3C20                    	cmp	al,' ' 			; space?
 38696 000042D9 741F                    	je	short b15		; then end of digits
 38697 000042DB 3C2C                    	cmp	al,',' 			; ',' is a seperator!!!
 38698 000042DD 741B                    	je	short b15		; then end of digits.
 38699 000042DF 3C09                    	cmp	al, tab ; 9		; tab
 38700 000042E1 7417                    	je	short b15
 38701 000042E3 2E3A06[AE02]            	cmp	al,[cs:sepchr]		; allow 0 or special separators
 38702 000042E8 7410                    	je	short b15
 38703 000042EA 3C2F                    	cmp	al,'/'			; see if another switch follows
 38704                                  	; 12/12/2022
 38705                                  	; 02/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 38706                                  	;nop				; cas - remnant of old bad code
 38707                                  	;nop
 38708 000042EC 740C                    	je	short b15
 38709 000042EE 3C0A                    	cmp	al,lf			; line-feed?
 38710 000042F0 7408                    	je	short b15
 38711 000042F2 3C0D                    	cmp	al,cr			; carriage return?
 38712 000042F4 7404                    	je	short b15
 38713 000042F6 08C0                    	or	al,al			; end of line separator?
 38714 000042F8 75C4                    	jnz	short b2		; no, try as a valid char...
 38715                                  b15:
 38716 000042FA 2EFF06[5603]            	inc	word [cs:count]		; one more character to s...
 38717 000042FF 2EFF0E[5A03]            	dec	word [cs:chrptr]	; back up over separator
 38718                                  b1:
 38719 00004304 89D8                    	mov	ax,bx			; get proper count
 38720 00004306 09C0                    	or	ax,ax			; clears carry, sets zero accordingly
 38721 00004308 5B                      	pop	bx
 38722 00004309 C3                      	retn
 38723                                  badnum:
 38724                                  	; 02/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 IO.SYS SYSINIT compatibility)
 38725                                  	;mov	byte [cs:sepchr],0
 38726 0000430A 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax			; set zero flag, and ax = 0
 38727                                  	; 12 /12/2022
 38728 0000430C 2EA2[AE02]              	mov	[cs:sepchr],al ; 0
 38729 00004310 5B                      	pop	bx
 38730 00004311 F9                      	stc				; and carry set
 38731 00004312 C3                      	retn

 39070                                  readincontrolbuffer:
 39071                                  
 39072                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 39073                                  ;move file pointer to cx:dx
 39074                                  ;read ax bytes into the control buffer. (should be less than 2 kb)
 39075                                  ;si will be set to 0 hence ds:si points to the control buffer.
 39076                                  ;
 39077                                  ;entry:  cx,dx offset from the start of the file where the read/write pointer
 39078                                  ;	 be moved.
 39079                                  ;	 ax - # of bytes to read
 39080                                  ;	 bx - file handle
 39081                                  ;	 ds - buffer seg.
 39082                                  ;return: the control data information is read into ds:0 - ds:0200.
 39083                                  ;	 cx,dx value destroyed.
 39084                                  ;	 carry set if error in reading file.
 39085                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 39086                                  
 39087 00004463 50                      	push	ax			;# of bytes to read
 39088 00004464 B80042                  	mov	ax,4200h
 39089 00004467 F9                      	stc
 39090 00004468 CD21                    	int	21h			;move pointer
 39091 0000446A 59                      	pop	cx			;# of bytes to read
 39092 0000446B 7209                    	jc	short ricb_exit
 39093                                  
 39094 0000446D 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx			;ds:dx -> control buffer
 39095 0000446F 31F6                    	xor	si,si
 39096 00004471 B43F                    	mov	ah,3Fh			;read into the buffer
 39097 00004473 F9                      	stc
 39098 00004474 CD21                    	int	21h			;should be less than 1024 bytes.
 39099                                  ricb_exit:
 39100 00004476 C3                      	retn

 39108                                  set_country_path:
 39109                                  
 39110                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 39111                                  ;in:  ds - sysinitseg, es - confbot, si -> start of the asciiz path string
 39112                                  ;     dosinfo_ext, cntry_drv, cntry_root, cntry_path
 39113                                  ;     assumes current directory is the root directory.
 39114                                  ;out: ds:di -> full path (cntry_drv).
 39115                                  ;     set the cntry_drv string from the country=,,path command.
 39116                                  ;     ds, es, si value saved.
 39117                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 39118                                  
 39119                                  	; 04/01/2023 - Retrodos v4.2 (Modified MSDOS 6.21 IO.SYS)
 39120                                  	; (SYSINIT:4EF4h)
 39121                                  
 39122                                  	; 10/09/2023 - Retrodos v4.2 IO.SYS (Optimization)
 39123                                  	; (Retrodos v5.0 Pre-Works)
 39124                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMBIO.COM - SYSINIT:513Bh)
 39125                                  
 39126                                  	push	si
 39127                                  
 39128                                  	push	ds			;switch ds, es
 39129                                  	push	es
 39130                                  	pop	ds
 39131                                  	pop	es			;now ds -> confbot, es -> sysinitseg
 39132                                  
 39133                                  	call	chk_drive_letter	;current ds:[si] is a drive letter?
 39134                                  	jc	short scp_default_drv 	;no, use current default drive.
 39135                                  
 39136                                  	mov	al,[si]
 39137                                  	inc	si
 39138                                  	inc	si			;si -> next char after ":"
 39139                                  	jmp	short scp_setdrv
 39140                                  
 39141                                  scp_default_drv:
 39142                                  	mov	ah,19h
 39143                                  	int	21h
 39144                                  	add	al,"A"			;convert it to a character.
 39145                                  
 39146                                  scp_setdrv:
 39147                                  	mov	[cs:cntry_drv],al	;set the drive letter.
 39148                                  	mov	di,cntry_path
 39149                                  	mov	al,[si]
 39150                                  	cmp	al, "\"
 39151                                  	je	short scp_root_dir
 39152                                  
 39153                                  	cmp	al,"/"			;let's accept "/" as an directory delim
 39154                                  	;je	short scp_root_dir
 39155                                  	;jmp	short scp_path
 39156                                  	; 04/01/2023
 39157                                  	jne	short scp_path
 39158                                  
 39159                                  scp_root_dir:
 39160                                  	dec	di			;di -> cntry_root
 39161                                  scp_path:
 39162                                  	call	move_asciiz		;copy it
 39163                                  
 39164                                  	mov	di,cntry_drv
 39165                                  scpath_exit:
 39166                                  
 39167                                  	push	ds			;switch ds, es
 39168                                  	push	es
 39169                                  	pop	ds
 39170                                  	pop	es			;ds, es value restored
 39171                                  
 39172                                  	pop	si
 39173                                  	retn
 39174
